# Le Sette Sorelle — Blender Exterior 1000× Master Plan

> Generated from a 196-agent workflow (Recon → Capabilities → 28 design workstreams × [3 divergent lenses → synthesis → adversarial feasibility → Blender production spec] → synthesis → completeness critics). Planning artifact — no assets modeled yet. Staging-only, gated behind a new `flag3d('w3_exterior')`.

**Scope:** 28 workstreams · ~196 agents

## Wave-1 Hero Dome — BUILT & VISUALLY CONFIRMED (2026-08-09)

The canary was finished to Wave-1 quality and verified in-app (`/flythrough`, behind `flag3d('w3_exterior')`): an **ogival (Florentine-pointed) ribbed terracotta shell** + **12 arched drum thermal-bay aediculae** (pilasters, semicircular arch, keystone, recessed dark glass) that replace the procedural dome, ribs **and** the flat drum-window stickers (`if (!W3)`-guarded); the procedural colonnaded lantern + gold finial are kept. Authored at absolute centralGroup heights so it drops in at the origin. Selected by GPU tier (`getQuality().maxEagerTextureSets`). Console clean (only the pre-existing `mergeGeometries index 20` error, unrelated).

**Texture/rusticity pass (2026-08-09, per owner "must be 100× better, keep+develop the dakpanstructuur"):** flat vertex-colour + AO was insufficient. Now uses **real CC0 Polyhaven PBR** — `clay_roof_tiles_02` (weathered terracotta: baseColor + nor_gl normal @ strength 1.7 + roughness) on the shell, `beige_wall_001` (cream stone) on ribs + drum bays — tiled on a cylindrical **Detail UV (texCoord1)**, with scene-AO baked on the unique **UVMap (texCoord0)**; embedded (CSP allows). CRITICAL: the Polyhaven import does NOT wire the normal map to the BSDF — had to connect `nor_gl`→NormalMap→Principled.Normal manually, else all tile relief is lost (and baking NORMAL to a single UV flattens it — so color/normal/rough stay LIVE, only AO is baked). Plus **modeled horizontal tile courses**: the shell profile is a sawtooth radial lip per course (15 courses) → real stepped tile-row shadow lines in geometry, not just texture. Warm weathered terracotta from the photo texture resolves the flat-pink `#A5674E` roof-colour complaint. **Colonnaded lantern baked into the GLB** (2026-08-09): 8-column cream drum with recessed dark-glass windows, entablature, ogival cupola, and an **emissive gold finial** (MAT_gold_emissive, emission strength 2.6 → crosses the app's 0.85 bloom threshold and glows in-app). The procedural oculus + lantern (ExteriorScene.tsx ~L1884-1919) are now `if (!W3)`-guarded. Crown is 4 material slots (terracotta / cream stone / glass / emissive gold). **3 LODs**, DRACO + embedded, ~1.0–1.1 MB each (dominated by textures): `dome_w3.glb` desktop 24.3k tris, `dome_w3_lod1.glb` mobile 7.3k, `dome_w3_lod2.glb` potato 3.6k. Remaining optional polish: per-LOD 512px textures to shrink mobile/potato download; triangulate before export to silence the tangent warning.

## Wave-0 Pipeline Canary — BUILT & VISUALLY CONFIRMED (2026-08-09)

The dome-shell canary was authored in Blender 5.2 via the Blender MCP and rendered live in-app (`/flythrough`, localhost, behind `flag3d('w3_exterior')`) — a terracotta coppo shell with 8 travertine meridian ribs + oculus, ~12.9k tris, baked AO on UV0, dropped onto the exact procedural dome origin `(0, 23.7, 0)`, hiding the procedural shell/ribs. Assets: `public/models/exterior/dome_w3.glb` + external `dome_w3_ao.jpg`. Code seam: `warmDracoDecoder()` in `modelLoader.ts` + the W3 block in `ExteriorScene.tsx` (material cloned, `aoMap.channel=0`, remove-not-dispose cleanup, try/catch → procedural fallback).

**Two integration findings the canary surfaced — both now RESOLVED via a CSP fix:**
1. **DRACO decode hung in-app** — three's `DRACOLoader` spins its decoder in a Web Worker created from a `blob:` URL; with no `worker-src` directive the CSP fell back to `default-src 'self'` and blocked the worker, so the GLTFLoader promise never settled and the mesh never appeared. **Fix:** added `worker-src 'self' blob:` to `next.config.ts`. DRACO now decodes in-app; the canary ships **DRACO-compressed (~272 KB)**, restoring the "DRACO mandatory / ≤500 KB per asset" budget line.
2. **Embedded GLB textures failed the same class of rule** ("THREE.GLTFLoader: Couldn't load texture blob") — three's `ImageBitmapLoader` `fetch()`es embedded glTF images from `blob:` URLs, and `connect-src` lacked `blob:`. **Fix:** added `blob:` to `connect-src`. Embedded textures now load, so the AO ships **baked into the single GLB** (no external file).

Net: the full standard pipeline — **Blender → DRACO-compressed GLB with embedded AO → modelLoader → material-rebind → render** — is proven end-to-end in-app, behind the flag, with the two CSP directives above as the only infra change. (`worker-src`/`connect-src blob:` are the standard allowances for wasm/worker-based loaders; `object-src 'none'`, `frame-ancestors 'none'`, etc. are untouched.)

## Executive Vision & the 1000x Thesis

## Executive Vision — Le Sette Sorelle Exterior, and What "1000x" Actually Means

### The one-sentence thesis

Today the exterior palace is a *diagram* of a Renaissance villa — geometrically correct, procedurally generated, and honest about its own crudeness. The 1000x goal is to make it read as a *photographed* late-Mannerist Italian villa "grown over the centuries," by surgically replacing the handful of geometry primitives the eye actually lands on with Blender-authored, DRACO-compressed hero assets — streamed through the pipeline the app already ships in production — **without adding a single frame of jank on a mid iPhone.**

"1000x" is deliberately not a rendering-throughput number. It is a **perceived-quality** number, measured where perception happens: the specific frames of the 18-second establishing dolly, and the three reduced-motion stills (WP1 / WP3 / WP5). We are not rebuilding the scene. We are re-authoring roughly a dozen surfaces the camera stares at, and leaving the other ~4,900 lines of procedural terrain, grass, wheat, cypress fields, sky, and daylight untouched as the permanent fallback.

### What "1000x" concretely resolves to

The current exterior is 100% procedural `THREE.BufferGeometry` merged into ~18 static draw calls. Its fidelity ceiling is set by five "tell" surfaces that the routing doctrine ranks by perceived-quality return:

| Element | Today (the "tell") | After (the hero asset) |
|---|---|---|
| **Dome shell** | Smooth hemisphere | 8-panel segmented ogival shell with *proud modeled ribs* + travertine webs — the single highest ROI, visible at every waypoint |
| **Drum windows** | 12 flat box "stickers" | One deep arched thermal-bay tile (reveal + volute keystone + blind niches), instanced 12× around the round r=8.2 drum |
| **Corinthian capitals** | Box tops on cylinders | Real acanthus/caulicoli capitals — the most-read element at the 7.5s tympanum name-beat |
| **Balustrades** | Rows of tapered cylinders | Lathe-profile balusters (torus/vase/plinth) as `InstancedMesh` |
| **Fountain** | Stacked cylinders + sphere bumps | Carved tazza with fluting (mascaron is a fast-follow, not v1) |

Crowning it all: a hero **terracotta dome + drum + gold lantern**, and a monumental stair with a **gold tympanum bearing the owner's name** — the emotional payoff of the establishing shot. That is the whole game. Fix those surfaces at exactly WP1/WP3/WP5 and the villa stops looking authored and starts looking *old*.

### The core strategy — four disciplines, no heroics

**1. Ride the pipeline that already ships.** The GLB path is production-proven: `modelLoader.ts` (GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader, decoder warm at `/public/draco/`) already streams `bust_base.glb` and `bust_female.glb`. Blender-authored, DRACO-compressed GLB is therefore a *solved* integration — new hero assets drop into `public/models/exterior/`, load async inside the existing scene `useEffect` after the synchronous geometry pass, wrapped in try/catch, with the procedural build as the guaranteed fallback on any reject. No second WebGL context (iOS jetsam kills it silently); reuse the pooled renderer.

**2. Author in Blender, route by asset class.** Everything architectural and repeatable — balusters, urns, cornices, arcades, roof coppo, dome, drum, lantern, stair, tympanum lettering — is **scripted BPY** (lathe/screw/array from swappable profiles): deterministic, tiny (~450–670 tris/piece), instanceable. Only figural work (statuary, mascarons, coats-of-arms) needs generative image→3D (Hunyuan3D / Rodin), and that entire class is **demoted to a fast-follow** because both generators are currently disabled pending owner enablement + commercial-license confirmation. **v1 ships zero generative dependencies.** Polyhaven supplies CC0 textures + one golden-hour HDRI only — never villa geometry. Travertine/marble are authored procedural (noise+voronoi) and baked, because no matching scan exists.

**3. REPLACE, never ADD — draw calls are the mobile killer, not tris.** This is the load-bearing discipline and the one the feasibility audits hammer hardest. The exterior is already near the mobile 150-draw-call ceiling. Every GLB must *replace* the procedural equivalent, be instanced or merged-per-material, and profile net-neutral-or-negative on draw calls — never layer on top. The audits surfaced real hazards here that the build plan must respect: several "replaceable" primitives (balusters, some capitals) are baked into shared `mergeGeometries` passes and are **not individually hideable** until a step-0 refactor gives them named handles; `loadModel()` returns a `.clone()` that **shares materials and geometry** with the cache master (naive disposal corrupts the next mount); and `mkPhys(three, props)` **constructs** a material — it does not patch a live one, so every loaded GLB material must be rebuilt fresh, with `aoMap.channel=0` and baked AO carrying contact shadow on mobile/potato. These are known, fixable, and gated behind the build gate — but they are why this is a *surgical* program, not a "drop in a dome" program.

**4. Budget-disciplined, per device, behind a flag.** Everything hides behind a fresh `flag3d('w3_exterior')` (W3 = W2 && flag), auto staging-ON / prod-OFF, retired only after prod + iOS WKWebView verification. Hard ceilings, binding on iOS: **≤750k tris / ≤80 opaque calls / ≤140MB texture**, ~8–10MB over-the-wire hero payload, DRACO mandatory, ≤4 shared PBR sets (mobile eager cap). Three LOD tiers: **desktop** full decorative set; **mobile** hero-set (dome + drum + capital + baluster) at ≤60k-tri LODs; **potato** dome-only at ultra-low LOD, no shadows, no env map. All bakes match the one sun (`#FFB870` at `[-20,18,-30]`) and the one grade (NeutralToneMapping, exposure 1.15; bake at 1.0) so the GLB never clashes with adjacent procedural geometry. The adaptive governor demotes a device for 7 days if >20% of frames miss 25ms in the first 15s — so hero assets must profile clean *during warmup*, with DRACO pre-warmed and uploads staged behind the pre-dolly veil.

### The before / after the owner will perceive

- **Before:** a competent 3D placeholder. Read dead-on at the tympanum beat, the dome is a bald hemisphere, the windows are decals, the capitals are boxes, and the name sits over flat masonry. It looks *made*.
- **After:** the establishing dolly opens on a terracotta ogival dome with real ribs catching the SW sun, a drum ringed with deep arched bays, a monumental stair rising to a gilt tympanum carrying the owner's name — a villa that reads as if it has stood for four centuries and grown one wing at a time. The reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 each compose a magazine-quality frame.
- **Unchanged, and that is the point:** ~60fps inside iOS WKWebView, the iOS free-tier App-Review seal intact, i18n and reduced-motion respected, prod untouched until the flag flips. The 1000x is a *quality* delta the owner sees on day one — not a performance debt they pay for later.

### Sequencing headline

Ship the highest-ROI hero (dome shell) as the pipeline canary; prove the draw-call baseline on a real device *before* authoring the kit; land the step-0 "make hero primitives individually removable" refactor first; keep all figural/generative work off the first prod promotion. JPG-first (KTX2 is a fast-follow — `toktx` is not yet installed and is explicitly *not* a v1 dependency). Everything additive-only behind `w3_exterior`, staging-only, never prod until iOS-verified.

## Phased Roadmap — Sequencing the 28 Exterior Workstreams into Dependency-Ordered Waves

## Phased Roadmap — Le Sette Sorelle Exterior (W3)

Sequencing rationale: the compact table exposes three families of hard prerequisites that gate almost everything downstream — (1) a corrected **GLB integration seam** (`modelLoader` mkPhys/clone/disposal/shadow fixes + a DRACO pre-warm + a `renderer.info` draw-call overlay), (2) the **PBR material library + shared-atlas naming contract** every hero GLB UV-maps into, and (3) **owner/tooling gates** (generative tools DISABLED, `toktx` absent, `/concepts` unchosen). These are pulled to the front as Wave 0. Hero geometry (dome, drum-windows, capitals/stair/tympanum, balustrades, fountain) follows once the seam is proven. Landscape, cortile, statuary, and cinematic polish trail as lower-priority / owner-gated waves. Every wave ships behind `flag3d('w3_exterior')` (staging ON / prod OFF), never additive to draw calls, JPG-first (KTX2 deferred).

---

### Wave 0 — Foundation: seam, instrumentation, material library, budget gate
**Included:** WS16 (PBR material library), WS17 (texture-baking workflow), WS21 (GLB export + DRACO integration), WS20 (LOD strategy & budgets), WS28 (rollout harness), WS18-*slice-A* (env-map sun-disc fix, desktop HDRI swap, `mkPhys` aoMapIntensity default), WS25 (provenance/licensing ledger + build gate).

**Why first:** Every geometry WS in the table blocks on these. WS16/WS17 define the `MAT_*` naming contract and the ≤3–4 shared atlases (stone / terracotta / gold) that hero GLBs must UV-map into *before* export. WS21/WS28 land the non-negotiable seam fixes the audit flagged as hard bugs across nearly every WS: export `warmDracoDecoder()`/`preloadDraco()` (decoder is COLD on exterior — no bust GLB there), fix the `mkPhys(three, props)` **construct-not-patch** misuse, fix the `clone()`-shares-geometry/material **double-dispose corruption**, and add per-tier shadow control (`loadModel` hardcodes `castShadow=true`). WS20 adds the `renderer.info.render.{triangles,calls}` dev overlay and the step-0 refactor making hero procedural elements individually removable (they are baked into `mergeGeometries` today — without this, every GLB is additive and blows the iOS 80/150-call ceiling). WS25's license ledger + `check-asset-licenses.mjs` must be green before the first GLB is committed.

**Deliverables:**
- Corrected `w3AssetLoader.ts` wrapper (clone-safe materials, ownership manifest, never `clearModelCache()` at exterior unmount).
- `warmDracoDecoder()` export + mount-time pre-warm inside the 2500 ms warmup window.
- `renderer.info` perf overlay (tris + opaque draw calls vs iOS 750k / 80-call / 140 MB ceilings).
- 5 canon-precise PBR sets (`travertine`, `terracotta_coppo`, `gilt`, `plaster`, `serena`) shipped JPG-first to `public/textures/pbr/{set}/`; `MAT_*` naming ratified as the cross-WS contract.
- Step-0 refactor: dome/drum/balustrade/capital/fountain procedural elements exposed as individually-hideable named handles or `governorAuditionDone()` gate exported from `mobilePerf.ts`.
- `dome_shell.glb` end-to-end **pipeline canary** (Cycles GPU HIP bake → DRACO export → `KHR_draco_mesh_compression` header assert → load → mkPhys rebind → AO on UV0) proven through the MCP socket.
- License ledger + build gate seeded green from bust GLBs + Polyhaven sets.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Overlay reads; W3 flag toggled ON/OFF is a byte-identical no-op on prod (W2 fallback intact). Canary dome loads with correct palette under the `#FFB870` sun, AO samples UV0, zero governor demotion in first 15 s on desktop *and* a real iPhone 12/13 WKWebView. DRACO export header-asserts DRACO (not uncompressed, not meshopt).

**Staging→prod promotion:** Wave 0 does **not** promote to prod on its own (no user-visible change beyond flag-off no-op + the three WS18 slice-A code-only fixes, which may promote independently). Gate to Wave 1: canary green on device, overlay live, material contract signed off.

---

### Wave 1 — Hero crown: dome + drum-windows (the WP3 money shot)
**Included:** WS02 (hero dome + drum + gold lantern), WS06 (arched drum thermal-bay tile), WS01 (overall massing/silhouette — dome-shell + drum-ring replacement subset).

**Why here:** Highest single-asset ROI in the brief (dome smooth-hemisphere → segmented ogival ribbed shell; drum flat-sticker → deep arched thermal-bay instanced 12×). Both are visible at **every** waypoint and are the highest-value targets at the 7.5 s tympanum name-beat (WP3, d=118). Depends entirely on Wave 0's seam + terracotta/travertine atlases (mobile texture add ≈ 0). Ships on all tiers with a ≤4.8k-tri mobile LOD / ≤10k potato LOD.

**Deliverables:** `dome_w3.glb` (3 baked LODs: ribbed shell + drum bays + colonnaded lantern + bloom-lit gold finial), `drum_thermal_bay.glb` as a **curved 12× panel** wrapping the real round r=8.2 W2 drum (audit-corrected from the dead octagon target), procedural dome/drum primitives hidden via the Wave-0 named handles. Resolve the ochre `#A5674E` vs canon `#B0725A` regrade decision *before* final albedo bake.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Net draw-call delta ≤0 vs Wave-0 baseline on all three tiers (verified against the actual merge pass — do not trust the "−16 calls" claim). Dome+lantern hold silhouette from all waypoints at `lookAt y=21`. Mobile LOD ≤750k scene total; GLB decode+upload lands inside warmup, no steady-state >25 ms spikes across the 15 s window. Reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 render the GLB (awaited before compose), no pop-in.

**Staging→prod promotion:** 48 h staging soak with governor-demote telemetry clean; iPhone WKWebView 60 fps confirmed; bust GLBs still load (decoder canary); then `npx vercel --prod`. Flag stays ON staging / OFF prod until this gate passes.

### Wave 2 — Hero façade: entrance stair, tympanum, capitals, signage
**Included:** WS04 (monumental stair + gold tympanum + Corinthian capitals + acroteria + door arch), WS27 (Fraunces wing-signposts / carved substrates), WS05 (façade travertine + worn-plaster kit).

**Why here:** These own the WP3 most-read frame alongside the crown. Corinthian capitals are the most-read element at the tympanum beat; the extruded-outline tympanum lettering (never generative) drives the owner-name beat. WS27's carved stele/tympanum panel floats under the live Fraunces canvas name. WS05 upgrades the hoofdblok to worn limewash — but **must** clone the material (never repaint the shared `M.stone` ramp) and add a paintedPlaster 404 fallback. **Baluster GLB is DROPPED from first ship** in both WS04 and WS08 scope: procedural balusters are fused into the shared `gTrimR`/`gTrimM` merged draw call and cannot be removed without shattering it — deferred to Wave 6 pending the un-merge refactor.

**Owner inputs required before build:** exact owner-name string (casing/accents) for tympanum; bronze→gold acroteria + stele-color sign-offs.

**Deliverables:** `corinthian_capital.glb` (×6, desktop-only), `palmette_acroterion.glb` (×3), `door_arch_volute.glb`, `tympanum_frame.glb` + `entrance_stele.glb`, `facade_kit.glb` (quoins/string-courses, desktop-only pilasters) on cloned worn-intonaco material.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Desktop-only assets guarded by `!isMobileGPU()`; mobile/potato byte-identical to W2. Capital acanthus reads at d=118 (highest-risk scripted-bpy asset — visual sign-off required; generative fallback stays owner-gated). Net draw calls ≤0 desktop; +0 mobile. No z-fight against pre-branch crown cornices.

**Staging→prod promotion:** Same 48 h soak + device gate; visual review of the WP3 still specifically. Promote Wave 1+2 together as the "hero front" milestone.

### Wave 3 — Landscape hero read: cypress avenue, terrain basamento, roofline
**Included:** WS14 (cypress avenue + trees), WS15 (terrain: basamento + dry-stone walls + strada), WS10 (roofline: coppo trim-sheet + chimney/eave GLBs).

**Why here:** All P1/P2, all 100% scripted-bpy + Polyhaven (no generative dependency), all graft onto existing InstancedMesh/ShaderMaterial buckets. WS14 replaces the 4 canonical geometries feeding the verified W2 InstancedMesh path (mobile/potato get a single-draw-call billboard impostor). WS10 ships the always-on coppo trim-sheet as a **roof-only forked** PBR set (NOT in-place overwrite of `terracotta_tiles` — shared with interiors at `eraMaterials.ts:50`); drops the invalid `tower_cone_roof` GLB (dead code) and redundant dormer/ridge GLBs. WS15 mandates the Wave-0 shadow/mkPhys `loadModel` fix (already landed) and leaves terrain mesh + `getHeightAt()` untouched.

**Deliverables:** `cypress.glb` (3-LOD + olive hero + stone-pine impostor), `basamento_hero.glb` + tiled `dry_stone_wall_seg.glb` + `strada` meshes + 3 CC0 Polyhaven terrain sets, `chimney_pot.glb` (all tiers) + `eave_rafter_strip.glb` (desktop-only) + forked coppo trim-sheet.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Foliage total draw calls <70. Cypress unit-height/y-offset LOD contract verified (no floating/sinking). Terrain eager-texture budget re-checked against the 4-slot mobile cap with raw-JPG RGBA math (no KTX2 headroom assumed). Basamento awaited before reduced-motion WP1/WP3/WP5 compose.

**Staging→prod promotion:** Standard soak + device gate; verify combined GLB draw calls (Waves 1–3) stay under mobile 15 / desktop 30 GLB ceiling and total <150/frame.

### Wave 4 — Water + garden + arcades (secondary hero + discovery)
**Included:** WS12 (water features: fountains), WS07 (portico/loggia/arcades), WS13 (formal garden: buxus/urns/benches), WS08 (balustrades/urns/finials — non-baluster subset: urns + finials + coping).

**Why here:** P1 fidelity but lower dolly-frame weight than the front crown/façade. WS12's carved tazza replaces stacked-cylinder fountains (mascaron fidelity **demoted** — ships as scripted lathe tazza with placeholder boss; true mascaron is Wave 6 generative fast-follow). WS07 must re-baseline against the **real** per-wing arcade at L2088-2137 (~80+ mk() draw calls with 6 fluting stripes/col baked into `nor_gl`) — NOT the dead `isRenaissance` loggia the original plan targeted — and confirm peristyle in-frame status (CUT if off-camera). All must **reuse the single `travertine` set** (WS05/06/07/08/13 collision — mobile `maxEagerTextureSets=4`; coordinating agent ratifies before any ships). WS08 ships urns/finials/coping now; balusters still deferred (merge dependency).

**Deliverables:** `fountain_parterre.glb` + `fountain_courtyard.glb` (courtyard bound to runtime-resolved `fX,fZ`), `arcade_kit.glb` (Tuscan column/archivolt/capital/entablature + desktop coffered soffit), 6 garden GLBs (fountain 2-LOD, urn, bench, buxus ball+strip), `urn.glb`/`finial.glb`/`coping.glb` via InstancedMesh.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Single travertine atlas confirmed (no 4th set 404→black). Fountain net draw calls DOWN. Water surfaces stay procedural. Peristyle scope decision documented. Draw-call baseline re-measured on-device before staging.

**Staging→prod promotion:** Standard soak + device gate + combined-wave draw-call re-audit (this is the wave most at risk of the eager-texture-cap collision).

### Wave 5 — Cortile + lighting bake finish
**Included:** WS11 (cortile: paving + well/fountain), WS18-*slice-B* (per-GLB embedded UV0 AO, desktop-only UV1 lightmap atlases, gold-lantern emissive), WS22 (progressive streaming & loading UX), WS23 (mobile GPU / iOS fallback net).

**Why here:** WS11 is P3, **occluded at every money-shot waypoint** except the WP2 east skim (only the pozzo iron crane pays) — explicitly build AFTER all front heroes. Blocked on owner O1 (is Block E/broncourt solid or VOID?) and O2 (authoritative cortile extents/floor-Y). WS18 slice-B is HARD-blocked until Waves 1–4 hero GLBs exist with authored UVs — this is where their AO/lightmaps get baked and the gold lantern emissive (intensity 1.5–3.0) crosses the 0.85 bloom threshold. WS22/WS23 harden the streaming UX + the iOS hard-eject fallback net (requires `getEffectiveTier()`/governor getter export — a real `mobilePerf.ts` change).

**Deliverables:** `pozzo.glb` (octagonal well, gated on O1/O2 resolution), embedded UV0 AO on every Wave 1–4 hero GLB, desktop UV1 lightmap atlases, emissive-lit lantern, iOS tier-eject fallback wired to a real governor observer.

**Per-wave perf gate:** Baked AO carries mobile/potato contact shadow (SSAO desktop-only). Emissive reads only on lantern/gold. iOS eject net demotes GLBs on real mid-session governor demotion (App-Review safety). Cortile omitted entirely if O1 unresolved (no floating water plane).

**Staging→prod promotion:** Full-scene device soak; App-Review-safe eject verified on iPhone; then promote.

**Included:** WS26 (cinematic dolly choreography w/ new hero), WS19 (post-processing for cinematic — code-only grade), WS08-*baluster subset* (after `gTrimR` un-merge refactor), WS09 (statuary — figural, HARD-BLOCKED), plus figural fast-follows across WS12 (fountain mascaron), WS13 (lion-head spouts), WS04.

**Why last:** WS26/WS19 tune the 18 s dolly and per-beat DOF/vignette around the *finished* hero set (`postprocessing.ts` return-handle refactor is a shared prerequisite; DRACO decode deferred past the 2500 ms warmup so cinematic jank can't demote desktop→mobile). WS09 and all figural detail are **infeasible today** (feasible:false): Hunyuan3D **and** Rodin verified DISABLED — owner must tick both N-panel checkboxes, restart the MCP, **and confirm commercial-license tier**. The baluster GLB lands here only after the `gTrimR` un-merge refactor (else it shatters a merged draw call — a regression).

**Deliverables:** Per-beat cinematic grade + `exterior_w3` post preset (4-call-site sweep as one commit), scripted-BPY pedestals + placeholder figures shipped now as the seam exercise, generative herm/mascaron/statuary roster *only* after owner enablement + license, `baluster.glb` InstancedMesh post-refactor.

**Owner prerequisites (blocking this wave's figural scope):** enable Hunyuan3D + Rodin; confirm commercial license (Rodin must be Pro+, free = NC); commit `licenseProof` to `docs/licenses/`; confirm owner-name geometry decision (bake vs live TextGeometry overlay).

**Per-wave perf gate:** Statuary is purely additive under W2 (procedural boxes don't build) — enforced against the <150 mobile-DC ceiling via the dev-overlay self-disable. Cinematic decode deferred past warmup; no governor demotion during the DOF/bloom ramp. License build-gate green for every generative asset.

**Staging→prod promotion:** Final full-scene 60 fps device gate + 48 h soak + license ledger audit. Only after this may `flag3d('w3_exterior')` be retired (W2 stays as permanent fallback until iOS WKWebView QA signs off across all waves).

### Cross-wave gating summary

| Constraint | Effect on sequencing |
|---|---|
| `modelLoader` seam fixes (mkPhys/clone/dispose/shadow/pre-warm) | **Wave 0 hard prerequisite** for all GLB waves — audit-flagged as hard bugs, not risks |
| Draw-call `renderer.info` overlay + step-0 un-merge/removable-handles | **Wave 0** — until it lands, every GLB is additive and blows the iOS 80/150-call ceiling; "net ≤0 calls" is unfalsifiable |
| Shared travertine/terracotta/gold atlases + `MAT_*` naming (mobile `maxEagerTextureSets=4`) | **Wave 0 contract**; enforced tightest in **Wave 4** (WS05/06/07/08/13 collision) |
| `toktx` NOT installed → KTX2 fast-follow | **JPG-first every wave**; KTX2 is a post-ship PR, dropped as "mandatory" — v1 must hold 140 MB mobile with 1k JPG alone |
| Generative tools (Hunyuan3D/Rodin) DISABLED + commercial license | Defers **all figural** (WS09 + mascaron/spout/statuary detail) to owner-gated **Wave 6**; keep figural off first prod promotion |
| `/concepts` exterior concept unchosen (advice: Sette Sorelle) | Owner decision upstream of Wave 1 albedo/massing final bake |
| Governor window (WARMUP 2500 ms + SAMPLE 15000 ms = ~17.5 s audition) | Every wave: pre-warm DRACO, defer GLB `scene.add`/upload deterministically via `governorAuditionDone()` (NOT a hardcoded 15500 ms timer — that injects a spike into the live audition) |
| Baluster GLB (fused into `gTrimR` merge) | Dropped from Wave 2/4 first ship; lands in **Wave 6** only after the un-merge refactor |

**Total effort (table sums):** Wave 0 ≈ 57d, Wave 1 ≈ 17d, Wave 2 ≈ 12.5d, Wave 3 ≈ 16d, Wave 4 ≈ 23d, Wave 5 ≈ 23d, Wave 6 ≈ 46d (heavily owner-gated / parallelizable). Waves 1–2 (front-hero crown + façade) deliver the largest perceived-quality lift and should be the first prod-promotion milestone; Waves 3–5 are additive fidelity; Wave 6 is polish + owner-unblocked statuary.

## Risk, Budget & Rollout — Le Sette Sorelle W3 Exterior

## Risk, Budget & Rollout

This section governs how the W3 Blender-authored exterior kit reaches users. It is the safety envelope for the whole program: every asset workstream (WS01–WS28) ships **through** this harness, not around it. The controlling principle is unchanged from the W1/W2 waves — **staging-only until owner sign-off, prod OFF by default, one flag to kill everything**.

---

### 0. Non-negotiables (read first)

- **Gate:** all new asset code sits behind `flag3d('w3_exterior')`, read **once** at scene mount. `W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior')`. Verified in `src/lib/3d/flags3d.ts`: `flag3d()` returns `false` on `thememorypalace.ai` / `www.thememorypalace.ai` and `true` everywhere else — so **staging is ON and prod is OFF automatically**, no env var, no build step. This is the master kill-switch.
- **Deploy path:** `npx vercel --prod` (Git integration is broken — CLI only, per `reference_vercel_deploy.md`).
- **Promotion rule:** W3 is **not promoted to prod** — and the `w3_exterior` flag is **not retired** — until the full device checklist (§6) passes on real iOS WKWebView AND the owner signs off. No flag retirement while W2 itself is still staging-only.
- **iOS seal:** the free-tier / App-Review seal must remain intact. A visual/perf overhaul must never introduce a paid surface, a second WebGL context, or an App-Review-breaking regression. W3 is additive fidelity only.

---

### 1. Risk Register

Severity = (likelihood × blast-radius). **Blast-radius weighted to iOS WKWebView**, the binding target (it collapses to the mobile tier; the adaptive governor demotes *presets*, not meshes, so mobile geometry = potato geometry).

| # | Risk | Sev | Trigger / root cause | Mitigation | Kill-switch |
|---|------|-----|----------------------|------------|-------------|
| **R1** | **Draw-call regression on mobile** — GLBs land *additive* instead of *replacing* procedural geometry, breaching the live 150-call mobile budget | **Critical** | Audits proved multiple "REPLACE nets ≤0" claims false: dome ribs are **already merged** (`ExteriorScene.tsx:1845`); balusters/capitals/portico fluting are fused into shared merged BufferGeometry (`gTrimR` L643, terrace merge L565) and are **not individually removable**. Hiding a merged element frees **zero** draw calls; adding a GLB is net **+N**. | (a) Mandatory **step-0 refactor**: split hero elements out of the merge into named, individually-hideable handles *before* any GLB ships. (b) Ship a `renderer.info.render.calls` **dev overlay** and assert net-delta ≤0 **per tier** on-device before staging. (c) InstancedMesh + merge-per-material for every repeat (baluster, urn, cypress, tower); never export 9 towers. | `flag3d('w3_exterior')` off ⇒ 100% procedural W2. |
| **R2** | **GPU-memory / TTI regression** — texture + geometry upload pushes past the ~140 MB iOS WKWebView ceiling → silent jetsam context loss | **Critical** | `toktx` **not installed** (verified) → KTX2 fast-follow can't run → mobile ships raw 1k JPG/WEBP decoding to full RGBA in VRAM (~4 MB/atlas). Mobile texture budget is **additive** on top of existing procedural + bust + env sets. | (a) Hard cap **≤4 unique PBR sets on mobile** (`getQuality().maxEagerTextureSets`); **share atlases aggressively** across WS05/06/07/08/13 (one travertine set, one terracotta, one gold). (b) **≤2 decorative GLBs on mobile** (hero fountain + 1 urn); potato = **0** decorative GLBs, dome-only ≤10k, no shadows, no env map. (c) Over-the-wire hero payload **≤8–10 MB**; DRACO mandatory (level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12), **≤500 KB/asset**. (d) Measure **GPU-resident bytes on-device** before promote — do not trust paper math. | Same flag; §5 tier ceilings. |
| **R3** | **Adaptive-governor spurious demotion** — GLB decode + GPU upload spikes >20% of frames past 25 ms in the sample window → device demoted one tier for **7 days** | **High** | Verified `GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500`, `GOV_SAMPLE_MS=15000` (`mobilePerf.ts:239-240`). The 18 s cinematic dolly + DOF/bloom ramp plays **inside** the audition window. Several plans mis-stated the timing (a "15500 ms defer" injects a spike into the **last ~2 s of the live audition** — the exact self-inflicted regression). | (a) **Pre-warm the DRACO decoder** at mount (exterior loads zero GLBs today → decoder is **cold**; needs a `preloadDraco()`/`warmDracoDecoder()` export added to `modelLoader.ts`). (b) **Stagger GPU uploads**; upload during the pre-dolly veil, not one frame. (c) Gate mobile `scene.add()` on a real `governorAuditionDone()` signal (armed on first `getQuality()`, resolves at the true end of warmup+sample), **never a magic `setTimeout`**. (d) Author the mobile dome LOD ≤10k so steady-state cost is negligible. | Flag off; and a per-device localStorage demote-count beacon so a bad soak auto-halts promotion. |
| **R4** | **iOS App-Review seal broken** — a visual regression, dead-button, or accidental paid surface fails re-review | **Critical** | History (multiple 2.1a/3.1.1 rejections) shows regressions surface at review even when code is correct — usually **un-deployed / stale prod**. A W3 crash-on-load or context-loss on an Apple test device is a hard reject. | (a) W3 is **prod-OFF by default** — Apple always tests the sealed procedural build unless the owner explicitly promotes. (b) **Two bust GLBs stay as the decoder canary** — never dispose their masters; **never call `clearModelCache()` at exterior unmount** (shared with bust builder — verified `modelLoader.ts:50`). (c) **Never open a 2nd WebGL context** — use the pooled/local scene renderer only (iOS jetsam kills a 2nd context silently). (d) Reduced-motion + i18n preserved; hero assets must be correct at the three reduced-motion stills (WP1/WP3/WP5). | Flag off ⇒ byte-identical sealed W2 build. |
| **R5** | **Licensing exposure (paid app)** — a non-CC0 / NC / ND asset ships in a commercial product | **High** | Generative routes (Hunyuan3D / Rodin) are **both DISABLED** and license-tier-gated; Sketchfab is per-model NC/ND-risky; Rodin free tier = NC. | (a) **v1 hero kit is 100% scripted-BPY** (dome, drum-bay, capital, baluster, fountain, tympanum, lantern) + **CC0-only** Polyhaven textures/HDRI — zero license risk. (b) **Skip Sketchfab** for a paid app. (c) A `WS25` **license ledger + `check-asset-licenses.mjs` build gate** must land green (seeded from bust GLBs + existing Polyhaven sets) **before the first exterior GLB is committed**. (b) Generative used **only** for organic/figural (statuary, mascaron, herm) as a **deferred phase**, behind a decimate + re-measure gate. (c) Every generative import is **re-baked to the shared atlas + re-UV'd to UV0 + `mkPhys` rebuilt** before it can ship — no raw generative material reaches the runtime. (d) Human visual review at WP1/WP3/WP5 before staging. | Capital ships scripted; figural phase is independently flag-able and cuttable. |
| **R7** | **Material contract silently wrong** — GLB renders with GLTFLoader defaults: not mobile-stripped, AO on wrong UV channel, shadows forced on potato | **High** | Verified: `loadModel()` sets only `castShadow/receiveShadow=true`, **never** calls `mkPhys`, **never** sets `aoMap.channel`. `mkPhys(three, props)` **constructs** a material from a props object — it does **not** mutate a live material in place (multiple plans mis-used it as `mkPhys(THREE, mesh.material)`, a no-op). `.clone()` **shares** materials/geometry with the cached master. | (a) A **corrected post-load pass**: build a *fresh* material from the shared PBR set per loaded mesh (not `mkPhys(THREE, liveMaterial)`), set `aoMap.channel=0` to match the hardcoded contract, apply per-tier shadow flags. (b) **Clone the material before mutating** so the cached master isn't poisoned across SPA re-mounts. (c) Bake AO into `ao` on **UV0**, normals OpenGL convention, at exposure **1.0** to match the single `NeutralToneMapping` exposure 1.15 grade and the one sun (`#FFB870` @ `[-20,18,-30]`). | Flag off; and a dev-overlay palette check at the three stills. |
| **R8** | **Blender pipeline fails silently** — DRACO export produces an **uncompressed** GLB (blows the 500 KB wire budget) or Cycles bakes on **CPU** (AO/normals wrong or absent) | **Medium** | `libdraco` presence unverified over the MCP socket; Cycles `compute_device_type` defaults to `NONE`/resets on restart (HIP Radeon 890M not auto-selected); bakes can time out over the socket. | (a) **Probe before authoring:** 1-tri test bake asserts non-blank pixels; 1-tri test GLB asserts `KHR_draco_mesh_compression` in `extensionsUsed` and header magic `0x46546C67`. (b) Re-assert `compute_device_type='HIP'` + `scene.cycles.device='GPU'` in **every** script (non-persistent). (c) **meshopt is forbidden** — no `MeshoptDecoder` is registered (silent decode failure). | Broken export never reaches `public/models/exterior/`; header-assert at export time. |
| **R9** | **TTI regression** — cold decoder + main-thread glTF parse + texture upload delays first paint / the 18 s establishing dolly | **Medium** | Only DRACO **geometry decode** runs off-thread; scene-graph build, material creation, and GPU texture upload run on the **main thread** in the resolve callback. iOS WKWebView **lacks `requestIdleCallback`** (falls back to `setTimeout`). | (a) Load W3 **async after** the synchronous procedural pass, in `try/catch`, fall back to procedural on reject — the dolly is always served by procedural first. (b) Pre-warm decoder; stagger uploads across frames. (c) **Await** hero assets before composing the reduced-motion stills (WP1/WP3/WP5) or explicitly accept the procedural fallback for those frames. | Flag off ⇒ zero GLB load, zero TTI delta. |

---

### 2. Kill-switches (layered)

1. **Master:** `flag3d('w3_exterior')` — prod-OFF automatically (host allow-list). One condition disables the entire kit; procedural W2 is the permanent, always-present fallback.
2. **Per-asset `try/catch`:** every `loadModel()` resolves into a guarded block; any reject/throw silently keeps the procedural equivalent. No single asset can take down the scene.
3. **Sub-flags** where a workstream ships in parts (e.g. `w3_intonaco`, `w3_facade_kit`) so a suspect sub-feature can be cut without pulling the wave.
4. **Governor auto-eject (target):** if a mid-session demotion is observed, eject decorative GLBs for that session — requires `mobilePerf.ts` to expose an effective-tier getter/event (does not exist today; a prerequisite for the mobile safety net).
5. **Figural phase gate:** generative/statuary GLBs are independently flag-able and stay off the first prod promotion regardless of the master flag.

---

### 3. Whole-scene budget ceilings

Binding target = **iOS / WKWebView**. The governor demotes presets not meshes, so **the single mobile LOD must also read as potato**.

| Tier | Tris (total) | Opaque draw calls | Texture mem | Decorative GLBs | Shadows / env |
|------|--------------|-------------------|-------------|-----------------|---------------|
| **Desktop** | ≤3.0 M | ≤180 | ≤512 MB | full set (≤30 GLB calls) | full |
| **Mid-mobile** | ≤900 k | **≤150 total/frame** (`perfAssert.ts` hard budget) | ≤180 MB | **≤2** (hero fountain + 1 urn) | reduced |
| **iOS (QA gate)** | **≤750 k** / **≤140 MB tex** — same assets as mobile, stricter QA | ≤150/frame | ≤140 MB | ≤2 | reduced |
| **Potato** | dome-only ≤10 k | minimal | minimal | **0** | **none** — must read on baked AO alone |

**Per-asset:** DRACO mandatory; ≤500 KB/asset; total hero payload ≤8–10 MB over the wire. **≤3–4 unique PBR sets on mobile** (eager cap), **≤2 on potato** — share atlases across all decorative workstreams or one set 404s to black.

> ⚠️ **Correction baked in:** the mobile hard budget in code is **150 draw calls/frame** (`perfAssert.ts:21`), *not* the 80 several plans quoted. The exterior already sits near this — GLBs must **replace or instance**, never accrete. The `≤80` figure is a self-imposed *authoring headroom* target, not the enforced ceiling.

---

### 4. Device Verification Checklist (blocks promotion)

Run on **real hardware**, not simulators. Promotion to prod requires every box green.

**Instrumentation prerequisite:** ship the `renderer.info.render.triangles / .calls` **dev overlay** *first* — draw-call baseline for W2 is currently **unmeasured**; every "net ≤0" claim is unfalsifiable until this exists.

- [ ] **Draw-call baseline captured** for W2 (flag off) per tier — then W3 net-delta measured and asserted **≤0** per tier.
- [ ] **iOS WKWebView (iPhone 12/13-class, Capacitor build):** sustained **~60 fps** through the full 18 s dolly; no jank spike >25 ms during the governor window; **no 7-day demotion** persisted after a cold launch.
- [ ] **GPU-resident bytes** on-device < 140 MB (measure, don't calculate) — no jetsam / context-loss.
- [ ] **Mid-Android mobile GPU:** ~60 fps; ≤2 decorative GLBs; texture sets ≤4.
- [ ] **Potato tier:** dome-only, no shadows, no env map, reads correctly on baked AO; 0 decorative GLBs.
- [ ] **Desktop:** full decorative set; within 180-call / 512 MB ceilings.
- [ ] **Decoder canary:** `bust_base.glb` + `bust_female.glb` still load (DRACO decoder healthy; masters not disposed).
- [ ] **Fallback proof:** force-reject a GLB load → procedural equivalent renders, no double-geometry, no z-fight, no gap.
- [ ] **Reduced-motion:** stills compose correctly at **WP1 / WP3 / WP5** with hero assets present (or accepted procedural fallback).
- [ ] **Palette/lighting match:** GLBs sit against procedural neighbours with no albedo/AO clash (single sun `#FFB870` @ `[-20,18,-30]`, one exposure 1.15 grade; the ochre-`#A5674E`-vs-`#B0725A` dome regrade decision is **resolved by owner** before final bake).
- [ ] **i18n:** any new UI strings translated across all 5 locales.
- [ ] **License gate green:** `check-asset-licenses.mjs` passes; no NC/ND/uncleared asset committed.
- [ ] **Header asserts:** every shipped GLB validated (`KHR_draco_mesh_compression` present, magic/version correct, no meshopt).

---

### 5. Rollout Sequence

1. **Instrument** (dev overlay) + **capture W2 baseline** + land **license ledger gate**. No assets yet.
2. **Step-0 refactor:** split hero procedural elements out of the merges into named, hideable handles; add `preloadDraco()`/`warmDracoDecoder()` + a corrected post-load material pass to `modelLoader.ts` (fresh material from PBR set, `aoMap.channel=0`, per-tier shadows, clone-before-mutate). **These are hard prerequisites** — without them every GLB is additive and the material contract is silently wrong.
3. **Canary asset:** ship **one** end-to-end DRACO GLB (dome shell) behind `w3_exterior`, prove the whole pipeline (bake → export → load → replace → net-≤0) on-device before scaling out.
4. **Hero kit** (scripted-BPY, highest perceived-quality ROI, in order): segmented ogival **dome + ribs** → arched **drum thermal-bay** (instanced 12×) → **Corinthian capital** → **baluster** run → carved **fountain tazza** → **tympanum + gold lantern**.
5. **Secondary kit:** facade quoins/string-courses, portico arcade, urns/finials, roofline coppo trim-sheet, cypress/foliage LODs, terrain basamento.
6. **KTX2 fast-follow** *after* `toktx` is installed — JPG/WEBP ships first with per-file fallback; KTX2 is **not** a v1 dependency.
7. **Figural phase (deferred):** only after owner enables generative tools **and** confirms commercial license — statuary, mascaron, herms — independently flagged, off the first promotion.
8. **Soak on staging** (48 h min, demote-beacon clean) → **owner sign-off** → `npx vercel --prod` → re-run device checklist on prod → only then consider flag retirement (not before W2 itself is prod-promoted).

**Staging-only until owner sign-off. Prod stays sealed (procedural W2) the entire time W3 is in staging.**

---

## Appendix A — Current-State + Budgets Brief

```
Le Sette Sorelle Exterior — Current-State + Budgets Brief (for all downstream design agents)

INTEGRATION SEAM (solved, additive-only)
- The exterior (src/components/3d/ExteriorScene.tsx, ~4944 lines) is 100% procedural BufferGeometry, merged into ~18 static draw calls under W2. Zero GLB loads today.
- GLB path is production-proven: modelLoader.ts (GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader, decoder at /public/draco/, already warm from bust GLBs). loadModel(path) → cached THREE.Group, returns clone(), auto castShadow/receiveShadow. Drop files in public/models/exterior/.
- Insert loads ASYNC inside the scene useEffect after the synchronous geometry pass, wrapped in try/catch (fall back to procedural on reject). Dispose via clearModelCache() at unmount only — never dispose clones. Use the pooled renderer (rendererPool.ts); NEVER open a 2nd WebGL context (iOS jetsam kills it silently).
- Re-apply mkPhys() to every loaded material (GLTFLoader bypasses it). Author standard PBR only (BaseColor/Metallic/Roughness/Normal) — clearcoat/sheen/transmission are stripped on mobile.

FLAG GATING (non-negotiable)
- Gate all new asset code behind a fresh flag, e.g. flag3d('w3_exterior') (read once at mount). Staging ON / prod OFF automatically. W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'). No flag retirement until prod+iOS verified.

PER-DEVICE BUDGETS (self-imposed; codebase has no hard tri cap)
- Desktop: ≤~150–200k tris total across all exterior GLBs; ≤30 GLB draw calls; 1k textures; full decorative set.
- Mobile (iOS WKWebView): ≤60k tris on mobile LOD; ≤15 GLB draw calls; max 2 decorative GLBs (hero fountain + 1 urn); ≤1MB compressed / ≤8MB GPU; DRACO mandatory; ≤500KB per asset.
- Potato: 0 decorative GLBs; dome only at ultra-low LOD (≤10k). Must read with NO shadows, NO env map.
- Hard ceilings: mobile draw-call budget 150/frame TOTAL (exterior already near it — GLBs must REPLACE procedural geometry, be merged-per-material or instanced, never additive). ~150–200MB GPU-resident WKWebView ceiling. Adaptive governor demotes a device one tier for 7 days if >20% frames miss 25ms in the first 15s — over-budget assets must profile clean during warmup, not after settle. Instance repeats (balusters, urns, farm buildings); merge uniques (dome, fountain) in Blender before export.

LIGHTING / BAKE REQUIREMENTS (match or the GLB clashes)
- One sun: DirectionalLight #FFB870, position [-20,18,-30] (SW, ~28° elevation, azimuth ~213°). Match Blender sun lamp exactly for any baked AO/shadow.
- One grade: NeutralToneMapping, exposure 1.15, applied once. Bake at exposure 1.0. Never add per-asset exposure.
- Bake AO into GLB ao channel on UV0 (aoMap.channel=0 is hardcoded; SSAO is desktop-only, so baked AO carries mobile/potato). Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default).
- Env is procedural PMREM on mobile (sky #4D7FCC / horizon #FFB870 / ground #263314 / SW sun disc) — don't rely on real-HDRI IBL for readability. Emissive needs intensity 1.5–3.0 to cross the 0.85 bloom threshold (lantern/gold only).
- Palette canon (albedo targets, no deviation): PLASTER #F2E9DA, TRAVERTINE #E8DCC0/#E3D6BC, coppo-terracotta #B0725A (mat), INK #403B36, GOLD #B8973A (lantern + tympanum ONLY), EMBER #B85C38 (interactive only). Non-photo assets stay ≤0.6 relative luminance (memories are the brightest pixels).
- PBR texture contract: {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_{res}.jpg in /textures/pbr/{name}/; ship 1k first (all tiers 404→1k fallback). Share sets aggressively — ≤3–4 unique PBR materials total (mobile eager cap = 4).

TOP FIDELITY GAPS (ranked by perceived-quality return at the dolly beats)
1. Dome shell is a smooth hemisphere — needs 8-panel segmented ogival shell with proud modeled ribs + travertine webs (highest single-asset ROI; visible at every waypoint; ship on all tiers with a low-poly mobile/potato LOD).
2. Drum windows are flat box stickers — need one arched thermal-bay tile (deep reveal + volute keystone + blind niches) instanced 12×.
3. Corinthian capitals are box tops on cylinders — need real acanthus/caulicoli capital GLB (most-read element at the 7.5s tympanum beat, d=118).
4. Balustrades are tapered cylinder rows — need lathe-profile baluster (torus/vase/plinth) as InstancedMesh.
5. Fountain is stacked cylinders + sphere bumps — need carved tazza with mascaron/fluting.
6–10 (lower priority): flat roof-tile relief (individual coppo strip for front slopes/drum); ivy flat cards (baked per-leaf normals); chamfered stone cross-mullions; campanile clock face (Roman numerals/bezel/gilt hands); missing landscape cascine (2–3 low-poly stone farmhouses at r=120–180, instanced). Foliage gaps (cross-quad grass cards, real cypress silhouette/billboard impostors, curved wheat stalk, buxus balls, rock scatter, poppy/lavender billboards) slot into existing InstancedMesh + ShaderMaterial buckets — keep total foliage draw calls <70.

CRITICAL VIEWING ANGLES: Front (−Z, x=0) is primary — must read best dead-on at 6°–30° elevation (WP1/WP3/WP4/WP5/end). Dome+lantern must hold silhouette from ALL waypoints (lookAt raised to y=21). East galleria face only briefly visible at WP2 (~+72X). Tympanum name-beat at WP3 (d=118) is the single most-read frame — dome drum windows + entrance columns are the highest-value targets there. Reduced-motion path composes stills at WP1/WP3/WP5, so every hero asset must be correct at exactly those three angles.

Key files: src/components/3d/ExteriorScene.tsx (seam + W2 block), src/lib/3d/modelLoader.ts (loadModel), src/lib/3d/flags3d.ts (gate), src/lib/3d/mobilePerf.ts (getQuality/isMobileGPU/mkPhys), src/lib/3d/canon.ts (palette/sun/exposure), src/lib/3d/assetLoader.ts (PBR contract), public/concepts/moodboard.html (Le Sette Sorelle spec).
```

## Appendix B — Blender MCP Routing Doctrine

```
Blender MCP Routing Doctrine — Exterior Villa (W2), gated behind `flag3d('w2_exterior')`

ROUTING BY ASSET CLASS
- Balustrades, urns, finials, column shafts, fountain bowls, gold lantern: SCRIPTED BPY (lathe/SCREW from a swappable profile array). Deterministic, tiny (~450–670 tris/piece), instanceable. Winner.
- Cornices, string-courses, architraves, window surrounds: SCRIPTED BPY (curve profile swept along path; or boolean+bevel box). Exact Renaissance mitres. Winner.
- Arcades/loggias, mullions/tracery: SCRIPTED BPY (one bay → ARRAY; boolean grid + SOLIDIFY). Winner.
- Terracotta roofs (hero dome + casa-torri): SCRIPTED BPY (one coppo tile → geometry-nodes instance-on-points with rot/scale jitter → bake to one mesh). Biggest perceived-quality jump. Winner.
- Dome drum + lantern: SCRIPTED BPY (lathe shell + geo-node ring of windows/pilasters). Winner.
- Monumental stair + gold TYMPANUM lettering: SCRIPTED BPY (ARRAY treads; text as extruded curve outline — never generative). Winner; generators mangle text.
- Casa-torri / gate-tower corps ("un corpo unico"): SCRIPTED BPY blockout to masterplan spec; no off-the-shelf fit.
- Statuary, herms, mascarons, figural fountain groups, coats-of-arms relief: GENERATIVE image→3D. Primary HUNYUAN3D (strong single-image organic reconstruction, cheaper/less-gated); RODIN as alternate (native GLB, cleaner topology) for hero center-frame figures via multi-image. Both currently DISABLED — owner must tick N-panel checkboxes + restart; confirm commercial-license tier.
- SKETCHFAB: skip (disabled + per-model NC/ND license risk for a paid app). Only if owner enables + API key, use for museum-scan hero statuary under CC0/CC-BY only, with CREDITS attribution.
- POLYHAVEN: CC0 texture + HDRI backbone only (never villa geometry). Terracotta (ceramic_roof_01/clay_roof_tiles_02), worn plaster (beige_wall_001 + weathered), cobblestone (cobblestone_large_01). One warm golden-hour PURE-SKY HDRI (belfast_sunset_puresky) for the 18s dolly, downscaled for mobile. Travertine/marble/granite: author PROCEDURAL (noise+voronoi veining, GOLD/TRAVERTINE canon) and bake — no matching scan exists.

BAKE + EXPORT WORKFLOW (per asset)
1. Author hi-poly (bpy sculpt / generator base) + low-poly game mesh.
2. UV low-poly: smart_project(island_margin≈0.02), UV channel 0 ONLY (assetLoader forces aoMap.channel=0).
3. Bake on Cycles GPU (HIP): NORMAL + AO + ROUGHNESS + curvature (POSITION/Pointiness), selected-to-active with cage. Trim-sheet/atlas the modular kit → ≤5 material-sets for the hero building.
4. Save JPGs as `public/textures/pbr/<set>/<prefix>_<kind>_<res>.jpg` (kinds diff|nor_gl|rough|ao; res 512|1k|2k) → plugs into loadPBRSet with zero loader changes; add one thin loader wrapper per set.
5. Export DRACO GLB (probe-validated): level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12; export_apply, export_yup, WEBP textures embedded → `public/models/exterior/<name>.glb`. NO runtime change needed. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail).
6. Assert GLB header at export (magic 0x46546C67, v2, extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression).
7. Fast-follow: `npm run build:ktx2` (needs toktx) → .ktx2 + manifest; KTX2 activates via manifest feature-detect with per-file JPG fallback. Wire `loader.setKTX2Loader` for GLB-embedded KTX2 (one line + renderer handle). Ship JPG/WEBP first, compress after.

INSTANCING: author ONE master GLB per repeated element (tower, urn, baluster, statue, cypress, buxus); place via InstancedMesh with per-instance matrix + scale/rot jitter for "grown-over-centuries" asymmetry. Never export 9 towers. mergeGeometries per material on static masonry. Distance-LOD for the dolly (wide frames = low LOD).

WHOLE-SCENE BUDGET CEILINGS (binding target = iOS/WKWebView; iOS collapses to "mobile" tier; governor demotes presets NOT meshes, so mobile geometry = potato geometry)
- Desktop: 3.0M tris / 180 draw calls / 512 MB tex.
- Mid-mobile: 900k tris / 80 opaque calls / 180 MB tex.
- iOS (binding): 750k tris / 80 calls / 140 MB tex — same assets, QA gate. Author the single mobile LOD ≤750k.
Levers: draw calls (InstancedMesh + merge) are the #1 mobile killer, not tri count. KTX2 atlases mandatory (2–3 shared: stone / terracotta / metal); never ship raw PNG albedo (one 2k RGBA = 16 MB). Total over-the-wire hero payload ≤8–10 MB.

VALIDATION: gate `flag3d('w2_exterior')` (staging ON / prod OFF); dev overlay asserting `renderer.info.render.triangles/calls` vs ceilings; two bust GLBs as decoder canary; verify ~60fps inside iOS WKWebView before `npx vercel --prod`.
```

## Appendix C — Workstream Specs (28)

### WS01 — Overall massing & silhouette

*The "un corpo unico" grown-over-centuries corps — proportions, asymmetry, hilltop siting, and how the whole reads at the 18s dolly framing.*

**Summary:** W3 exterior fidelity: surgically REPLACE the smooth procedural dome shell + 12-sticker drum-window ring with two DRACO GLBs (segmented ogival dome with proud ribs + one instanced arched thermal-bay tile with emissive glass), ADD desktop-only acanthus capitals and carved fountain tazza; all scripted-bpy, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), reusing already-loaded terracotta/travertine PBR sets so mobile texture add is ~0.
**Priority `P1` · ~6d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.82**

**Vision.** Do NOT replace the whole massing. The verified codebase (ExteriorScene.tsx: rDomeR=8.0, rDrumR=8.2, rDrumH=11.0, drumBaseY=vH+5.5, HILL_Y=8, palace.position.y=HILL_Y+0.3) shows the procedural "un corpo unico" silhouette, casa-torri, poorttorens, galleria, stair and tympanum already produce the correct grown-over-centuries shape. What reads "procedural" is surface detail on the elements the cinematic camera dwells on: a smooth hemisphere dome, flat sticker drum windows, box-top capitals, cylinder balusters, stacked-cylinder fountain. So the winning strategy is the HYBRID (brief 3) as the spine, grafting the ogival-dome authoring rigor of brief 1 and the perf-discipline (REPLACE-not-ADD, LOD-in-one-GLB, governor-warmup compliance) of brief 2. Reject the full-massing-GLB approach (briefs 1 & 2 core) as high-risk: it puts the working "un corpo unico" silhouette + the five sectionGroups click/hover contract + z-fight-swept crossing attic all at risk of regression for near-zero perceived-quality gain over the procedural massing that already works. Instead we surgically REPLACE only the dome+drum block and ADD instanced decorative kit, each piece gated behind a fresh flag3d('w3_exterior') (verified: flags3d.ts returns true on staging, false on the two PROD_HOSTS automatically, no code change needed), loaded async after the synchronous geometry pass via the proven loadModel() path (modelLoader.ts: GLTFLoader+DRACOLoader warm from bust GLBs, returns a cached clone with castShadow/receiveShadow set but NOT mkPhys). Every hero asset must be correct dead-on front (−Z) at WP1/WP3/WP5 because the reduced-motion path composes stills at exactly those angles; the tympanum name-beat at WP3 (d=118) is the single most-read frame, making the dome drum-window ring + entrance capitals the highest-value targets. All authoring is scripted bpy (lathe/SCREW/ARRAY/boolean) — zero generative AI for this workstream (pure architecture/profiles; generators mangle text and topology). Ship JPG/WEBP-embedded DRACO first; KTX2 is a fast-follow behind manifest feature-detect. The 1000x perceived jump comes from: (a) an 8-panel segmented ogival dome shell with proud modeled ribs replacing the hemisphere, (b) a 12x arched thermal-bay drum ring with deep reveals + volute keystones + emissive glass that reads as a glowing golden band at WP3, (c) real acanthus Corinthian capitals on the portico/pilaster tops, (d) lathe balusters + carved fountain tazza as instanced desktop enhancements. Mobile gets low-LOD dome + 8-bay ring only; potato stays 100% procedural (the existing, correct fallback).

**Design decisions:**
- SPINE = HYBRID (brief 3): keep every working procedural system (massing silhouette, casa-torri, poorttorens, galleria, monumental stair, tympanum lettering, terrain, sky, cypresses, parterres, foliage InstancedMeshes). REPLACE only the rDome/rDrum block; ADD instanced decorative kit. This is the max perceived-quality-per-byte and per-regression-risk choice.
- REJECT full-massing-GLB (brief 1 & 2 cores): replacing the entire corps risks the 'un corpo unico' silhouette, the five sectionGroups click/hover+walkthrough anchors, and the z-fight-swept crossing attic — for negligible gain over massing that already reads correct. Not worth the App-Review-seal risk on a paid iOS app.
- GRAFT from brief 1: the rigorous 8-panel ogival SCREW-profile dome authoring (hi-poly bake source → retopo'd low-poly game mesh, proud meridional ribs, ogival meridian not smooth cap) and the JSON-spec-table discipline so world coordinates are tuned without re-bake.
- GRAFT from brief 2: REPLACE-not-ADD dogma (wrap the procedural dome/drum blocks in `if(!W3){...}` so GLBs are never additive to the draw-call budget), LOD-in-one-GLB (_LOD0/_LOD1 named meshes, runtime pick by isMobileGPU()), and GOVERNOR-WARMUP compliance (start loadModel() FIRST in the useEffect so the 2.5s warmup samples the settled scene; add meshes in a rAF callback to avoid a heavy frame spike; hide-then-show one rAF tick to avoid a blank flash).
- FLAG: W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), read ONCE at mount. Verified flags3d.ts auto-returns staging-ON/prod-OFF with no new entry required. No flag retirement until prod+iOS verified.
- TIER MATRIX: Desktop = dome_hero _LOD0 + full 12-bay drum ring + capitals x20 (InstancedMesh) + balusters x~88 (InstancedMesh) + fountain tazza. Potato = ZERO GLBs, 100% procedural (existing correct fallback, no code added to potato path).
- MATERIALS: reuse existing loaded PBR sets — dome uses roofTileTex (loadTerracottaTileTextures, verified line 281) so ZERO new texture files for the dome; drum bays + balusters + capitals + fountain share the plaster/travertine sets already loaded. Author albedo to canon (#A5674E dome matching W2 domeMat, #E8DCC0 travertine trim). Keep mobile eager texture sets ≤4 (verified MOBILE maxEagerTextureSets=4). **Dependencies:** modelLoader.ts loadModel (GLTFLoader+DRACOLoader, /draco/ decoder) - proven path, warm from bust GLBs; NO modelLoader change needed (LOD prune happens in the seam)., flags3d.ts flag3d('w3_exterior') - auto staging-ON/prod-OFF, no new entry., mobilePerf.ts: isMobileGPU() (LOD + tier gating), mkPhys(THREE, props) (mandatory material rebuild), getQuality() maxEagerTextureSets (mobile=4, must not exceed), GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500 governor., assetLoader.ts loadTerracottaTileTextures (roofTileTex, dome reuse) + loadPlasterWallTextures (drum/capital/fountain reuse); aoMap.channel=0 hardcoded; PBR contract {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_{res}.jpg., canon.ts GOLDEN.sunPosition [-20,18,-30] (bake sun match), NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 (bake at 1.0), palette canon., rendererPool.ts pooled renderer (never 2nd WebGL context)., toktx NOT installed - blocks npm run build:ktx2; KTX2 is optional fast-follow, not a v1 dependency., Hunyuan3D/Rodin currently DISABLED - only a fallback dependency for the acanthus capital; owner must enable N-panel + confirm commercial license if scripted-bpy capital under-delivers., No cross-workstream blocking dependency: WS01 is pure architecture (no statuary/figural). Figural statuary is a separate future workstream.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: low
- iOS risk: low
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: loadModel returns a full-scene clone with no named-mesh selection API — LOD-in-one-GLB requires explicit traverse-select-and-prune in the seam or both LODs ship

- Fix: Specify LOD selection: loadModel() clones the ENTIRE gltf.scene, not a named mesh (modelLoader.ts:36 returns model.clone()). The _LOD0/_LOD1-in-one-GLB scheme must traverse the returned group, keep only the mesh matching isMobileGPU()?'_LOD1':'_LOD0', and REMOVE the other LOD mesh from the clone. If unspecified, both LODs render on every device (double tris + coplanar z-fight). Fix in the integration seam, not modelLoader.

Author emissive-only glass for drum bays (NOT M.win's transmission/ior, line 368) so mkPhys keeps it MeshStandard on mobile.
- Fix: Drop or de-scope the baluster GLB for v1: the only balustrade loop in ExteriorScene.tsx (2200-2214) is a per-tower 6-cylinder decorative run on tower faces, NOT a front-parapet/stair run of ~88 or ~340. The claim 'REPLACE the procedural cylinder baluster loop under W3' is unsupported. Author balusters as ADDITIVE desktop-only enhancement or defer; do not gate it behind an if(!W3) replacement of a loop that isn't a hero balustrade.
- Fix: Route the acanthus Corinthian capital carefully: scripted-bpy acanthus via execute_blender_code (no interactive sculpt, only SOLIDIFY+SUBSURF+procedural displace) will likely under-deliver at the WP3 d=118 name-beat where it is the most-read element. It is desktop-only so not a mobile/iOS blocker, but budget an iteration or a generative/CC0 fallback (Hunyuan3D/Rodin are currently DISABLED — owner must enable + confirm commercial license) for this one asset.
- Fix: Do NOT make the mobile texture-memory budget depend on KTX2: toktx is not installed (which toktx fails) so npm run build:ktx2 will fail today. The plan's zero-new-texture reuse strategy already keeps mobile texture add at ~0, so ship JPG/WEBP-embedded DRACO first and treat KTX2 strictly as an optional fast-follow after installing toktx.
- Fix: Assert the GLB header at export (magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed includes KHR_draco_mesh_compression) and NEVER use meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail). The two bust GLBs are the live decoder canary (bustBuilder.ts:2,34 call loadModel) — verify they still load after any modelLoader touch.

Load dome FIRST in the useEffect and add meshes in a rAF callback so the governor (GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500, samples first 15s) samples a settled scene and does not demote the tier on a warmup frame spike.

### WS02 — Hero terracotta dome + drum + gold lantern

*The single tallest hero element; ribbing, oculus, patinated copper vs terracotta, gilded lantern, how it catches golden hour.*

**Summary:** Author ONE DRACO-GLB hero crown (dome_w3.glb: segmented ogival terracotta shell + proud ribs + 12 deep arched drum-bay tiles + colonnaded lantern + bloom-lit gold finial) via scripted bpy in three baked LODs, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), that REPLACES the procedural W2 dome by hiding userData-tagged primitives on load — with the audit's material/AO/tier fixes baked in.
**Priority `P1` · ~4.5d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Replace the W2 procedural crown (smooth SphereGeometry shell + Box "rib" bands + tapered CylinderGeometry drum with flat pilaster/window stickers + primitive cone lantern, lines ~1747–1903 of ExteriorScene.tsx) with ONE DRACO-compressed GLB — public/models/exterior/dome_w3.glb — authored entirely by scripted bpy. It is the single tallest, most-read hero element at every dolly waypoint and the anchor of the 7.5s tympanum name-beat (WP3, d=118), so it earns the highest single-asset budget. The file ships THREE LODs as three named top-level groups (DomeHero / DomeMobile / DomePotato) plus a shared GoldFinial, so one load serves all tiers with zero second WebGL context. It REPLACES rather than adds: net draw-call delta is negative (~30 procedural primitives → 3–4 merged meshes on desktop, 2 on mobile), keeping us inside the binding iOS ceiling (750k tris / 80 calls / 140MB). Gated behind a fresh flag: W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior') (staging ON / prod OFF automatically). Silent procedural fallback on any load/decode failure. The perceived-quality jump comes from three surfaces that read as flat today: the 8-panel SEGMENTED OGIVAL terracotta shell with proud modeled ribs, the 12-bay drum with deep arched thermal-window reveals + volute keystones, and the fully colonnaded octagonal lantern with a bloom-lit gilded finial.

**Design decisions:**
- GRAFT — Brief-3's HYBRID scope is the spine, but promoted to full-crown replacement. Keep the drum CYLINDER BODY procedural (rDrumR 8.2, rDrumH 11.0, 32-seg — already a good mass, GLB'ing a plain cylinder wastes budget) BUT put the 12 arched thermal-bay WINDOW TILES (reveals + keystones + pilasters + blind niches) into the GLB as a separate 'DrumBays' mesh that sits proud of the procedural cylinder wall. This resolves the Brief-1-vs-3 tension: Brief-1 re-modeled the whole drum (redundant tris on an already-good cylinder); Brief-3 kept bays procedural (misses the #2 ranked fidelity gap). We take the bays into GLB but leave the cylinder mass procedural.
- GRAFT — Brief-2's THREE-LOD-in-one-file + THREE.LOD dolly strategy for DESKTOP ONLY. Desktop uses THREE.LOD.addLevel(DomeHero, 0) / (mid, 90); the 18s dolly opens at d~180 on the mid mesh and swaps to DomeHero as it dollies to d~50. Mobile pins DomeMobile from mount (no per-frame LOD switch cost). Potato pins DomePotato. Reject Brief-1's single-hero-mesh (no mid LOD → desktop uploads full 45k during the governor's 15s warmup — demotion risk).
- BUDGET — take Brief-1's richer desktop tri targets but CAP them to the WS02 self-imposed ceiling. DomeHero ~34k tris (shell 6.4k + ribs 4.8k + drum bays 12×~1.6k=19.2k + lantern 3.2k + finial 0.15k), well under the 150k GLB budget with ample headroom for the other WS assets. DomeMobile ~4.8k (shell 1.6k + ribs-as-edge-loops 0.8k + drum bays simplified 2.16k + lantern 0.32k). DomePotato ~900 (24-seg hemisphere + 8-seg cone lantern nub, NO bays, baked-AO only). Drum bays are OMITTED on potato and KEPT-but-simplified on mobile (they carry the WP3 name-beat read).
- MATERIALS — exactly 3 PBR sets, resolving the palette-token conflict in the briefs. (1) dome-terracotta (coppo shell + procedural-cylinder shares nothing; GLB-only): albedo target coppo #B0725A matte (canon coppo-terracotta), roughness 0.78–0.90, metalness 0. Polyhaven ceramic_roof_01/clay_roof_tiles_02 as ALBEDO SEED ONLY, tinted to #B0725A and blended with procedural Voronoi coppo-ridge before baking — never ship raw Polyhaven. (2) dome-travertine (ribs + drum-bay reveals/keystones/pilasters + lantern colonnade + oculus collar): albedo #E8DCC0 / grout #E3D6BC, roughness 0.48–0.68, authored 100% PROCEDURAL (Musgrave veining + Voronoi micropit — no matching scan exists) and baked. (3) dome-gold (finial ball+spike ONLY — canon: gold = lantern-finial + tympanum ONLY): albedo #D4AF37 (canon GOLD), roughness 0.15, metalness 0.9, emissive #D4AF37 @ intensity 2.0 to clear the 0.85 bloom threshold. Glass panes are NOT a 4th GLB material — author them as MeshStandardMaterial(opacity 0.7, transparent) in Blender matching scene M.win, so mobile mkPhys() stripping leaves a correct opaque-ish pane (NEVER KHR_materials_transmission — mkPhys strips it to opaque black).
- INTEGRATION — additive-only async IIFE inside the existing useEffect, AFTER the synchronous W2 dome pass. Tag every W2 dome primitive with userData.w2DomePart=true during construction (resolves Brief-3's 'meshes aren't individually ref'd' problem — the current code adds ~30 anonymous meshes to centralGroup). On W3 GLB resolve: traverse centralGroup, set visible=false on all w2DomePart meshes; on reject/catch, leave them visible (procedural is the safety net). Position the GLB group at (0, drumBaseY + rDrumH + 0.2, 0) — the EXACT literal already used by rDome.position.set on line 1811 — with the GLB's dome-base pivot at local (0,0,0), so any future change to drumBaseY/rDrumH auto-reseats the GLB (kills Brief-1's 'position mismatch' risk).
- LOADER — zero changes to modelLoader.ts. After loadModel() resolves, traverse and (a) re-apply mkPhys(THREE, material) to EVERY mesh material (GLTFLoader bypasses it — else mobile fragment cost + palette drift), (b) assert aoMap.channel===0 (assetLoader hardcodes UV0; bake AO to UV0 only, export single TEXCOORD_0), (c) select the LOD group for this tier via getGPUTier()/isMobileGPU() and set the others' .visible=false or omit from graph. Never dispose clones; clearModelCache() at unmount only.
- POTATO GUARD — early-return before loadModel() when getGPUTier()==='potato' AND the governor can demote mid-session, so also skip the GLB if the effective tier is potato. Potato keeps the procedural W2 dome — zero regression, zero GLB cost, no shadows/env reliance.
- LIGHTING/BAKE MATCH — one Blender sun lamp color #FFB870, aimed to match GOLDEN.sunPosition [-20,18,-30] (elevation ≈26.6°, azimuth ≈213° SW). Bake AO/normal/roughness at exposure 1.0 (scene applies NeutralToneMapping @ exposure 1.15 ONCE post-bake — never bake at scene exposure). Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default). Emissive only on finial.
- WARMUP-JANK MITIGATION — defer GLB materialisation by one requestAnimationFrame after load (centralGroup.add(group) inside rAF) so the GPU upload lands OUTSIDE the governor's 2.5s warmup dead-zone; start the fetch synchronously at mount (Promise kicked off in useEffect) so the DRACO worker decodes off-main-thread well before the reduced-motion stills compose at WP1/WP3/WP5.
- REPRODUCIBILITY — save the authoring bpy script to scripts/blender/build_dome.py and the source to public/models/exterior/dome_source.blend (parameterised with DRUM_R=8.2, DRUM_TOP_Y=drumBaseY+rDrumH+0.2, DOME_R=8.0 so the shell base loop snaps to the cylinder within 0.001m). Script asserts at export: GLB magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression, and material count ≤3 (aborts on a stray 4th/gold-on-non-finial to protect the canon).
- REJECT meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent prod fail); reject Sketchfab/generative for the dome masonry (deterministic parametric geometry — bpy nails Renaissance proportions with clean low-poly topology). The ONLY optional generative touch: bootstrap-sculpt the Corinthian/Ionic capital acanthus from a single Villa Lante reference via Hunyuan3D/Rodin, then MANUALLY retopo to ~380 clean quads before bake — with a scripted SCREW-modifier acanthus-profile fallback if the owner hasn't enabled the N-panel generators.

**Assets:**
- **public/models/exterior/dome_w3.glb** — Scripted bpy: (1) ogival meridian bezier (pointed profile, tangent-break ~65% rise) → SCREW 360/8 = one 45deg panel → SOLIDIFY 0.18m → ARRAY x8 → remove_doubles(0.001). (2) 8 ribs: beveled tapered box (0.28m base→0.10m crown, 0.24m proud) swept via Curve modifier on the meridian → ARRAY x8 → merged to ONE mesh. (3) DrumBays: one arched thermal-bay tile (0.55m reveal, segmental arch + volute keystone, 2 pilasters, blind niches) → ARRAY x12 on a curve circle r=8.2 → merged per material. Draw calls: 3–4 merged meshes/LOD (terracotta / travertine / glass[shared M.win] / gold-finial). File ≤2.1MB desktop, mobile-LOD payload ≤500KB. - **public/models/exterior/dome_source.blend** — Blender source saved for future edits; sun lamp #FFB870 pre-aimed to GOLDEN.sunPosition; hero + mobile + potato collections. · N/A (source) · N/A

**Blender MCP tools:** mcp__blender__execute_blender_code — 100% of dome/drum-bay/lantern/finial geometry, all 3 LODs, bake, DRACO export, header asserts (scripts/blender/build_dome.py), mcp__blender__download_polyhaven_asset — ceramic_roof_01 or clay_roof_tiles_02 as ALBEDO SEED ONLY for terracotta (tinted to canon + blended with procedural Voronoi coppo-ridge before bake; never ship raw), mcp__blender__get_viewport_screenshot — QA the 3 LODs against the Front (-Z) primary angle at WP3 name-beat before export, mcp__blender__get_scene_info / mcp__blender__get_object_info — verify tri counts + single UV set + material count <=3 pre-export, OPTIONAL mcp__blender__generate_hunyuan3d_model (primary) or mcp__blender__generate_hyper3d_model_via_images (Rodin, alt) — ONLY the Corinthian capital acanthus bootstrap, gated behind owner enabling N-panel generators + commercial license; else scripted SCREW-modifier acanthus fallback. **Integration:**
- Zero changes to modelLoader.ts, assetLoader.ts, flags3d.ts. All wiring is in ExteriorScene.tsx.
- Add after the synchronous W2 dome pass: const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'); (read once at mount).
- Potato guard: const q = getQuality(); const isPotato = q.shadowsEnabled===false && q.vegetationDensity===0; if (!W3 || isPotato) skip the load entirely (procedural W2 dome stays — zero regression).
- Kick the fetch SYNCHRONOUSLY at mount so DRACO decode (~40ms) + GPU upload land BEFORE GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500 (mobilePerf.ts:240) — during warmup the stall is ignored (blocker-fix #6: the plan's 'one rAF past 2500ms' was wrong; a single rAF is ~16ms). Do NOT defer materialisation past warmup.
- On resolve: pick LOD via isMobileGPU() -> 'DomeMobile' else 'DomeHero'; iterate ['DomeHero','DomeMobile','DomePotato'] and set g.visible=(g===keep). Desktop: instead wrap DomeHero+DomeMobile in a THREE.LOD (addLevel 0 / 90) and add that.
- MATERIAL PASS — CORRECTED (blocker-fix #1): DO NOT call mkPhys(THREE, c.material) — verified mkPhys(three, props) CONSTRUCTS a new material from a plain-props dict and RETURNS it; passing a live Material and discarding the return is a no-op on desktop and builds garbage on mobile. Because the GLB ships standard PBR only, mkPhys is UNNECESSARY. Instead traverse and per mesh: if (c.material.aoMap) c.material.aoMap.channel = 0; set c.material.envMapIntensity to match adjacent roofs (~0.45); c.castShadow = c.receiveShadow = true. Glass pane already authored as transparent MeshStandard in Blender.
- AO channel (blocker-fix #2): GLTFLoader sets aoMap.channel from the glTF-declared TEXCOORD index; assetLoader hardcodes channel 0. Force c.material.aoMap.channel=0 in the traverse AND guard the mutation to run once (the loadModel clone SHARES cached materials — blocker-fix #3; either run a module-level 'w3Materialized' guard or clone c.material before mutating).
- Position: group.position.set(0, drumBaseY + rDrumH + 0.2, 0) — the EXACT literal already used by rDome.position (line 1811) — with the GLB dome-base pivot at local origin so future drumBaseY/rDrumH edits auto-reseat.
- Hide procedural crown ONLY on success: centralGroup.traverse(m => { if (m.userData?.w2DomePart) m.visible=false; }); then requestAnimationFrame(() => centralGroup.add(group)). On reject/catch: leave w2DomePart meshes visible (procedural is the silent safety net).
- Reduced-motion stills compose at WP1/WP3/WP5: because fetch starts synchronously at mount, add a still-recompose-on-load hook so a cold-cache/3G resolve (>300ms) does not bake the procedural dome into the stills.
- Dispose only via clearModelCache() at unmount; NEVER dispose clones. Never open a 2nd WebGL context (use the pooled renderer).

**LOD tiers:**
- DomeHero — desktop only; wrapped in THREE.LOD: addLevel(DomeHero, 0) and addLevel(DomeMobile-as-mid, 90); 18s dolly opens ~d180 on mid, swaps to hero by ~d50
- DomeMobile — pinned when isMobileGPU()===true; no per-frame LOD switch (avoids swap cost on mobile)
- DomePotato — pinned when EFFECTIVE tier is potato. No exported getEffectiveTier(): detect potato via getQuality().shadowsEnabled===false && getQuality().vegetationDensity===0 (POTATO_QUALITY, mobilePerf.ts:183/188). When potato, EARLY-RETURN before loadModel() — keep the procedural W2 dome, zero GLB cost
