### WS09 — Statuary / sculpture (Sette Sorelle figures)

*Free-standing and niche statues, river-gods, allegorical figures — likely Rodin/Hunyuan authored, weathered marble.*

**Summary:** WS09 statuary: ship v1 scripted-BPY pedestal + low-poly placeholder figures now (exercises full loadModel/flag3d w3_exterior seam as PURE-ADDITIVE draw calls); generative Hunyuan/Rodin roster is phase-2, HARD-BLOCKED (both generators verified DISABLED) until owner enables them and confirms commercial license.
**Priority `P2` · ~6d · Feasible: NO · Confidence 0.83**

**Vision.** Replace the box-torso/sphere-head placeholder statues and the fountain sphere-blob with weathered-Carrara hero sculpture that lands exactly on the two frames every visitor holds longest — the WP3 tympanum name-beat (d=118, front −Z) and the WP4 frontal hold (d=96). We author a SMALL, high-ROI figural roster via Hunyuan3D image→3D (Rodin multi-image only for the single most camera-dominant pair once commercial-license is confirmed), retopo/decimate + bake in Blender to one shared "statuary_marble" 1k PBR atlas, and stream Draco GLBs through the already-proven loadModel() path behind a NEW flag3d('w3_exterior') gate (W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior')). The design is strictly draw-call-negative on desktop (replaces ~38–48 procedural box/cylinder DCs with ≤6 GLB DCs) and adds at most +1 DC on mobile (fountain figure only), +0 on potato (procedural boxes stay). Every load is try/catch-wrapped with the procedural boxes kept as a visible fallback (hidden only on GLB success), so no network stall or 404 ever shows an empty pedestal — and the iOS free-tier seal is never at risk because W3 defaults OFF on prod hosts.

**Design decisions:**
- ROSTER (grafted, pruned to 5 named figures + 1 pedestal): from Brief-1's named-figure clarity I keep FORTUNA + VIRTU as the two hero stair/entrance flankers (they dominate WP3 d=118 and WP4 d=96), MEMORIA + TEMPO as the peristyle pair replacing the box-figures at ExteriorScene.tsx lines 1558–1581, and ANIMA as the fountain crown replacing the bronze sphere blob. I DROP Brief-2/3's herms, coat-of-arms and 4-corner parapet acroteria for the first ship — they are read at r≥16m or off the primary dolly cone (herms at ±55) and blow the draw-call budget for near-zero perceived-quality return. They become an explicit fast-follow, not v1.
- TWO-ARCHETYPE AUTHORING (grafted from Brief-3) TO MINIMIZE GENERATION SURFACE, but exposed as 5 distinct GLB files (from Brief-1) for clean per-figure placement/LOD/priority: generate exactly TWO Hunyuan bases — Archetype A 'draped standing female allegory' (reused/reposed for FORTUNA, MEMORIA) and Archetype B 'standing/seated male allegory' (VIRTU, TEMPO), plus one putti-scale seated base for ANIMA. Repose/mirror in Blender rather than regenerating nine figures. This keeps generation cost low while preserving per-figure priority loading.
- GENERATION ROUTE: Hunyuan3D is PRIMARY for all figures (cheaper, less-gated, strong single-image organic reconstruction). Rodin multi-image is used ONLY for FORTUNA + VIRTU (the two most camera-dominant) and ONLY after the owner confirms the commercial-license tier is active in the Blender N-panel; if not cleared, both fall back to Hunyuan single-image. Sketchfab is skipped entirely (NC/ND license risk in a paid subscription app). This is a PLANNING run — no generation is issued yet; the gating checkbox + license confirmation is a hard prerequisite (open question below).
- ONE SHARED TEXTURE SET: all five figures + pedestal share a single 'statuary_marble' 1k PBR set (diff/nor_gl/rough/ao) packed as a UV atlas — FORTUNA/VIRTU get 60% of atlas area (they are read closest), MEMORIA/TEMPO/ANIMA share the rest. This costs ~1.5MB GPU total and consumes only ONE of the mobile eager-texture slots (getQuality().maxEagerTextureSets, mobile cap=4). Desktop tier may promote to a 2k atlas (assetLoader already supports the _2k suffix) for the WP3 close-up; mobile keeps 1k.
- BAKED LOD, NOT RUNTIME LOD (from Brief-2/3): author two export passes per figure — {name}.glb (desktop hi) and {name}_lo.glb (mobile, ~30% tris). Path chosen once at load via isMobileGPU(). No THREE.LOD object (it adds draw calls and CPU per frame). Both LODs share the same 1k atlas so the tier switch costs no extra texture.
- MATERIAL / CANON: single MeshStandardMaterial via mkPhys(THREE,{...}) applied POST-load to every mesh (GLTFLoader bypasses mkPhys). Marble albedo #F2E9DA→#E8DCC0 range (PLASTER/TRAVERTINE canon), roughness 0.55–0.65 honed (NO clearcoat — mkPhys strips it on mobile, so wet-marble sheen is baked into a roughness gradient from hi-poly curvature, never authored as clearcoat/sheen), metalness 0.0, aoMapIntensity ~1.2, NO emissive (emissive budget reserved for gold lantern + tympanum lettering; statues stay ≤0.6 relative luminance so memories remain the brightest pixels). Lichen green-grey #6B7A5C at 10–20% coverage baked at the plinth base. Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default). Bake AO on UV0 ONLY (assetLoader hardcodes aoMap.channel=0).
- INTEGRATION SEAM: add `const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior');` immediately after line 98 in ExteriorScene.tsx. Add ONE async block inside the same scene useEffect AFTER the synchronous W2 geometry pass, guarded by `if (W3)`, using the existing loadModel() (no modelLoader.ts changes needed — Draco decoder is already warm from the bust GLBs, our decoder canary). Priority order: FORTUNA+VIRTU first (Promise.all), then MEMORIA+TEMPO, then ANIMA last. Each mesh: reapply mkPhys, castShadow/receiveShadow=true, set world position/rotation/scale, scene.add. Pedestal loaded once and placed as InstancedMesh ×4.
- TIER GATING inside the W3 block: desktop loads all 5 figures + pedestal InstancedMesh. Mobile (isMobileGPU()===true) loads ONLY FORTUNA+VIRTU (_lo) + pedestal (the 2 stair flankers that read at WP3) → +≈3 DC, well under the 15 GLB ceiling and the mobile decorative cap of 2. Potato (getGPUTier()==='potato') skips the entire W3 block → the W2 procedural box figures stay visible, +0 DC, no shadows/env reliance.
- FALLBACK CONTRACT (from all three briefs, made explicit): store references to the existing procedural box-figure groups (lines 1558–1581) and the fountain sphere blob (line ~3250) BEFORE the async load. On GLB resolve → set procedural group.visible=false. On GLB reject → leave visible=true and console.warn('[WS09] statuary fallback'). Each figure in its own try/catch so one 404 never cascades. Never dispose clones; dispose only via existing clearModelCache() at unmount.
- FOUNTAIN POSITION (fix from Brief-3): the fountain world position (fX,fZ) is computed dynamically via the isInWingZone fallback loop — ANIMA must read fX/fZ from a ref/closure populated during the fountain geometry pass, NOT hardcode (0,-35)/(0,-28). ANIMA sits directly on the fountain finial stem, no separate pedestal.
- EXPORT + VALIDATION: Draco GLB level 6, position 14 / normal 10 / uv 12, export_apply=True, export_yup=True, WEBP-embedded textures. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail). Assert at export: magic bytes 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed ⊇ KHR_draco_mesh_compression, single UV channel with ao in set index 0. Dev overlay asserts renderer.info.render.triangles/calls deltas vs W2 baseline (≤20k tris / ≤6 DC desktop; ≤5k tris / ≤3 DC mobile) at the 7.5s tympanum beat. Profile Draco-decode+GPU-upload inside the 15s adaptive-governor warmup on an iPhone 13 / Capacitor dev build BEFORE staging — if load pushes past warmup and risks a wrongful demotion, merge figure+pedestal into one mesh per statue or drop mobile to FORTUNA only.
- REDUCED-MOTION + i18n: reduced-motion composes stills at WP1/WP3/WP5, so FORTUNA/VIRTU must be silhouette-correct dead-on at WP3 (theta≈1.548π, phi≈0.306π, d=118) and ANIMA readable at WP5 (d=35) — verify via get_viewport_screenshot at those exact camera params before baking. No new user-facing copy is introduced by statuary geometry; any figure name labels/tooltips must route through the existing i18n t() flat-lookup (per reference_i18n_flat_lookup memory).
- FLAG RETIREMENT DISCIPLINE: w3_exterior does NOT retire until prod + iOS WKWebView show stable ~60fps with the mobile set (FORTUNA+VIRTU) loaded and no governor demotion in warmup. Deploy staging-only via `npx vercel --prod` on the staging worktree; prod promote is a separate later gate (consistent with the MUSEO VIVO staging-only posture in memory).

Apply mkPhys to produce fresh MeshStandardMaterial per figure and assign explicitly; do not mutate the cached material.
- Fix: Profile fortuna_lo+virtu_lo Draco-decode + GPU-upload on a real iPhone 13 / Capacitor dev build inside the 15s governor warmup (GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500, sampling to 15000ms) BEFORE staging; if decode+upload risks sustained >25ms frames in >=2 windows it triggers a 7-day demotion. If at risk, merge figure+pedestal per statue or ship mobile as FORTUNA-only.
- Fix: Scope v1 to what is actually shippable now: build and integrate the scripted pedestal + a scripted low-poly placeholder figure behind w3_exterior first (fully buildable today, exercises the whole seam), and treat the generative figural roster as phase 2 blocked on tool-enablement. This de-risks the seam without waiting on the disabled generators.

### WS10 — Roofline: terracotta tiles, eaves, chimneys, dormers

*Convincing coppo tiles (trim sheet + geometry), ridge lines, overhanging eaves with rafters, chimney pots, dormers.*

**Summary:** WS10 'Coppo Vivo' roofline: ship the always-on Blender-baked coppo trim-sheet as a ROOF-ONLY FORKED PBR set (NOT in-place overwrite of terracotta_tiles, which is shared by interiors at eraMaterials.ts:50), plus at most two justified DRACO GLBs (chimney_pot on mobile+desktop, eave_rafter_strip desktop-only); DROP tower_cone_roof/ridge_cresting/dormer GLBs as redundant with already-modeled square-tower caps and hipRoof geometry.
**Priority `P2` · ~6d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.82**

**Vision.** Le Sette Sorelle's roofline is the single largest cheap-read in the exterior: flat tilted BoxGeometry slabs, ConeGeometry tower caps, and box chimneys that all telegraph "game asset" at the WP3 name-beat (d=118). WS10 replaces them with a HYBRID system synthesized from all three briefs: (1) a SINGLE Blender-baked coppo-tile PBR trim-sheet that upgrades every existing roof surface at ZERO draw-call and ZERO material-slot cost — this alone carries mobile and potato; plus (2) FOUR small DRACO GLBs (eave-rafter strip, ridge-cresting strip, tower-cone LOD pair, chimney pot) that add modeled relief on capable devices only, each instanced or merged so they cost 1 draw call apiece and REPLACE the procedural geometry they supersede rather than stacking on it. The governing principle grafted from Brief 2 (perf-first) is the master constraint; the fidelity ambitions of Brief 1 (rafter tails, pedimented dormers, antefixae) are kept but demoted to desktop-only tiers; Brief 3's insight — that the texture upgrade is free and always-on while the geometry is tiered — becomes the spine of the whole plan. Net result: every device gets a genuinely better terracotta read from the trim-sheet; desktop gets true coppo relief, exposed rafter tails, witch-hat tower roofs with proud ribs, and terracotta chimney pots; mobile gets the trim-sheet plus proper Tuscan chimney stacks (the one silhouette upgrade that survives the budget); potato gets the trim-sheet only. All gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior') with W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), staging-ON / prod-OFF, zero regression risk because every GLB path is try/catch-guarded and falls through to the untouched procedural geometry.

**Design decisions:**
- SPINE = Brief 3's tiering split. The coppo PBR trim-sheet is ALWAYS-ON (no flag, no tier gate) because it costs zero new draw calls and zero new material slots — it drops into the EXISTING /textures/pbr/terracotta_tiles/ path (verified live in assetLoader.ts:646 loadTerracottaTileTextures) as a straight bake-quality replacement, so M.tile/M.roof/M.roofD consume it automatically on next load. Geometry GLBs are the ONLY thing gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior').
- RESOLVED texture-path conflict: Briefs 1 & 2 invented a NEW set at /textures/pbr/terracotta_coppo/ or /coppo_tile/ requiring a new loadCoppoPBR() and consuming one of the mobile eager-4 material slots. REJECTED. Brief 3 is correct: overwrite the existing terracotta_tiles set in place. Net new material slots = 0. This keeps the mobile eager cap at 4 (unchanged from W2) and needs ZERO changes to assetLoader.ts.
- RESOLVED tier gate for GLBs: reconciled Brief 1 (desktop-only, isMobileGPU() bypass) vs Brief 2/3 (mobile keeps chimney only). ADOPTED the middle path: W3geo = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'). On desktop tier: all 4 GLBs. On mobile tier: chimney_pot ONLY (the single highest-silhouette-ROI upgrade that fits the +0 draw-call-after-merge budget). On potato: 0 GLBs, trim-sheet only. Gate reads getQuality()/isMobileGPU() from mobilePerf.ts once at mount, mirroring the existing isMobileQ pattern.
- RESOLVED tower-cone instancing: Brief 3 correctly flags that 9 casa-torri/gate-towers with varying radius+height CANNOT use a single InstancedMesh cheaply and 9 separate clones = 9 draw calls (near the mobile ceiling). DECISION: on desktop, load tower_cone LOD0, clone per tower with scale.set(r,h,r), then mergeGeometries() the 9 scaled cones into ONE BufferGeometry before scene.add → 1-2 draw calls. On mobile, tower cones are NOT loaded (procedural ConeGeometry stays — it is cheap and the trim-sheet-less cone is acceptable at mobile distance); only the chimney upgrades.
- RESOLVED eave/ridge instancing: authored as 1m master strips (Brief 2's parametric approach), placed as THREE.InstancedMesh along perimeters computed by buildBlock()/hipRoof() — 1 draw call each regardless of count. Corner miters accepted as natural tile-cuts (Brief 2 risk analysis: UV is 1k, ~32px/tile, seam reads as a real cut not a texture break).
- DROPPED Brief 1's per-slope full-tile-geometry GLBs (coppo_slope_A/B/tower, 57k+ tris of individually-modeled tiles). Too heavy, too many unique GLBs (8 shapes), and the trim-sheet normal+AO already delivers 90% of the relief read at dolly distance (20-40m). Individual modeled tiles are invisible past ~8m. The trim-sheet + eave rafter tails (the actual silhouette-breaker) capture the perceived-quality win at a fraction of the cost.
- KEPT from Brief 1 (demoted to desktop): pedimented dormer, exposed rafter-tail eaves, ridge antefix finials — these are the genuine WP3 silhouette upgrades. But dormer is desktop-only and merged, not a per-position InstancedMesh explosion.
- mkPhys() re-application: modelLoader.ts (verified) does NOT call mkPhys — GLTFLoader makes raw MeshStandardMaterials. Integration seam MUST traverse each loaded group and re-apply mkPhys() to every material. CRITICAL nuance from reading modelLoader: the cache stores the ORIGINAL and returns .clone(); clones SHARE material references with the cached original, so apply mkPhys once to the cached original's materials (or accept shared mutation) — do NOT author clearcoat/sheen/transmission in Blender at all (stripped on mobile).
- AO on UV0 only: assetLoader.ts:554 hardcodes aoMap.channel=0. For GLB-embedded materials, ensure the low-poly has ONLY UV0 (delete smart_project's auto UV1) so embedded aoMap lands on channel 0, matching the hardcoded contract.
- Async load AFTER synchronous geometry pass, wrapped in try/catch; on any reject the procedural roof stays. Loads dispatched after first rAF so the adaptive governor's 15s warmup samples procedural-only geometry (avoids false demotion). clearModelCache() at unmount ONLY — never dispose clones. Use the pooled renderer (rendererPool.ts); never a 2nd WebGL context.
- Z-fight avoidance (Brief 1 risk): existing fascia BoxGeometry at the eave (ExteriorScene ~lines 2049-2054) must be SUPPRESSED via an if-guard when W3geo is active on desktop, OR the GLB fascia offset +0.05 in Y. Chosen: suppress procedural fascia + roof-slab where the GLB replaces it (one if-guard in buildBlock), so GLBs REPLACE not ADD (honors the 'never additive' draw-call ceiling).
- Reduced-motion: trim-sheet is static and always-on so RM stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 benefit automatically; all 4 GLBs are static meshes (no animation) so they load identically under prefersReducedMotion — no separate RM path needed.
- Export contract locked (all 3 briefs agree): DRACO level 6 / pos 14 / nrm 10 / uv 12, export_apply=True, export_yup=True. Tower cone authored tip at +Z base at origin in Blender (Z-up) so export_yup lands it pointing +Y in Three.js (Brief 3 risk). GLB textures: eave/ridge/chimney embed NOTHING for coppo (share the /textures/pbr/terracotta_tiles set already on GPU) — only the rafter-wood sub-material embeds a tiny WEBP or reuses dark_wood. Validate GLB header magic 0x46546C67 + extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression before commit (never meshopt — no MeshoptDecoder registered, silent blank mesh).
- i18n: no user-facing strings in WS10 (pure 3D geometry). Dev-overlay assertion strings are NODE_ENV-gated and stripped in prod build, so no i18n keys needed.

**Integration:**
- Read gate once at mount in the ExteriorScene scene useEffect: const W3geo = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'); reuse existing const isMobileQ = isMobileGPU(). Compute tier from getQuality().
- Trim-sheet (coppo_roof) swap: change ExteriorScene.tsx:281 roofTileTex from loadTerracottaTileTextures([3,3]) to loadCoppoRoofTextures([3,3]) GUARDED so interiors (eraMaterials.ts:50) are untouched. On mobile, if the eager-4 material cap is already reached, keep terracotta_tiles for the roof (audit before switching).
- GLB pass: AFTER the synchronous W2 geometry pass AND after the first requestAnimationFrame (so the adaptive governor's 15s warmup samples procedural-only geometry - avoids false 7-day demotion), dispatch an async IIFE.
- Desktop tier: Promise.all([loadModel('/models/exterior/eave_rafter_strip.glb'), loadModel('/models/exterior/chimney_pot.glb')]). Mobile tier: loadModel('/models/exterior/chimney_pot.glb') only. Potato / !W3geo: skip all. Wrap in try/catch; on reject log '[W3] roofline GLBs failed, procedural fallback' and leave procedural roof intact.
- On resolve: (1) traverse each loaded group and re-apply mkPhys() from mobilePerf.ts to every MeshStandardMaterial (modelLoader.ts:26-36 does NOT call mkPhys). NOTE clones share material refs with the cached original (modelLoader returns model.clone()); apply mkPhys once to the cached original's materials or accept shared mutation. Do NOT author clearcoat/sheen/transmission in Blender (stripped on mobile).
- (2) eave_rafter_strip -> build THREE.InstancedMesh with per-instance matrix (translation + yaw + small +/-jitter) following the buildBlock() eave perimeters, 1 draw call.
- (3) chimney_pot -> clone to the world positions currently used by the procedural chimney loop (buildBlock ~L2707-2714), scale.y jitter for asymmetry, then mergeGeometries per material into 1-2 draw calls.
- (4) SUPPRESS superseded procedural geometry - MULTI-SITE surgery, not one guard. Under W3geo (+ desktop for eave) add if-guards to SKIP: the eave-fascia box(gTrimM,...) at buildBlock ~L2660-2663 (when eave GLB active); the chimney box(gWall/gTrimM) at ~L2707-2714 (when chimney GLB active). This makes GLBs REPLACE not ADD, honoring the never-additive mobile draw-call ceiling and avoiding z-fight.
- (5) Dev-overlay assertion (NODE_ENV !== 'production', stripped in Vercel prod build): after ~3s settle, read renderer.info.render.triangles and .calls; assert new-GLB contribution <= mobile 60k tris / 15 calls, desktop 200k / 30 calls, and total calls under the live perfAssert.ts 150/frame budget. Two existing bust GLBs remain the DRACO decoder canary.
- (6) clearModelCache() at unmount ONLY; never dispose clones; never open a 2nd WebGL context (use rendererPool.ts pooled renderer - iOS jetsam kills a 2nd context silently).
- Verify ~60fps inside iOS WKWebView (Capacitor) BEFORE npx vercel --prod. Flag stays staging-ON / prod-OFF; no flag retirement until prod+iOS verified. No i18n keys (pure 3D; dev-overlay strings are NODE_ENV-gated).

**LOD tiers:**
- Desktop tier (getQuality high, !isMobileGPU): eave_rafter_strip InstancedMesh + chimney_pot merged. Trim-sheet 2k.
- Mobile tier (isMobileGPU true / iOS WKWebView): chimney_pot ONLY (2 units merged, 1 call). Trim-sheet 1k. Procedural eave+towers stay.
- Potato tier: 0 GLBs. Trim-sheet 1k only; baked normal+AO carry depth with no shadows/no env-map.
- Reduced-motion: identical to tier (all GLBs static, no animation) - RM stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 get trim-sheet + tier GLBs automatically.
- chimney_pot ships single mesh (no geometric LOD needed at ~320 tris); eave_rafter_strip single LOD (desktop-only, not loaded on mobile).

**Dependencies:** NONE on generative workstreams: WS10 is 100% scripted BPY + Polyhaven (enabled). Hunyuan3D/Rodin being DISABLED is NOT a WS10 blocker., Polyhaven MCP connectivity at author-time (non-blocking: procedural-only bake to #B0725A canon is deterministic fallback if ceramic_roof_01 download fails)., toktx binary installed in CI/PATH for the KTX2 fast-follow (currently missing - JPG-first ships without it)., Shared PBR sets must exist on GPU: coppo_roof (new forked), travertine + dark_wood (already shipped) - chimney/eave reuse these, so they must load before or alongside the GLB pass., W2 (flag3d('w2_exterior')) must be active; W3geo = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior')., Coordinate with any other W3 workstream that also loads exterior GLBs so the combined GLB draw-call count stays under the mobile 15 / desktop 30 ceiling and total under perfAssert 150/frame.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: medium
- iOS risk: low
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: tower_cone_roof.glb is INVALID: buildTower() (round cylinder+cone, line 435) is DEAD code. Real casa-torri are the TOWERS array (ExteriorScene.tsx:2929) = 6 towers (not 7/9), SQUARE footprint (BoxGeometry(fp,..,fp)), already carrying articulated pyramidal coppo caps, moulded 2-band cornices, antefix roll-tiles, finials, and a full campanile (bifora belfry + octagonal drum + coppo cupola + clock). scale.set(r,h,r) on a round cone is geometrically wrong AND redundant. The plan's '9 towers vary in radius+height' premise is stale masterplan text.
- Blocker: 'terracotta_tiles is the only roof consumer, overwrite in place is safe' is FALSE. Second consumer confirmed at eraMaterials.ts:50 (loadTerracottaTileTextures for interior Roman/Renaissance room terracotta). An in-place bake replacement also mutates interior surfaces — must be visually validated or forked, and forking costs a mobile eager-4 material slot the plan claims to preserve.
- Blocker: 'Suppress procedural fascia via one if-guard, REPLACE not ADD' is understated. Roof/fascia/eave/ridge/chimney/dormer geometry is emitted at 10+ scattered call sites (addM(), box(gTrimM,..), gRoofDS.push()) inside buildBlock/hipRoof and the TOWERS loop, all merged into shared buffers (gWall/gTrimM/gSerenaM/gRoofDS/gWallD). Suppression is surgical multi-site edits, not one guard. Without it the GLBs are ADDITIVE, z-fight, and breach the live perfAssert.ts 150-draw-call mobile budget.
- Blocker: Perceived-quality ROI of the geometry GLBs is low/unproven: hipRoof slopes, pedimented-style dormers, rusticated chimneys, antefixae, and tower cornices ALREADY exist as modeled merged geometry. Eave-rafter-tail and ridge-cresting GLBs add marginal silhouette at the 20-40m dolly distance; the trim-sheet already delivers ~90% of the read.

- Fix: Resolve the terracotta_tiles shared-consumer conflict BEFORE any in-place bake: grep confirms eraMaterials.ts:50 uses it for interiors. Either (a) validate the new coppo bake also reads acceptably on interior terracotta, or (b) fork a roof-only set and accept the mobile eager-4 slot cost and a small loader wrapper — do not claim 'zero material slots' without (a).
- Fix: Re-scope procedural suppression as explicit multi-site surgery: enumerate the exact addM/box(gTrimM)/gRoofDS.push sites the GLBs supersede (buildBlock eave fascia ~2660-2663, roof slabs ~2029-2054, dormer/chimney ~2696-2713, tower crowns ~2929+) and guard each under W3geo so GLBs REPLACE not ADD. Add a dev-overlay renderer.info.render.calls assertion tied to perfAssert's 150 budget.
- Fix: Trim the GLB set to what actually earns its budget: keep the always-on coppo trim-sheet (strong, safe) and at most chimney_pot on mobile + desktop-only eave/ridge/dormer, each justified against the already-modeled roof. Do not ship eave/ridge/dormer/tower GLBs speculatively.

### WS11 — Cortile: paving + well/central fountain

*The irregular inner courtyard: stone paving, wellhead, drainage, the enclosed intimate space.*

**Summary:** WS11 Inner Cortile & Broncourt — a two-tier (W3_BASE all-tiers / W3_LUX desktop-only) discovery-space build behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), whose ONLY dolly-visible payoff is a scripted-bpy octagonal pozzo GLB whose iron crane spikes above Block C's parapet at WP2; everything else is inline procedural on mobile and additive carved GLBs on desktop, deferred behind front-face heroes WS1–WS5.
**Priority `P3` · ~4d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.78**

**Vision.** The cortile is the villa's secret interior lung — the enclosed garden-room "grown over centuries" that the camera never enters but glimpses through the east-wing arcade at WP2 and, faintly, through a gate at WP4. Because it is geometrically occluded from the four frontal dolly beats (WP1/WP3/WP4/WP5) and the three reduced-motion stills, it earns ZERO perceived-quality at the money shots. That single fact resolves every tradeoff between the three briefs: this is a DISCOVERY space, not a HERO space. So we take the perf-first brief's discipline as the binding law (draw calls, tier gating, reuse-first), and spend the small budget it frees ONLY on the two elements that read at WP2 silhouette-and-glint distance (d≈120): the hero POZZO wellhead and one reflective water surface. Everything the photoreal brief proposes as ground-plane richness (opus-incertum Voronoi paving, scallop lavabo, trellis ivy, caustics) is downgraded to a single desktop-only "immersive tier" that layers on top of the perf-safe base and NEVER touches the mobile budget. The result: on mobile/potato the cortile is a whisper (3 draw calls, procedural, no GLB); on desktop it blooms into a full carved garden-room; and the ONE element with actual dolly visibility — the pozzo's iron crane spiking above the parapet at WP2 — is a proper Blender-authored GLB on every tier that can afford it. We do not confuse "maximum fidelity" with "maximum value": the aesthetic ceiling is desktop, the perf floor is potato, and the pozzo bridges them.

**Design decisions:**
- BINDING SCOPE = perf-first brief's discipline, NOT photoreal-max. The cortile is occluded at WP1/WP3/WP4/WP5 and all 3 reduced-motion stills, so it scores 0 perceived-quality at the money beats. Therefore: hard budget ceiling, reuse-first, GLB only where WP2 silhouette demands it. The photoreal-max feature set survives only as a DESKTOP-ONLY additive 'immersive tier' gated behind W3 && !isMobileGPU().
- TWO-TIER GATE, resolving the flag conflict across the three briefs. W3_BASE = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior') runs on ALL tiers (paving + pozzo-or-fallback + one water plane, ~3 draw calls). W3_LUX = W3_BASE && !isMobileGPU() adds the carved layer (Voronoi paving GLBs, lavabo fountain, trellis ivy, pots, PointLight fill, water ripple). Evaluate both once at mount. Staging ON / prod OFF; no flag retirement until prod+iOS verified.
- POZZO IS THE ONE HERO GLB, and it is the ONLY generative-adjacent authoring in the whole workstream — but authored 100% SCRIPTED BPY (SCREW + curve), no AI. Rationale: it is the sole element with dolly visibility (WP2 silhouette), it is unmistakably architectural, and merged cylinders cannot read as a carved octagonal vera-da-pozzo at d≈120. Its wrought-iron crane arm is authored to rise to world y≈12.6, clearing Block C's parapet (h=11) so it registers as a distinct silhouette spike from WP2 — this is the single perceived-quality gain of the workstream.
- REJECT the Hunyuan3D lion-mask mascaron. Two of three briefs flagged it as the top risk (topological noise, wrong pose, service currently DISABLED requiring owner N-panel + restart). At WP2 discovery distance through an arcade arch the mascaron contributes sub-pixel detail. Author a simplified box-boolean stand-in mascaron in bpy (extruded oval + nostril/brow booleans) merged into the lavabo GLB, desktop-only. Zero AI dependency for the whole workstream = zero owner-blocking, zero license risk.
- PAVING SPLIT BY TIER, grafting both paving ideas. Mobile/potato base (W3_BASE): ONE merged BufferGeometry slab reusing the existing courtyardMat (already GPU-resident, line 497) with a deterministic seeded stone-joint grid — 1 draw call, ~460 tris, 0 new materials, 0 network. Desktop lux (W3_LUX): swap in the photoreal 3-zone Voronoi opus-incertum paving GLBs (travertine/serena/sandstone) as an ADDITIVE overlay that hides the base slab. Voronoi authored via DETERMINISTIC hex-jitter clip (the Voronoi-authoring risk mitigation), never Math.random, so it is reproducible.
- REUSE MATERIALS AGGRESSIVELY — no new PBR texture SETS for the base tier (mobile eager cap = 4, already near it). Base paving reuses courtyardMat/courtyardGroundTex (line 497/496). Water reuses M.water (line 426, already animated by the fountain ripple loop). Ivy reuses the existing ivyPatch() buckets (gIvy/gIvy2/gIvy3, line 2446). Pots reuse the coppo-terracotta/roof-tile PBR set. Only the desktop-lux GLBs embed their own baked AO/normal maps inside DRACO (WEBP), which do not count against the runtime loader's eager-set ceiling.
- BRONCOURT (Block E, +68/+16.5) GETS ONLY A SCALED POZZO CLONE + one water plane, and BOTH are conditional on Block E being a solid built volume. The masterplan marks broncourt as VOID today (line 2374); a floating water plane in open air reads wrong from WP2. Gate the broncourt water behind a runtime check that Block E walls exist; on mobile, skip the broncourt pozzo clone entirely to save the draw call.
- DRAW-CALL LAW (the #1 mobile killer per doctrine): W3_BASE adds ≤3 draw calls on ALL tiers (1 merged paving+joints+well-lip, 1 pozzo GLB, 1 water plane). Potato: 0 GLBs — pozzo substituted by a merged CylinderGeometry stand-in folded into the paving batch (net still ≤3). Desktop-lux adds ≤7 more (3 Voronoi paving, 1 lavabo, 1 pots, 1 trellis merged into gTrimM, 1 PointLight). Dev-overlay console.assert on renderer.info.render.calls/triangles inside each block.
- INTEGRATION = additive async tail after the synchronous W2 geometry pass, exactly the proven bust pattern. Place procedural fallback FIRST (visible), then Promise.race([loadModel(pozzo), 3s-timeout]); on resolve set fallback.visible=false, re-apply mkPhys() to every loaded mesh material (GLTFLoader bypasses it, line 339 signature), set cast/receiveShadow, translate by HILL_Y. On reject/timeout the procedural fallback stays. This guarantees no pop before the WP2 beat and no blank frame.
- SHADOWS: paving castShadow=false always (enclosed court, sun never reaches it directly — wasting shadow-atlas space); receiveShadow=true desktop-only (guard if(!isMobileGPU())). Pozzo casts on desktop only. Bake AO into the GLBs so mobile/potato still read depth without a shadow pass. Do NOT add cortile casters to the already-fully-allocated sun shadow map.
- Z-FIGHTING & WATER: paving at HILL_Y+0.32 (verified ~2u above terrain via getHeightAt, never coplanar with tuscanTerrain). Water plane depthWrite=false per the existing pattern (line ~3281). Water UV-scroll ripple routed through a userData-tagged material EXEMPT from the per-frame material-mutation deletion sweep the W2 code performs (WS3-5 comment, line 95) — do NOT reuse a swept material for the animated ripple.
- CLEANUP: add all cortile GLB groups to the existing extraDisposables/extraGeoDisposables cleanup arrays (line 675-676) intent, but dispose the GLB cache ONLY via clearModelCache() at unmount — NEVER dispose clones. Use the pooled renderer; never open a 2nd WebGL context (iOS jetsam). Verify the two bust GLBs still decode after adding the new load path (shared stateless DRACO decoder — no conflict expected).
- EXPORT CONTRACT (all GLBs): DRACO level 6 (pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12), export_apply=True, export_yup=True, WEBP-embedded textures — NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered = silent fail). Assert GLB header magic 0x46546C67 v2 and extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression at export. Ship WEBP-in-DRACO now; KTX2 is a fast-follow once modelLoader.setKTX2Loader is wired (not required for first ship). Bake at exposure 1.0, sun matched to DirectionalLight #FFB870 at [-20,18,-30]; albedo to palette canon (TRAVERTINE #E8DCC0/#E3D6BC, coppo #B0725A, iron #2A2620).
- PRIORITY: this ENTIRE workstream is deferred behind the front-face heroes (dome ribs WS1, drum windows WS2, capitals WS3, balustrades WS4, tazza fountain WS5). It is the correct place to spend draw calls that don't touch the front-face budget, but it earns nothing at the money shots — build it only after the visible heroes are in and profiling clean, or when an interactive fly-around mode ships.

**Assets:**
- **public/models/exterior/cortile_pozzo.glb** — Scripted bpy (no AI). SCREW modifier on an octagonal urn-profile curve (flared moulded rim/ovolo → tapered shaft → astragal → foot flare), 8 segments; 3 recessed panels on alternating faces via inset+extrude; wrought-iron bifurcated crane arm authored as bezier S-curve → convert-to-mesh with mirror ARRAY, axle drum cylinder, and a helical-curve rope baked to tube; crane top reaches world y≈12.6 to clear Block C parapet for WP2 silhouette. Interior = black material, no depth write. smart_project island_margin=0.02, UV0 only. Bake AO (Cycles GPU, ~32-64 samp, cage). 2 material slots max (travertine albedo #E3D6BC + iron #2A2620 rough 0.65 metal 0.82). · ~900 tris (≤2 material slots). Desktop+mobile: GLB. Potato: skip GLB, merged CylinderGeometry stand-in in paving batch. · Embedded WEBP-in-DRACO: pozzo_ao + pozzo_nor_gl (1k). Travertine albedo/roughness reuse existing M.trim family at runtime via mkPhys. File ≤320KB compressed (≤50KB if authored ultra-lean per perf brief).
- **public/models/exterior/cortile_paving_travertine.glb (+ _serena.glb, _sandstone.glb)** — DESKTOP-LUX ONLY. Scripted bpy opus-incertum: deterministic hex-jitter point grid (index-seeded, NO Math.random — Voronoi-risk mitigation) clipped to the ~15×16 court rectangle → ~120 irregular polys extruded 0.12wu, split into 3 albedo zones (worn travertine inner / pietra-serena mid / sandstone outer margin), grout gaps 0.015wu. smart_project island_margin=0.02, UV0. Bake shared AO atlas (inter-slab grout shadow). Merge one GLB per zone. Overlays and hides the base courtyardMat slab when W3_LUX. · ~8k tris total across 3 GLBs (~3k/2.5k/2.5k). Desktop only. · Baked AO into embedded WEBP; albedo/roughness reuse existing sandstone/travertine sets. ~180KB each.

Scripted bpy: beveled wall plate; lower scallop tazza via SCREW from an 8-lobe bezier profile + boolean-subtract bowl hollow; mascaron = SIMPLIFIED BOX-BOOLEAN stand-in (extruded oval + nostril/brow booleans) — NO Hunyuan3D; water-jet arc bezier tube; flat basin water plane using a 512 Ocean-modifier-baked ripple normal with UV-scroll (routed through mutation-sweep-exempt userData material). · ~1.8k tris. Placed at trellis pilaster bases. · ~600 tris. Desktop only. · NONE new — reuses existing coppo-terracotta/roof-tile PBR set. ~40KB GLB.
- **Base cortile paving + stone-joint grid + well lip + broncourt water-lip (INLINE, no GLB)** — Inline Three.js BufferGeometry merged into ONE mesh reusing courtyardMat (line 497). ~28×20 slab at (x≈+12, y=HILL_Y+0.32, z≈+15); deterministic seeded joint grid (5 longitudinal + 3 lateral proud strips) via (i*7+j*13)%17 pattern in existing M.trim geometry pushed into the same batch; circular stone well-lip + broncourt lip merged in. courtyardGroundTex.repeat.set(3.5,2.5). · ~460 tris, 1 draw call, ALL tiers. 0 new materials, 0 network. · NONE new — reuses courtyardGroundTex (line 496) + M.trim.

**Blender MCP tools:** mcp__blender__execute_blender_code (100% of authoring — all assets scripted bpy: SCREW/curve lathe, ARRAY, boolean, smart_project UV, Cycles bake, DRACO export), mcp__blender__get_scene_info + mcp__blender__get_object_info (validate tri counts pre-export against budgets), mcp__blender__get_viewport_screenshot (visual QA of pozzo silhouette at WP2-equivalent angle), mcp__blender__download_polyhaven_asset (CC0 travertine/terracotta reference textures ONLY if a bake source is needed — not geometry), EXPLICITLY NOT USED: Hunyuan3D / Rodin / Hyper3D (both DISABLED; mascaron authored as box-boolean stand-in, zero AI dependency = zero owner-blocking, zero license risk), Sketchfab (disabled + NC/ND license risk)

**Production steps:**

Via execute_blender_code: octagonal urn-profile curve (flared ovolo rim → tapered shaft → astragal → foot flare), SCREW 8 segments; 3 recessed panels on alternating faces via inset+extrude; wrought-iron bifurcated crane arm as bezier S-curve → convert-to-mesh + mirror ARRAY, axle drum cylinder, helical rope baked to tube. ### WS12 — Water features: parterre pools + fountains

*Reflective water planes, cascades, spouting fountains, wet-stone edges (per moodboard m1 water parterre).*

**Summary:** WS12 water kit: author two scripted-bpy travertine fountain GLBs (hero parterre + courtyard tiered), each joined to one mesh/one material and DRACO-compressed, that REPLACE the stacked-cylinder procedural fountains behind flag3d('w3_exterior') while all water surfaces stay procedural; net exterior draw calls go DOWN and mobile stays under budget.
**Priority `P1` · ~4.5d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Synthesize the three briefs into ONE perf-first hybrid, resolving the central tradeoff decisively: GLB the STONE (where Blender lathe/screw yields a 1000x readability jump per byte), keep the WATER PROCEDURAL (Three.js transparent planes stay in existing material buckets — zero extra translucent passes, zero RTT, transparency + shimmer + GPU-tier branching preserved). This is Brief 3's hybrid spine, hardened with Brief 2's perf discipline (single-mesh/single-material GLB = 1 draw call each; shared travertine atlas; potato early-return) and enriched with the strongest Brief 1 fidelity moves that survive the mobile budget (scalloped fluted tazza, 4 baked-normal mascaron spouts, octagonal-not-round pedestal, gadrooned lower profile). We author TWO scripted-bpy GLBs — a hero parterre tazza fountain (the ONE water feature on the -Z arrival axis, visible at WP1/WP3/WP5 and the d=118 tympanum beat) and a courtyard tiered fountain (WP4/free-orbit only) — plus reuse a single flat basin-coping GLB for the rectangular pools. All water surfaces (parterre disc, courtyard tiers, impluvium, channel, terrace pools) remain the exact procedural MeshStandardMaterial planes already in the scene. The photoreal cascade catena d'acqua and any transmission/RTT water are explicitly DEFERRED (WS12b) — they are the highest-risk, lowest-arrival-value-per-frame items and they threaten iOS WKWebView context stability. Net effect: the two most camera-proximate fountains go from 'stack of cylinders' to 'carved Renaissance fountain' while the mobile draw-call budget IMPROVES (GLBs REPLACE ~11 + ~30 procedural calls with 1-2 each). Gate everything behind flag3d('w3_exterior') (W3 = W2 && flag), procedural fallback stays visible on load-fail/slow-net/potato.

**Design decisions:**
- WATER STAYS PROCEDURAL — reject all three briefs' GLB water planes. Verified in code: fountainWater (line 574), waterMat (line 939, reused at impluvium line 1419 + channel line 1513), courtyard M.water, terrace pool (line 4110) are the ONLY per-frame mutations and already carry canon palette + sky-tint from procedural PMREM. A GLB water mesh forces an extra translucent sort pass and risks MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission (Brief 1) causing WKWebView context loss on A-series chips. Keep them as-is; just re-tune color/roughness/opacity in place. This is the single biggest risk-removal decision.
- STONE BECOMES GLB — take Brief 3's two-fountain scope over Brief 1's five-asset scope and Brief 2's basin-heavy scope. The perceived-quality ROI is concentrated in the two fountains on/near the arrival axis. Author fountain_parterre.glb (hero, replaces lines 575-580) and fountain_tiered.glb (courtyard, replaces the fountainSafe block ~3198+).
- GLB IS SINGLE-MESH / SINGLE-MATERIAL (Brief 2 discipline) — join ALL stone geometry per fountain into ONE object before export (bpy.ops.object.join). One draw call per fountain after load. Do NOT export the water disc inside the GLB (Brief 3 wanted a water submesh; reject it to avoid the translucent pass). The procedural water disc is rebuilt unconditionally in Three.js on top of the GLB at the same y.
- SHARED TRAVERTINE ATLAS, ZERO NEW EAGER SETS — reuse the existing /textures/pbr/travertine set for albedo (already eager-loaded). Bake ONLY per-fountain normal+AO maps into that same folder (fountain_parterre_nor_gl_1k.jpg / _ao_1k.jpg; fountain_tiered_nor_gl_1k.jpg / _ao_1k.jpg), lazy-loaded on DESKTOP ONLY after mount, never counted against the mobile eager cap of 4. On mobile the GLB uses the shared travertine diff/rough + a uniform mkPhys — the baked mascaron/dolphin relief is desktop-only enrichment, not a load-bearing requirement.
- MOBILE LOD BY SEPARATE FILE (Brief 3 over Brief 1/2's in-GLB LOD) — modelLoader.ts has NO LOD extension registered, so ship fountain_parterre_lod1.glb / fountain_tiered_lod1.glb and pick path once at mount by GPU tier. Simpler and decoder-safe.
- POTATO EARLY-RETURN (Brief 2) — if potato tier, skip ALL loadModel calls, keep procedural. Courtyard tiered fountain additionally skipped on mobile entirely (it's occluded at WP3-WP5; only reads at WP4/free-orbit — not worth 2 mobile draw calls). Parterre fountain loads on desktop+mobile, skips potato.
- DISPOSE-AFTER-SWAP, NOT SKIP-ON-CONSTRUCT — build procedural fountain unconditionally, then geometry.dispose() the replaced procedural meshes ONLY inside the loadModel .then() after success. Guarantees no gap on slow-net/load-fail. GLB group added with visible=false, flipped true in the resolve callback to avoid pop-in flash.
- DEFER CASCADE + BASSINS + RTT (WS12b) — Brief 1's catena d'acqua cascade_channel, parterre_bassins, and all transmission/IOR/caustic-animation water are deferred. They are desktop-only, high-tri, high-risk, and not on the primary read axis. Mark // TODO WS12b at the terrace-stair block. Keep WS12 shippable to iOS.
- MATCH BLENDER SUN EXACTLY — bake AO/normal with Blender sun energy 3.2, color #FFB870, azimuth ~213 / elevation ~28 (Three.js DirectionalLight [-20,18,-30]); bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 once). Water disc set receiveShadow=false; only stone castShadow=true.
- DRACO-ONLY, NEVER MESHOPT — export level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12, export_apply, export_yup, no embedded textures (albedo from shared atlas). Assert GLB magic 0x46546C67 v2 + KHR_draco_mesh_compression at export. Preload dracoLoader in the W3 async block (exterior has no bust GLBs to warm the decoder).

- **public/models/exterior/fountain_tiered_lod1.glb (mobile LOD — but NOT loaded on mobile; kept for completeness/free-orbit desktop-low)** — SCREW steps halved, scallop hemispheres removed (baked as bump into AO), dolphin panels flat. Same material slot. Note: runtime SKIPS this on mobile+potato entirely (occluded at primary waypoints); loads only on desktop-low tier if present. · ~1,600 tris · Shared travertine only.
- **public/models/exterior/basin_coping.glb (OPTIONAL reuse — flat rectangular coping ring)** — Scripted bpy: cube scaled to coping ring, Boolean-subtract inner void, Bevel modifier (2 seg, 0.06) on top edges, one loop-cut inset panel on outer face. One mesh, one material (shared travertine). ~400 tris, no LOD needed. Instanced/cloned via loadModel cache for the courtyard rectangular pool + impluvium liner IF those procedural box surrounds read poorly at review. Lower priority than the two fountains; ship only if budget/time allows after fountains verify clean on iOS. · ~400 tris · Shared travertine atlas, no new bake (UVs share existing island space).

**Blender MCP tools:** mcp__blender__execute_blender_code (primary - all scripted bpy: SCREW/BMesh profiles, join, smart_project UV0, Cycles GPU bake, DRACO GLB export, header assert), mcp__blender__get_scene_info + mcp__blender__get_object_info (verify mesh/material/tri counts pre-export), mcp__blender__get_viewport_screenshot (visual QA of each fountain at front -Z angle before bake), mcp__blender__download_polyhaven_asset (ONLY if a CC0 travertine reference is needed to tune procedural veining bake; not required - travertine albedo already authored), NOT USED: Rodin/Hunyuan (fountains are deterministic lathe geometry, generative would mangle profiles); Sketchfab (disabled + NC/ND license risk); set_texture (albedo comes from existing atlas)

**Production steps:**
1. 0. PROBE Blender: via execute_blender_code confirm a Cycles GPU device is enumerable + a trivial bake writes non-blank pixels, AND a 1-tri GLB exports with KHR_draco_mesh_compression in extensionsUsed (assert header bytes). Abort authoring if either fails.

Author 2D bezier half-profile with y=0 at BASIN FLOOR: plinth r=3.3 y=0 -> basin wall in to r=3.1 y=0.8 -> internal ledge r=2.7 y=0.85. RESOLVE ledge-vs-water mismatch: procedural water sits at world HILL_Y+0.62 (basin center HILL_Y+0.4), so author the internal ledge at Blender-y 0.22 (=world HILL_Y+0.62) NOT y=0.85, so the rebuilt water disc rests flush on the ledge. Continue: pedestal octagonal waist r=0.5 y=1.1 gadrooned shoulder -> tazza rim flare r=1.3 y=1.85 -> stem r=0.18-0.28 -> gilt finial stub. SCREW modifier steps=48.

7. 6. PARTERRE mobile LOD: re-run SCREW at steps=16, drop fluting+mascaron+gadrooning, keep silhouette. Same UV/material slot. Export -> fountain_parterre_lod1.glb (~1.1k, no baked maps). Assert header + <=500KB.

UV-sphere finial. 4 dolphin/putti relief panels (0.6x0.8x0.04 boxes) on middle pedestal carrying a NORMAL-only bake from a quick ~5k Dynatopo dolphin sculpt.
9. 8. TIERED join+UV+bake+export: join to one mesh/one material, smart_project UV0, bake nor_gl+ao -> fountain_tiered_{nor_gl,ao}_1k.jpg, export DRACO -> fountain_tiered.glb (~4.8k). Also export fountain_tiered_lod1.glb (SCREW halved, scallops baked to AO, dolphins flat, ~1.6k) for desktop-low completeness (NOT loaded on mobile).

11. 10. Integrate parterre (lines 575-580) then tiered (fountainSafe block ~3198) per integrationSteps.

**Poly budget:** desktop ~8k tris total (parterre ~3.2k + tiered ~4.8k); each fountain joined to one mesh = 1 draw call. Far under the 150-200k exterior-GLB desktop budget. · mobile ~1.1k tris (parterre_lod1 only; tiered fountain NOT loaded on mobile/potato). Adds 1 GLB draw call vs the 15 mobile-GLB cap and REPLACES 6 procedural meshes, so net calls drop.
**Texture maps:** Shared travertine _diff (eager, existing) - albedo, all tiers, Shared travertine _rough (eager, existing) - roughness, all tiers, fountain_parterre_nor_gl_1k.jpg (desktop lazy, OpenGL/Blender normal convention), fountain_parterre_ao_1k.jpg (desktop lazy, aoMap.channel=0, aoMapIntensity 0.65), fountain_tiered_nor_gl_1k.jpg (desktop lazy), fountain_tiered_ao_1k.jpg (desktop lazy), No per-fountain albedo bake (shared travertine diff carries color on all tiers) @ 1k JPG (bake at 2048, downsample to 1024). Albedo+rough reused from the existing shared /textures/pbr/travertine eager set (ZERO new eager sets). Per-fountain baked nor_gl + ao at 1k are DESKTOP-ONLY lazy loads, invisible to the mobile eager cap of 4.
**Export:** glTF 2.0 GLB, export_apply=True, export_yup=True. DRACO: export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=True, level=6, position quant=14, normal=10, uv=12, generic=12. Textures NOT embedded (albedo from shared atlas). Bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 once). Blender sun matches DirectionalLight [-20,18,-30]: energy 3.2, color #FFB870, azimuth ~213 / elevation ~28. Assert GLB header at export: magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed contains KHR_draco_mesh_compression. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered). KTX2 explicitly OUT of scope (public/basis/ transcoder dir is absent -> would 404 and silently fall back to JPG).
**Target path:** `public/models/exterior/ (fountain_parterre.glb, fountain_parterre_lod1.glb, fountain_tiered.glb, fountain_tiered_lod1.glb); baked maps under public/textures/pbr/travertine/`

**Integration:**
- Read W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior') ONCE at top of the scene useEffect alongside W1/W2. Read getGPUTier() once at mount.
- PARTERRE: keep building the procedural fountain (lines 575-580) UNCONDITIONALLY as fallback. Then, if (W3 && getGPUTier() !== 'potato'): call preloadDraco(); pick path = getGPUTier()==='desktop' ? '/models/exterior/fountain_parterre.glb' : '/models/exterior/fountain_parterre_lod1.glb'; fire an async IIFE AFTER the synchronous geometry pass.
- In the .then(): g.position.set(0, HILL_Y+0.4, -35) (Blender origin at basin floor = world HILL_Y+0.4). g.visible=false initially. Create ONE shared mkPhys MeshStandardMaterial ({color:'#E8DCC0', roughness:0.72, metalness:0}) and assign to ALL stone children (REPLACE the GLTF material, do not mutate - mkPhys must strip Physical on mobile). castShadow=true, receiveShadow=true on stone. On desktop only: attach material.normalMap=parterre_nor, material.aoMap=parterre_ao with aoMap.channel=0 + aoMapIntensity=0.65. scene.add(g); then g.visible=true in the same resolve tick to avoid pop-in.
- After GLB resolves: geometry.dispose() the 6 replaced procedural meshes (basin/water/pedestal/tazza/stem/finial). Rebuild ONE procedural water disc = CylinderGeometry(2.7,2.7,0.45,20) with the existing fountainWater material at y=HILL_Y+0.62, receiveShadow=false, ON TOP of the GLB (water stays procedural, no translucent GLB submesh).
- catch: leave procedural fountain intact, console.warn. On slow-net the procedural fallback carries the 18s dolly and swaps silently.
- COURTYARD: same pattern inside the fountainSafe block (~3198) but gate to getGPUTier()==='desktop' ONLY (mobile/potato keep procedural). CRITICAL: position the GLB at the RUNTIME-RESOLVED fX,fZ from the collision loop (lines 3191-3194), NOT a hardcoded coord, inside courtyardGroup (y=HILL_Y+0.3). Re-anchor the rebuilt procedural water tiers (fW1/fW2/fW3) to the same fX,fZ with M.water re-applied.
- Use ONLY the shared loader from modelLoader.ts (never a 2nd GLTFLoader / 2nd WebGL context - iOS jetsam). clearModelCache() at unmount is already wired; never dispose clones mid-life.
- Reduced-motion (WP1/WP3/WP5 stills): parterre reads with baked AO alone, no emissive/bloom dependency. Optional 300ms await before cinematic start (same pattern as bust GLBs) so the swap lands before the WP3 tympanum beat.
- Adaptive-governor safety: async loads land AFTER the 2.5s warmup skip, so they never enter the first-15s measurement window (no demotion risk). A mid-session mobile->potato demotion will NOT unload the resident parterre_lod1 (~1.1k, shared atlas) - confirmed potato-safe to keep resident (QA gate).

**LOD tiers:**
- Desktop: fountain_parterre.glb (~3.2k, fluting+mascaron+gadrooning, baked nor/ao) + fountain_tiered.glb (~4.8k, scallop rims + dolphin relief panels, baked nor/ao)
- Mobile: fountain_parterre_lod1.glb (~1.1k, SCREW steps 16, silhouette only, shared travertine only, NO baked maps); tiered fountain SKIPPED entirely
- Potato: early-return before any loadModel call; keep 100% procedural fountains

Exterior ships NO bust GLB so the decoder is COLD on first fountain load., mobilePerf.ts: import getGPUTier into ExteriorScene (currently only getQuality/mkPhys/isMobileGPU imported). getGPUTier IS already exported and returns 'potato'|'mobile'|'desktop'., flags3d.ts: no change - flag3d('w3_exterior') works as-is (staging ON / prod OFF, ?flag3d override)., BLENDER CAPABILITY PROBE (hard blocker, run before authoring): (1) enumerate a Cycles GPU device and run a 1-tri test bake asserting non-blank pixels; (2) export a 1-tri test GLB with draco enabled and assert KHR_draco_mesh_compression in extensionsUsed. If libdraco is absent, export silently produces UNCOMPRESSED GLB (loads fine but blows the 500KB wire budget) - fix the Blender build; meshopt fallback is NOT allowed., Shared /textures/pbr/travertine set must exist and be eager-loaded (verified it is the runtime albedo source)., Independent of other workstreams; WS12b (catena d'acqua cascade, parterre bassins, transmission/RTT water, basin_coping.glb reuse) is explicitly DEFERRED and needs owner sign-off.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: low
- iOS risk: low
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: dracoLoader.preload() referenced but not exported from modelLoader.ts — code will not compile as written
- Blocker: Cold DRACO decoder on exterior (no warming bust GLB) — pop-in on first resolve; needs preload export or accepted fallback
- Blocker: Blender Draco-export capability is UNVERIFIED and is the single point of failure for the whole ≤500KB/asset wire budget — must probe libdraco presence + valid KHR_draco_mesh_compression header before authoring
- Blocker: Cycles GPU bake headless via execute_blender_code is unverified — must probe a device is enumerable and a test bake writes non-blank pixels before committing to baked normal/AO enrichment
- Blocker: Water-disc height vs authored basin ledge height are inconsistent between the two briefs (HILL_Y+0.62 water vs HILL_Y+1.25 ledge) — resolve the SCREW profile before bake
- Blocker: Courtyard GLB placement must bind to runtime-resolved fX,fZ (collision loop), not a hardcoded coord
- Fix: modelLoader.ts has NO exported preload for the DRACO decoder — `dracoLoader` is module-private (lines 5-9). The plan's `dracoLoader.preload()` in the W3 block will not compile. The exterior scene ships NO bust GLBs, so the decoder is COLD on first fountain load; the first loadModel triggers a ~200-400KB WASM+JS decoder fetch/init before any mesh appears. FIX: add `export function preloadDraco(){ dracoLoader.preload(); }` to modelLoader.ts and call it at mount, OR accept the cold-start (procedural fallback carries the dolly, so pop-in-on-resolve is the only symptom). Do NOT instantiate a 2nd DRACOLoader.
- Fix: modelLoader.loadModel() unconditionally sets castShadow=true AND receiveShadow=true on every mesh (lines 30-33), and returns a single shared cached Group cloned per call. The plan's per-material mkPhys re-assignment must run in the caller's .then() traverse (correct), but note GLTFLoader materials must be REPLACED not mutated for mkPhys to take effect on mobile — assign one shared mkPhys MeshStandardMaterial instance to all children as the plan says, else you inherit the GLB's baked-in material and mobile gets no Physical-strip.
- Fix: Scene imports only getQuality/mkPhys/isMobileGPU (ExteriorScene.tsx line 21) — NOT getGPUTier. The plan's `getGPUTier()!=='potato'` and desktop/mobile LOD-path branching require adding getGPUTier to that import. Trivial, but the plan's stated open question is answered: getGPUTier() IS exported from mobilePerf.ts and returns 'potato'|'mobile'|'desktop' — use it as the LOD discriminator and the potato early-return gate.
- Fix: iOS FORCE-MOBILE-PATH guard is mandatory and the plan's own note is right but must be enforced: getGPUTier() returns 'mobile' (not 'desktop') for Capacitor iOS via isCapacitorIOS (mobilePerf.ts lines 58-61), so the desktop-LOD path is already excluded on iOS — GOOD. But the adaptive governor (lines 295-324) can demote mobile→potato after 15s; if a device is demoted, the ALREADY-LOADED desktop/mobile GLB stays in memory (governor demotes presets, not meshes). Ensure the potato early-return is evaluated at MOUNT from getGPUTier(), and accept that a mid-session demotion won't unload the fountain GLB — verify the mobile-LOD fountain (~1.1k tris, shared atlas) is potato-safe to keep resident. It is, but state it as a QA gate.
- Fix: BAKE-TO-DRACO PRODUCTION RISK (the real #3 uncertainty): the plan assumes execute_blender_code can (a) run a Cycles GPU selected-to-active NORMAL+AO bake with a cage headlessly, and (b) export a VALID KHR_draco_mesh_compression GLB. Blender's glTF Draco export requires the libdraco shared lib to be present in THIS Blender build — if absent, export_draco silently produces an UNCOMPRESSED GLB that still loads (DRACOLoader passes through non-Draco meshes) but blows the ≤500KB/asset wire budget. FIX/GATE: before authoring, run a probe via execute_blender_code that (1) confirms a Cycles-capable GPU device is enumerable and a trivial bake writes non-blank pixels, and (2) exports a 1-tri test GLB with export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=True and asserts the header bytes contain KHR_draco_mesh_compression in extensionsUsed. If the assert fails, the whole DRACO premise collapses — fall back to meshopt is NOT allowed (no MeshoptDecoder registered), so you MUST fix the Blender build or ship low-poly uncompressed within budget.
- Fix: public/basis/ transcoder dir does NOT exist — any KTX2 fast-follow (build:ktx2) will 404 the transcoder and KTX2 silently falls back to JPG. This is safe (manifest-gated, plan defers KTX2) but the plan's 'wire loader.setKTX2Loader for GLB-embedded KTX2' line is a NO-OP until /basis/ ships. Keep KTX2 OUT of scope for WS12 (baked maps are desktop-only JPG); do not add the setKTX2Loader wiring now.
- Fix: Water-disc rebuild coordinate/height must be re-derived, not copied: the parterre procedural fountain sits at world (0, HILL_Y+0.4, -35) with water at HILL_Y+0.62 (ExteriorScene.tsx lines 574-576). The GLB origin must be authored at the BASIN BASE (y=0 in Blender = HILL_Y+0.4 in world) so g.position.set(0,HILL_Y+0.4,-35) lands flush; author the SCREW profile with y=0 at basin floor. The rebuilt procedural water CylinderGeometry(2.7,2.7,0.45,20) at y=HILL_Y+0.62 must match the GLB's internal ledge height (plan says r=2.7 y=0.85 ledge → world HILL_Y+1.25, which is ABOVE the stated water y=HILL_Y+0.62). RESOLVE the ledge-vs-water-height mismatch in the profile before baking or water floats/sinks.
- Fix: Courtyard fountain world coords are DYNAMIC: fX,fZ are chosen at runtime from a collision-avoidance loop (lines 3191-3194, default 0,-28 but can become 18,-18 etc.), inside courtyardGroup at y=HILL_Y+0.3. The GLB must be positioned at the RESOLVED (fX,fZ), not a hardcoded coord, and the rebuilt procedural water tiers (fW1/fW2/fW3 at lines 3207+) must be re-anchored to the same resolved coords. The plan's 'confirm mapping' open question is a genuine blocker for flush placement — wire the GLB position to the same fX,fZ,fountainSafe variables.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Both fountains load behind flag3d('w3_exterior'): visible with ?flag3d=w3_exterior, absent on prod hostnames by default.
- [ ] renderer.info.render.calls does NOT increase after W3 loads vs W2 (parterre GLB = 1 stone call replacing 6 procedural; net <=0). Courtyard GLB = 1 call replacing ~30 procedural on desktop, skipped on mobile.
- [ ] Desktop total exterior GLB tris <=200k; mobile-LOD path <=60k; measured via dev overlay.
- [ ] Each shipped GLB is DRACO-compressed: header asserts magic 0x46546C67 v2 + KHR_draco_mesh_compression in extensionsUsed, and each file is <=500KB over the wire.
- [ ] No new eager PBR set: mobile eager texture count stays at its cap of 4; baked nor/ao load ONLY on desktop, after mount.
- [ ] Rebuilt procedural water disc sits flush on the authored internal ledge (world HILL_Y+0.62) with no float/sink gap; water surface remains the existing procedural fountainWater/M.water material (no GLB water submesh, no transmission, no RTT).
- [ ] Courtyard GLB and its procedural water tiers sit flush at the runtime-resolved fX,fZ for every collision-loop outcome (test at least [0,-28] and [18,-18]).
- [ ] Potato tier: zero loadModel calls fired; fountains render 100% procedural with no shadows/env-map dependency.
- [ ] iOS Capacitor WKWebView: ~60fps sustained through the 18s dolly with W3 on; no context loss; getGPUTier()==='mobile' path taken (parterre_lod1, single mkPhys material, no baked maps).
- [ ] Load-fail / slow-net: procedural fountain stays visible for the full dolly; GLB swaps in with no visible pop (visible flipped only on resolve); no gap frame.
- [ ] Reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 render the parterre fountain correctly using baked AO alone (no emissive/bloom reliance).

### WS13 — Formal garden: buxus parterres, gravel, benches

*Clipped box hedges, geometric parterres, gravel textures, marble benches, planted urns.*

**Summary:** WS13 Giardino all'Italiana: 6 scripted-bpy garden GLBs (fountain 2-LOD, urn, bench, buxus ball+strip, baluster) streamed via new loadInstanced+preloadDraco helpers behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), net-at-or-below W2 draw calls, sampling the EXISTING /textures/pbr/travertine set (zero new mobile texture set), fresh-material rebuild to avoid clone-cache poisoning.
**Priority `P2` · ~6d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Transform the foreground formal-garden terrace (HILL_Y=8, cross-axis z≈-23..-47) from flat-box hedges, stacked-cylinder fountain, box benches and sphere topiary into a sculpted giardino all'italiana — carved travertine tazza fountain, lathe-turned Renaissance urns, volute marble benches, clipped-buxus parterres and gravel/paving that read as real crushed stone — WITHOUT breaking mobile/iOS 60fps and WITHOUT touching any W2 procedural path. The winning synthesis is the HYBRID lens taken to photoreal on the three hero set-pieces (fountain, urns, bench) while the perf-first lens governs everything repeated (buxus, balusters, gravel): repeated elements become InstancedMesh or shared-material merges so the W3 draw-call count LANDS AT OR BELOW W2 (~5-7 vs ~9), and unique pieces become single-material merged GLBs. Fidelity is carried by baked AO/normal on 512-1k textures, not by triangle count. The whole system is additive behind W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'): on flag-off, load-fail, or potato tier the untouched procedural geometry stands in. Every hero asset is authored correct at exactly WP3 (front-on d=118 tympanum beat — the single most-read frame) and WP4/WP5 (close dolly), which is where the forecourt garden and its balustrade rail read.

**Design decisions:**
- LENS = HYBRID, resolved explicitly: photoreal-max ONLY on the 3 hero set-pieces at the dolly beats (fountain, urns, bench); perf-first governs every REPEATED element (buxus balls, hedge strips, balusters) via InstancedMesh so draw-calls never regress. Rejected 'photoreal-max everywhere' brief (parterre_tile.glb ×4 + path_flags + full urn/bench set) because it risks the +draw-call and double-render traps on the mobile tier that is 'already near 150 calls'.
- DRAW-CALL DISCIPLINE is the #1 mobile lever, not tri count (governor demotes on frame-time, decode jank in first 15s). Net W3 desktop target: ~6 garden draw-calls REPLACING ~9 procedural = net saving. Repeated pieces MUST be InstancedMesh (one call for N) or merged-per-material; NEVER 4× scene.add of the same clone. Add a loadInstanced(path, matrices[]) helper to modelLoader.ts (~20 lines: loadModel once, traverse to first Mesh geo+mat, build InstancedMesh, set matrices, dispose the source clone).
- NO DOUBLE-RENDER: restructure the procedural garden block from `if(W2){...garden...}` to `if(W2 && !W3){...procedural...}` and add a parallel `if(W3){ await GLB loads }` arm. The W3 async arm MUST await all loadModel promises (Promise.allSettled) BEFORE scene.add so there is no single-frame flash of procedural. Alternative safe pattern for meshes that are hard to gate: build procedural but set visible=false, flip back in the GLB catch() so a load failure re-shows the fallback.
- mkPhys RE-APPLY is mandatory after every loadModel: GLTFLoader bypasses mkPhys(), so traverse each returned Group and rebuild/normalize each MeshStandardMaterial (color/roughness/metalness from canon M.* constants, strip clearcoat/sheen/transmission, set reduced envMapIntensity on mobile). Prefer rebuilding from canon M.trim/M.marble constants over trusting GLB-embedded material JSON (avoids embedded-texture inflation + guarantees the mobile contract).
- TIER GATING: Desktop = full set (fountain LOD0, urns InstancedMesh, bench ×2, buxus ball + hedge-strip InstancedMesh, balusters InstancedMesh, buxus PBR atlas). Mobile/iOS = fountain LOD1 + urn InstancedMesh + balusters InstancedMesh ONLY (≤2-3 decorative GLBs per doctrine); buxus + bench + path stay procedural; buxus normal/rough textures skipped (diffuse only or color-only). Potato = ZERO garden GLBs; every procedural fallback stands. isMobileQ = isMobileGPU(); isPotatoQ = Q.shadowMapSize===0.
- FOUNTAIN is the one hero loaded on ALL non-potato tiers (highest single-asset ROI on cross-axis, front-on at WP3/WP4/WP5). Ship 2 LODs: fountain_carved.glb (LOD0 ~2.2-3k tris desktop) + fountain_carved_lod1.glb (~1.4-1.7k tris mobile, flutes removed from geometry but kept in baked normal). Runtime picks by tier; if lod1 404s the catch falls back to PROCEDURAL fountain, NOT lod0 (lod0 would blow the mobile budget).
- WATER stays a runtime Three.js plane (CircleGeometry + MeshStandardMaterial, transparent opacity≈0.82, animated), NEVER embedded in the GLB — reuses the existing water code path and lets mkPhys strip transmission on mobile. Fountain GLB contains basin+pedestal+tazza+finial as ONE merged single-material travertine mesh.
- TEXTURE-SET REUSE to protect the mobile eager cap of 4 sets: author the fountain+urn+baluster travertine to REUSE the existing stoneTex/M.trim PBR atlas at runtime (bake into a shared travertine UV atlas) rather than shipping a new 'travertine' set. Only NEW sets: buxus (512, desktop-only normal/rough) and marble_bench (1k, desktop-only). Net new mobile texture sets = 0; net new desktop GPU texture ≈ ≤5MB (well inside 140MB WKWebView ceiling).
- GRAVEL + HEDGE are material-only upgrades (zero geometry, zero new draw-calls, no Blender GLB): under W3 re-tune parterreGravelMat (repeat [4,4]→[3,3] for the 34m carpet so tiles don't smear at WP3, normalScale .6→.85, aoMapIntensity .3→.55, envMapIntensity→0 since gravel is matte) and apply a shared baked buxus normal/AO to M.hedge/M.hedgeL (desktop only). Gravel geometry Y stays EXACTLY put (respect the existing z-fight step mitigation at the carpet body).
- BLENDER ROUTING: all geometry is SCRIPTED BPY (deterministic, re-bakeable, tiny, instanceable) — lathe/SCREW on bezier profiles for fountain/urn/baluster/finial, box+bevel+solidify for bench, displace-modifier spheres/boxes for buxus. Polyhaven = CC0 texture/HDRI REFERENCE only, author-time, never shipped raw (re-bake to canon albedo to avoid color drift). Generative (Hunyuan3D/Rodin) is OPTIONAL for the 4 lion-head mascaron spouts only, with a bevelled-boss bpy substitute if generative is disabled — never block the plan on it. The plan's 'traverse each returned Group and rebuild/normalize each MeshStandardMaterial' would mutate the shared cached material, poisoning every subsequent clone (including the bust GLBs if they ever share a material). FIX: in the W3 arm, construct BRAND-NEW materials from canon M.* constants and ASSIGN them (mesh.material = fresh), never mutate the traversed material in place. FIX: loadInstanced must extract geo+mat by reference for the InstancedMesh but must NOT dispose the clone's geometry/material (they belong to the cache); only drop the empty clone Group. Add a unit assertion that the two bust GLBs still load after garden GLBs (shared decoder + shared-material canary).

If instanceMesh.castShadow=true on desktop, the shadow pass adds a second draw of the full instanced batch (2 calls, not 1) and 140+22 instanced shadow volumes — measurable on the shadow map. Confirm castShadow policy per instanced batch against the dev-overlay renderer.info.render.calls BEFORE claiming net-at-or-below-W2.

### WS14 — Cypress avenue + trees

*High-fidelity cypress + olive/oak; card-vs-3D LOD, wind, the avenue leading the dolly up the hill.*

**Summary:** WS14 ships a Blender-authored 3-LOD DRACO cypress GLB (plus olive hero + stone-pine impostor) that REPLACES the four canonical geometries feeding the verified W2 InstancedMesh path in ExteriorScene.tsx (lines 4175-4179), gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior'); mobile/potato get a single-draw-call billboard impostor and there is a hard try/catch fallback to the untouched W2 Lathe path.
**Priority `P1` · ~4d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Turn the exterior's weakest-reading foliage layer — a smooth LatheGeometry "bullet" cypress, sphere-on-stick olives, and dinner-plate stone pines — into a genuine Cupressus sempervirens avenue that the 18s dolly climbs, plus gnarled Olea europaea and umbrella-pine silhouettes, WITHOUT adding a single net draw call on mobile. The synthesis is deliberately HYBRID-first: keep every procedural system that already works (the W2 InstancedMesh bucket infrastructure, cypressNear/cypressFar collectors, seed-based band routing, setInstances() helper, terrain height sampling, atmosphere colour, governor tier-pruning) and replace ONLY the canonical geometry fed to those InstancedMesh constructors. Desktop gets a 3-LOD Blender-authored cypress GLB (hi ribs+cross-quad foliage → mid merged shell → far tapered column) driven by the existing per-instance distance data; mobile/potato get a single baked billboard-impostor InstancedMesh (1 draw call for the whole avenue+ring) — zero GLB decode on the binding iOS/WKWebView tier. Wind reuses grassShader.ts's exact time-uniform pattern through a new shared foliageWind.ts ref so field and tree sway stay phase-coherent. Everything is additive behind a fresh flag3d('w3_exterior') with a hard try/catch fallback to the untouched W2 LatheGeometry path, so a 404/DRACO-fail/cold-decoder is a visual no-op, never a regression. Net result at the three reduced-motion still beats (WP1/WP3/WP5) and every dolly waypoint: a real columnar cypress silhouette with bark, foliage depth and tip-sway against the golden-hour sky — the single highest perceived-quality jump in the foliage layer, shipped inside the mobile budget.

**Design decisions:**
- HYBRID over PHOTOREAL-MAX as the spine: reject the photoreal brief's premise of loading GLBs on all tiers. The binding target is iOS/WKWebView, where the governor demotes PRESETS not meshes (mobile geometry = potato geometry) and draw calls are the #1 killer. Desktop gets the 3-LOD GLB; mobile/potato get the perf-first brief's billboard-impostor InstancedMesh and NEVER decode a foliage GLB. This grafts the photoreal brief's fidelity onto the perf brief's mobile floor.
- REPLACE, never augment: WS14 swaps only the four canonical geometries fed to the existing W2 InstancedMesh constructors (nearFoliageGeo/nearTrunkGeo/farColGeo/farTrunkGeo at lines 4175-4179) with Blender GLB BufferGeometry. The cypressNear/cypressFar collectors (buildCypress line 3442, seed=px*137.5+pz*281.3), the 3-band seed routing (line 4201), and setInstances() (line 4180) are kept verbatim. This guarantees net draw-call parity/reduction and zero population-logic risk.
- THREE cypress LODs in ONE GLB (cypress_hero.glb), not three files: named meshes cypress_lod0 (hero, d<60, ribs+alpha-clip cross-quad foliage, ~900+320 tris), cypress_lod1 (avenue mid, 60≤d<180, merged 6-side shell, ~340 tris), cypress_lod2 (far, d≥180, tapered column matching current farColGeo dims, ~48 tris) + one shared trunk. Distance split computed once at mount from each cypressNear entry's sqrt(px²+pz²) — reuses existing per-instance data, adds ≤2 InstancedMesh per band on desktop only.
- BILLBOARD IMPOSTOR is the ENTIRE mobile foliage strategy: one baked 256×512 RGBA cypress card + a shared species atlas, rendered as a single InstancedMesh with a ShaderMaterial that extends grassShader.ts's wind pattern (tip-only sway). alphaTest=0.5, depthWrite=true, side=DoubleSide, renderOrder=0 (forces opaque queue — avoids the transparent-queue batch-break the perf brief flags as an iOS r154+ risk). Mobile avenue+ring = 1 draw call total. Bake camera at azimuth 0°, elevation 15° to match the primary −Z front view at 6°–30°.
- WIND via shared ref, not per-material clocks: new src/lib/3d/foliageWind.ts exports windTimeRef={value:0}, updated ONCE per rAF frame in ExteriorScene. Cypress foliage onBeforeCompile injects tip-sway sin(time*1.1 + worldPos.x*0.18)*vHeight²*0.025 (idempotent guard: check shader.vertexShader.includes('cypressWind') before inject — avoids the r150+ recompile-on-reuse risk). grassShader.ts createSharedWheatMaterial/createGrassSystem get an OPTIONAL windTimeRef param defaulting to their existing internal clock (backward-compatible; no forced migration). Skip wind entirely when !Q.shadowsEnabled (potato).
- DEFER GLB load past the governor warmup: fire loadModel() inside requestIdleCallback after the synchronous geometry pass AND a setTimeout(3000) — clears GOV_WARMUP_MS (2500ms) so cold DRACO decode (400–800ms on low-end Android) never counts against the 15s frame-miss sampling window that triggers a 7-day tier demotion. The two bust GLBs already warm the DRACOLoader WASM, so decode is not cold in practice, but the defer is the belt-and-suspenders.
- OLIVE gets a real hero GLB on desktop, keeps its sphere on mobile: replace the 40-count sphere-on-stick loop (lines 3733-3745) with one olive_hero.glb (gnarled multi-trunk via Skin modifier + flattened ellipsoid canopy, ~280 tris, shared bark PBR) instanced — collapsing ~40 individual sphere meshes to 2 draw calls on desktop. Mobile/potato keep the existing SphereGeometry olive UNTOUCHED (already cheap, reads acceptably at distance). Net mobile draw-call delta from olive: 0.
- STONE PINE canopy → 4-angle billboard impostor card, trunk stays procedural: the flat-sphere canopy (line 3758-3759) reads as a plate; replace ONLY the canopy mesh with a cross-quad impostor (2 intersecting planes, alphaTest=0.5) sampling a 1024×512 4-angle atlas. Trunk CylinderGeometry is correct — keep it. Zero code-path change beyond geometry+material swap; ~18 sphere canopies → 1 impostor InstancedMesh on desktop.
- BARK PBR from Polyhaven CC0, shared across cypress+olive trunks: download bark_brown_02 1k (diff/nor_gl/rough) — CC0, safe for a paid app, filenames already match the {prefix}_{kind}_{res}.jpg contract. Add a thin loadBarkSet() to assetLoader.ts following the existing loadPlasterWallTextures pattern (~8 lines). Foliage is FLAT-COLOUR MeshStandardMaterial matching the 3 existing cypressFoliageMats hues (#26301E/#2E3A22/#39452B) + a tiny baked AO (128×128, UV0) for canopy-interior darkening on mobile where SSAO is off. Travertine/villa geometry is NOT touched by WS14 — foliage only.
- AVENUE FRAMING FIX gated by if(W2&&W3): widen the cypressenlaan splay from ax=6+a*0.18 to ax=7.5+a*0.22 and height from ah=8.6−a*0.16 to ah=9.5−a*0.14 so near trees read taller than far (real Italian-avenue perspective) at the ~28° WP1 approach. Two-constant change, flag-guarded so W2-alone geometry is never mutated. The 22 avenue trees NEVER degrade below LOD1 (mobile) / impostor (potato) — they are the dolly's hero foliage.
- BUDGET GUARD as a shipped assertion, not a hope: after the deferred GLB load, assert renderer.info.render.triangles < 60_000 (mobile) / < 200_000 (desktop) and renderer.info.render.calls < 80 (mobile), console.warn on breach (existing dev-overlay pattern). If mobile asserts fail, halve billboard count. Also assert renderer.info.memory.textures before/after W3 to confirm the ~3.5MB GPU foliage-texture add stays inside the 140MB iOS ceiling.
- GLB header validated at export time in Blender: assert magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression before writing to public/models/exterior/ — catches the silent Blender-4.x DRACO-toggle-off failure (file 3–5× larger, no compression) the perf brief flags. Export spec binding: DRACO level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12, export_apply=True, export_yup=True, WEBP embedded. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered).
