Foliage onBeforeCompile injects tip-sway sin(time*1.1 + worldPos.x*0.18)*vHeight^2*0.025 with idempotent guard. Skip wind entirely when !Q.shadowsEnabled (potato). grassShader.ts gets an OPTIONAL windTimeRef param defaulting to its existing internal clock (backward-compatible, wheat/grass unchanged unless explicitly opted in).
- AVENUE FRAMING under if(W2&&W3) ONLY: widen splay ax=6+a*0.18 -> 7.5+a*0.22 and height ah=8.6-a*0.16 -> 9.5-a*0.14 (lines 3727-3728) so near trees read taller than far at the ~28deg WP1 approach. Flag-guarded so W2-alone geometry is never mutated.
- OLIVE: replace lines 3733-3745 loop with desktop olive_hero.glb InstancedMesh; mobile keeps existing SphereGeometry olive (capped at 10) UNTOUCHED. STONE PINE: swap canopy sphere (line 3758) for impostor cross-quad on desktop; mobile keeps sphere (capped at 4).
- Add loadBarkSet() to assetLoader.ts (~8 lines) following loadPlasterWallTextures/loadTerracottaTileTextures PBRTextureSet pattern; aoMap.channel=0 already forced there.
- Use the pooled renderer (rendererPool.ts) -- never a 2nd WebGL context (iOS jetsam kills it silently). Dispose via clearModelCache() at unmount ONLY; never dispose clones.

**LOD tiers:**
- Desktop LOD0 (d<60): ribs + 8 alpha-clip cross-quad foliage cards, ~900+320 tris, unit-height Y 0->1
- Desktop LOD1 (60<=d<180): merged 6-side shell, ~340 tris, unit-height Y 0->1
- Desktop LOD2 (d>=180): tapered cylinder matching farColGeo dims r0.12->0.30 h0.8 seg6, ~48 tris, with the +0.5 Y translate BAKED INTO the mesh
- Mobile/potato ALL distances: single billboard impostor InstancedMesh (1 draw call), baked az 0deg / el 15deg to match front -Z view at 6-30deg
- Guard: if(isMobileGPU()) skip LOD0 alpha cards even if getGPUTier mis-classifies an iPad Pro as desktop (avoids alpha-clip overdraw on tile-based A-series GPUs)

**Dependencies:** W2 exterior (flag3d('w2_exterior')) must be materialized -- WS14 is W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'); it grafts onto the W2 InstancedMesh block and is a no-op without W2., modelLoader.ts loadModel/clearModelCache (verified present, DRACOLoader warm from bust_base.glb + bust_female.glb -- decoder canary already hot, so cold-decode defer is belt-and-suspenders)., assetLoader.ts PBR contract + new loadBarkSet() wrapper., grassShader.ts (optional windTimeRef param) + new foliageWind.ts., canon.ts GOLDEN.sunPosition [-20,18,-30] + EXPOSURE 1.15 for bake matching. NOTE: canon GOLD is #D4AF37 (verified), not the brief's #B8973A -- irrelevant to foliage (no gold touches these assets) but downstream agents must bake against canon.ts., Independent of all generative-3D workstreams (Hyper3D/Rodin/Hunyuan disabled) -- WS14 needs none of them., public/draco decoder (present) for GLB decode., Production-time: Cycles GPU device configured in the running Blender (probe step 0).

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: low
- iOS risk: low
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: No hard blockers for shipping WS14. All are correctable pre-build. The single highest-risk item is the unit-height/y-offset LOD authoring contract (fix #4) — get it wrong and every cypress floats or sinks; get it right and the seam is a pure geometry swap through the existing, verified setInstances()/3-band routing.
- Blocker: Generative-3D routes (Hyper3D/Rodin, Hunyuan) are DISABLED, but WS14 needs NONE of them (all scripted bpy + Cycles + Polyhaven CC0). This is a blocker for the statuary workstreams in the broader doctrine, NOT for WS14 foliage.
- Fix: Correct the perf justification: the headline 'net -41 draw calls on mobile' is FALSE. Mobile already caps olives at 10 (line 3734) and stone pines at 4 (line 3748), and the plan itself keeps mobile olive spheres + pine trunks UNTOUCHED. So on the binding iOS tier WS14 is net +1 to +3 draw calls (adds the billboard InstancedMesh), NOT -41. Still safely under the 150-call ceiling, but the plan's mobile-win rationale is a phantom saving derived from wrongly assuming mobile runs the desktop 40-olive/18-pine loop. Re-baseline the budget assertion against real mobile counts.
- Fix: Guard requestIdleCallback: it is NOT used anywhere in ExteriorScene today and is historically absent/late in iOS WKWebView. The deferred-load branch (requestIdleCallback + setTimeout 3000) must be wrapped in `typeof requestIdleCallback !== 'undefined' ? requestIdleCallback(cb) : setTimeout(cb, 1)`. It only runs on the desktop branch in practice, but ship the guard to avoid a hard throw if getGPUTier ever mis-tiers.
- Fix: Clone materials before wind onBeforeCompile injection. loadModel() caches gltf.scene and returns .clone(); clones SHARE material references with the cached original. Mutating material.onBeforeCompile on a clone mutates the cached master, so the idempotent 'includes(cypressWind)' guard passes on the first tree and every subsequent clone silently skips wind injection. Deep-clone each LOD material (material.clone()) before injecting, or inject once on the cached master before cloning.
- Fix: Bake the geometry offsets into the LOD meshes, not just the profile. LOD2 must reproduce farColGeo EXACTLY: CylinderGeometry(.12,.3,.8,6) translated +0.4 in Y (line 4178) — if the GLB LOD2 is authored without that +0.4 baked in, far cypresses sink into the terrain because setInstances(false) applies scale.set(1,c.h,1) with no y-offset compensation. Same for LOD0/LOD1 unit-height (Y 0->1) so scale.y=c.h*0.82 and position baseY+c.h*0.18 land correctly; the near trunk must match nearTrunkGeo (Cyl .04/.14/.3 translated +0.15).
- Fix: Verify the exact Blender 4.x DRACO export kwarg on the RUNNING build and assert extensionsUsed contains KHR_draco_mesh_compression at export time. A silent no-compression export (Blender 4.x toggle-off bug) ships a 3-5x larger GLB; the two bust GLBs are ~880KB, so an uncompressed cypress_hero could blow the <=45KB target by an order of magnitude. Read GLB header magic 0x46546C67 + v2 + the draco extension before writing to public/models/exterior/.
- Fix: Confirm Cycles GPU bake device is configured in the running Blender before authoring. WS14 depends on Cycles bakes (AO on UV0) AND a bpy.ops.render.render orthographic billboard bake at 128 samples denoised. The doctrine names HIP; if the running Blender has no GPU device / no denoiser enabled, bakes fall to CPU (slow) or fail. This is a production-time capability, unverified in this planning run — probe cycles.device + preferences before the modeling run.
- Fix: Do NOT wire KTX2 for GLB in v1 as if it already works. modelLoader.ts has NO setKTX2Loader call (KTX2Loader lives only in assetLoader.ts for PBR sets). GLB-embedded KTX2 will NOT decode until that one line is added to the GLTFLoader in modelLoader.ts + a renderer handle is threaded in. Ship WEBP-embedded first (as the plan says) and treat KTX2 as a real code change, not zero-loader-change, for the GLB path specifically.
- Fix: Match GOLD token if any gold touches foliage assets (it should not): brief says GOLD #B8973A but canon.ts is GOLD #D4AF37. Irrelevant to foliage albedo but flag it so downstream agents bake against canon.ts, not the brief. Foliage flat hues #26301E/#2E3A22/#39452B are confirmed correct (lines 3424-3426) and read under 0.6 luminance.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] FLAG: with ?flag3d=-w3_exterior (or on prod hostname) the exterior renders BYTE-IDENTICAL to current W2 (untouched Lathe path); with w3_exterior ON on staging the new cypress silhouette appears. Zero change to prod behaviour until flag flips.
- [ ] FALLBACK: simulate a 404/DRACO-fail on cypress_hero.glb -> console.warn '[WS14] cypress GLB failed, keeping W2 Lathe' and the W2 Lathe cypresses still render (visual no-op, never a blank/regression).
- [ ] GEOMETRY CONTRACT: far cypresses (LOD2) sit ON the terrain, not sunk/floating -- proves the +0.5 Y offset is baked into LOD2 (matches farColGeo.translate(0,.5,0) line 4178). Near cypresses base sits at terrain with scale.y=h*0.82 -- proves LOD0/LOD1 unit-height Y 0->1.
- [ ] EXPORT: GLB header asserts pass at author time -- magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed contains KHR_draco_mesh_compression; cypress_hero.glb <=45KB, olive_hero.glb <=18KB (catches the silent no-compression export).
- [ ] MOBILE DRAW CALLS: on the iOS/mobile tier, renderer.info.render.calls delta vs W2-only is +1 to +3 (billboard InstancedMesh), NOT negative; renderer.info.render.triangles < 60000 for foliage; NO foliage GLB is decoded (verify network: no /models/exterior/*.glb fetch on mobile tier).
- [ ] MOBILE MEMORY: renderer.info.memory.textures before/after W3 confirms the ~3.5MB GPU foliage-texture add keeps total under the 140MB iOS ceiling.
- [ ] WIND: cypress foliage tips sway phase-coherently; onBeforeCompile injection is verified applied to EVERY LOD clone (material.clone() before inject) -- not just the first tree; wind disabled on potato (!Q.shadowsEnabled).
- [ ] PERF: ~60fps inside iOS WKWebView (Capacitor) sustained through the 18s establishing dolly; governor does NOT demote a tier (no >20% frames missing 25ms in the first 15s) -- deferred GLB load clears GOV_WARMUP_MS.
- [ ] REDUCED-MOTION STILLS: cypress reads correct at exactly WP1/WP3/WP5 static angles (front -Z, 6-30deg elevation) -- both the LOD0/LOD1 silhouette and the az0/el15 impostor bake satisfy these.
- [ ] iOS SEAL: no App-Review-breaking regression; no 2nd WebGL context opened (rendererPool used); i18n unaffected (foliage is non-text). Verified on staging before npx vercel --prod, flag stays prod-OFF until iOS-verified.

**Open questions:**
- Impostor angle-popping: the dolly sweeps ~48° azimuth (WP1→WP2). A single front-baked billboard is cheapest but a flat card can read as a rotating sprite. Decision needed: single-angle card (1 texture, accept slight flatness at oblique WP2) vs the perf brief's 8-angle atlas + smoothstep crossfade (4 extra fragment instructions, no pop). Recommend single-angle for v1 since the avenue is viewed near-dead-on at the hero beats and WP2 only shows the east face briefly — revisit if QA shows sprite-rotation.
- LOD0 alpha-clip overdraw on iPad Pro mis-tiered as desktop: if getGPUTier() classifies an iPad Pro as desktop, the alpha-clip cross-quad cards (expensive on tile-based A-series GPUs) would render. The if(isMobileGPU()) skip-lod0 guard should catch it, but needs on-device confirmation that isMobileGPU() returns true for iPad Pro in WKWebView (Capacitor isCapacitorIOS path suggests yes — verify).
- Whether to migrate wheat/grass to the shared windTimeRef now or keep them on their internal clocks: sharing guarantees phase-coherent field+tree sway but touches grassShader.ts's proven path. Recommend the backward-compatible optional-param approach (default = existing internal clock) so wheat/grass are unchanged unless explicitly opted in — confirm the owner wants coherence badly enough to opt them in.
- Blender DRACO export flag name across Blender 4.x versions (export_draco_mesh_compression_enable vs the UI Compression toggle) — verify the exact bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf kwarg on the running Blender build before authoring, and assert extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression at export to catch a silent no-compression export.
- Exact hue match: LOD foliage flat-colour must match the three live cypressFoliageMats (#26301E/#2E3A22/#39452B) AND read correctly after NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 — bake foliage AO at exposure 1.0 per canon, but confirm the flat albedo doesn't cross the 0.6 relative-luminance ceiling (memories must stay the brightest pixels).

### WS15 — Terrain: Tuscan hills, crop fields, displacement

*Sculpted/displaced terrain, terracing, crop fields, path integration, where Blender detail beats the shader terrain.*

**Summary:** WS15 Il Basamento Vivo: one hero rusticated-basamento GLB (desktop+mobile LOD) + a tiled dry-stone wall segment + gravel strada meshes + 3 CC0 Polyhaven PBR terrain sets, additive behind flag3d('w3_exterior'); mandatory step-0 loadModel() shadow/mkPhys fix; terrain mesh and getHeightAt() left untouched.
**Priority `P2` · ~6d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Ground the palace in the hill and give every crop/path/ground surface real material, while leaving the procedural terrain engine that the whole scene depends on completely intact. The synthesis rejects the photoreal brief's sculpted hero-hill GLB (it duplicates and can drift from the getHeightAt() analytical contract that grass, wheat, walls, roads and instance placement all read — a seam-and-drift trap for zero perceived gain from the dolly's distance) and rejects re-authoring background terrain as a shader-displacement mesh (net-zero fidelity per byte at WP distances, extra draw calls, governor-demotion memory risk). It keeps the strongest procedural systems verbatim (tuscanTerrain.ts sine/Gaussian mesh, grassShader.ts 15k-blade instanced grass, merged wheat/field buckets) and spends the Blender budget on the ONE place with the highest perceived-quality-per-byte: the "basamento" — the cyclopean retaining terrace the palace currently floats above. Today the palace sits at HILL_Y=8 over a smooth Gaussian hill with only a placeholder BoxGeometry substructure (~line 2866) and flat merged BoxGeometry retaining walls (gWallR); there is no believable connection between building and ground. Le Sette Sorelle is defined by exactly this — a villa that grew out of the hillside on rusticated terraces. We author ONE hero terrace_wall GLB (desktop + mobile LOD in the SAME file) that replaces the placeholder substructure with battered, coursed, rusticated stone, plus a dry-stone retaining-wall trim GLB that collapses 20 individual wall boxes into 1 InstancedMesh draw call (net NEGATIVE draw calls on mobile), plus three real CC0 Polyhaven PBR sets that finally give crop fields, ground and the strada-bianca path proper material through the existing loadPBRSet contract with zero loader-signature changes. This is 100% additive: every asset is inside a new W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior') block, async in try/catch, silent procedural fallback on reject. The terrain MESH is never replaced; getHeightAt() stays the single source of truth. Result at the three reduced-motion still beats (WP1/WP3/WP5, front −Z primary): the palace visibly grows out of a monumental coursed-stone basamento, the fields read as sun-baked Tuscan crops instead of tinted plaster, and the strade bianche converge on the gate — the single biggest believability jump the dolly can buy, for ~180KB of hero GLB + ~1.2MB of shared 1k textures, all inside the iOS 750k-tri / 80-call / 140MB ceilings with the draw-call delta going the RIGHT way.

**Design decisions:**
- KEEP the procedural terrain mesh and getHeightAt() untouched (all three briefs' hybrid instinct, made absolute). Rationale verified in tuscanTerrain.ts:13-47 — getHeightAt() is the analytical contract that grass, wheat, gWallR walls, ledges, roads and every instance placement read. A Blender hero-hill GLB (photoreal brief) would have to bit-match this floating-point sine/Gaussian formula at x,z up to ±400 or produce a visible seam at the r=110-120 join; the reward is nil because at WP distances (d=118-180) the hill is never read as sculpted geometry. Verdict: forbidden. The formula stays the ONLY height source; every GLB places against it at mount time, never against cached constants.
- THE ONE HERO ASSET IS THE BASAMENTO, not the hill (hybrid brief's core, chosen as the spine). Replace the placeholder COLOSSAL RUSTICATED SUBSTRUCTURE BoxGeometry (~ExteriorScene.tsx:2866) with terrace_wall.glb: a 3-level battered coursed-stone retaining terrace wrapping the visually-prominent N and E faces (WP1/WP3/WP5 read). This is where building-meets-ground believability lives and it is currently a flat placeholder box — highest perceived-quality-per-byte on the whole terrain surface.
- COLLAPSE the 20 procedural retaining-wall boxes into 1 InstancedMesh via a dry-stone trim GLB (perf brief's best move). Verified: stoneWallCount=20 desktop / 5 mobile (ExteriorScene.tsx:4276) — today 20 individual BoxGeometry draws. terrain_wall_seg.glb (~600 tris) instanced at the SAME wx/wz/wAng transforms already computed gives net -19 draw calls desktop / -4 mobile. Draw-call budget impact is POSITIVE, which is the entire point on iOS where calls (not tris) are the killer.
- REAL TEXTURES via three CC0 Polyhaven sets through the EXISTING loadPBRSet contract, zero signature change (perf brief). Replace the loadCropTextures/loadGroundTextures/loadWhiteGravelTextures stubs (assetLoader.ts:687-698, all currently point at plaster/travertine) with real 1k sets in /textures/pbr/<set>/ following the {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg naming — loadPBRSet picks them up unchanged. Under W3 the terrain material.map is swapped (material-swap only, no new mesh).
- EAGER-SET CAP IS THE BINDING TEXTURE CONSTRAINT — resolved by exploiting that mobile never loads crop. Verified ExteriorScene.tsx:287: on mobile cropTex is forced to paintedPlasterTex (already loaded), so the crop-set upgrade is DESKTOP-ONLY and costs 0 mobile eager sets. Mobile W3 spends its eager budget on: sandstone (terrainTex, already eager all-tiers) + tuscan_soil (ground) + strada_bianca gravel = 3 of 4; field_stone reuses the wall GLB's own baked atlas (loaded post-sync, not eager). Stays at/under the mobile cap of 4 with 1 slot of headroom for other W3 workstreams — tracked explicitly as a shared budget.
- ONE GLB FILE CARRIES BOTH LODs, picked by isMobileGPU() (photoreal brief's KHR-multi-LOD idea, simplified to two exports rather than in-file to keep the loader a one-liner). Desktop terrace_wall.glb ≤8k tris (pilasters + blind-arch niches + rusticated courses); mobile terrace_wall_lod1.glb ≤3k tris (flat coursed faces, detail stripped via Decimate 0.35). Potato: skip the GLB entirely, keep the existing placeholder box — no shadows, no env map, matches potato dogma.
- BAKE-TIME SUN AND GRADE MUST MATCH THE RUNTIME EXACTLY or the GLB clashes. Blender sun = DirectionalLight #FFB870 at [-20,18,-30] (SW, ~28° elev, azimuth ~213°), energy tuned to the GOLDEN preset; bake at NeutralToneMapping-equivalent exposure 1.0 (runtime applies 1.15 once globally). Bake AO to UV0 only (aoMap.channel=0 is hardcoded). Normal maps OpenGL/Blender-default convention. This is non-negotiable for the basamento since its baked AO shadows sit directly under the runtime sun.
- PALETTE-CONSTRAIN every Polyhaven albedo before baking (all briefs flag drift). aerial/grass sets skew cool-green and foreign against INK/GOLD canon: apply Hue +0.04 toward yellow, Saturation ×0.85, clamp relative luminance ≤0.6 (memories stay the brightest pixels). Basamento albedo = TRAVERTINE canon #E3D6BC / #E8DCC0 via procedural Voronoi+Noise baked to atlas — no scan matches travertine, so author it.
- STRADE BIANCHE stays but as a lightweight decal-offset ribbon, NOT a spline mesh that can z-fight (perf brief's polygonOffset resolution over photoreal's proud-cross-section). 3 gravel path ribbons (2 on mobile — drop the SE branch) converging on the gate apron, placed at y=getHeightAt(mid) with polygonOffset(true,-2,-4) to avoid terrain interpenetration on local high points. ~400-800 tris total.
- TERRACE GRASS INFILL is a pure-runtime win, no Blender asset (photoreal brief move #9, kept). Replace the flat gGrassR BoxGeometry patches (ExteriorScene.tsx:639) with the existing grassShader.ts createGrassSystem() instanced planes scaled by Q.vegetationDensity, inside the W3 block. Zero new asset, 1 draw call, sells the formal terrace.
- DRACO ONLY, header-validated at export (all briefs). export_draco_mesh_compression=True, level 6, pos 14 / nrm 10 / uv 12, export_apply, export_yup. Assert magic 0x46546C67 and extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression before shipping. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered → silent fail). Pre-warm decoder on exterior mount with the smallest GLB (terrace ledge) as canary before the 18s dolly, since bust GLBs live in the interior scene and may be cold.
- SUBSTRUCTURE SITS 1.5m INTO THE HILL to kill the contact seam (hybrid brief). Author basamento base at y=6.5 (HILL_Y − 1.5) so it grows out of the slope with no floating gap; verify mesh.position and boundingBox on first frame after load. Position the GLB at world (0,0,0) — geometry authored in ExteriorScene world-space (1 Blender unit = 1 world unit).

**Assets:**
- **public/models/exterior/terrace_wall.glb (desktop hero basamento)** — Scripted BPY. 3-level battered retaining terrace wrapping N+E faces. L1 bottom wall h=4m battered 4°, rusticated courses via Geometry-Nodes instance-on-grid of a 0.95×0.58×1.15m chamfered block, ±3% scale / ±1mm Y jitter (hand-laid), baked to mesh. L2 mid-wall 2.5m dressed, pilasters (Screw straight-extrude T-profile) every 8m, blind-arch niches (one boolean master, Array ×10, applied). L3 tapered plinth course merging into existing building base. Smart-UV island_margin=0.02 UV0-only. Cycles GPU bake AO(64 rays, cage 0.05)+Normal(GL)+Roughness with sun at [-20,18,-30] #FFB870, exposure 1.0. Base at y=6.5. Merge to single material. · ≤8,000 tris desktop; DRACO L6; target ≤160KB wire · public/textures/pbr/travertine_wall/terrace_wall_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg — Voronoi(scale8,rand0.7)+Noise procedural travertine baked, albedo #E8DCC0→#C8B898 vein range, rough 0.75-0.90, metal 0
- **public/models/exterior/terrace_wall_lod1.glb (mobile basamento LOD)** — Same BPY source, Decimate modifier ratio=0.35 stripping pilasters/arches to flat coursed silhouette before export. Selected at runtime by isMobileGPU(). Reuses the same travertine_wall texture set (no extra texture cost). · ≤3,000 tris; DRACO L6; target ≤60KB wire · shared travertine_wall 1k set
- **public/models/exterior/terrace_wall_seg.glb (dry-stone retaining trim, instanced)** — Scripted BPY. One ~2m×8m dry-stone wall section, individual courses as beveled boxes offset per row with ±3cm XY jitter, ~4mm mortar recesses. Smart-UV UV0, bake AO+Normal to 1k field_stone atlas. Runtime: InstancedMesh at the existing wx/wz/wAng transforms (ExteriorScene.tsx:4276 loop), replacing 20 BoxGeometry draws → 1 draw. castShadow=false; receiveShadow=false on mobile (cheap), true desktop. · ≤600 tris; DRACO L6; target ≤14KB wire · public/textures/pbr/field_stone/field_stone_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg from Polyhaven rough_block_wall_001 (CC0), loaded post-sync (not eager)
- **public/models/exterior/strada_bianca.glb (gravel path ribbon)** — Scripted BPY. Bezier-arc curve, 4m-wide rectangular profile instance-on-curve, realized+applied, UV repeat every 4m along length. 3 orientations converging on gate apron z≈-19 (SW azimuth ~210°, due-south main axis, SE branch). Runtime: static Mesh ×3 (×2 mobile, drop SE), y=getHeightAt(mid), polygonOffset(true,-2,-4) to prevent z-fight. Cobblestone/gravel PBR baked. · ≤800 tris total; DRACO L6; target ≤10KB wire · public/textures/pbr/strada_bianca/strada_bianca_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg from Polyhaven cobblestone_large_01 or gravel_road (CC0), white-Tuscan albedo, EAGER on mobile
- **public/textures/pbr/tuscan_soil/tuscan_soil_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg (crop+ground upgrade)** — Polyhaven CC0 (brown_mud_leaves_01 / brown_mud_01) downloaded via download_polyhaven_asset at 1k. Palette-shift Hue +0.04, Sat ×0.85, albedo to #C8B89A range, luminance ≤0.6. Renamed to loadPBRSet contract. Replaces loadGroundTextures stub (all tiers) and loadCropTextures stub (DESKTOP ONLY — mobile crop stays paintedPlasterTex per ExteriorScene.tsx:287, so 0 mobile eager cost for crop). · n/a (texture set) · 4 maps 1k JPG ~q80, ~1.0MB set
- **Runtime integration (no new asset) — terrace grass infill + W3 seam** — Pure Three.js inside new W3=W2&&flag3d('w3_exterior') block. Replace gGrassR flat BoxGeometry patches (ExteriorScene.tsx:639) with grassShader.ts createGrassSystem() instanced planes, count×Q.vegetationDensity. Add 3 assetLoader wrappers (loadTuscanSoilTextures/loadFieldStoneTextures/loadStradaBiancaTextures) mirroring loadPBRSet. Async loadModel() calls in try/catch after synchronous geometry; mkPhys() re-applied to every loaded material; clearModelCache() at unmount only; pooled renderer only. **Blender MCP tools:** execute_blender_code (all scripted geometry: lathe/Screw T-pilasters, geometry-nodes instance-on-grid rusticated courses, boolean blind-arch niches, tiled dry-stone wall segment, bezier strada, Cycles GPU AO/normal/rough bake, DRACO GLB export), search_polyhaven_assets + download_polyhaven_asset (CC0 only: tuscan_soil from a brown_mud/aerial set, field_stone from rough_block_wall_001, strada from a gravel/dirt-track set NOT cobblestone_large_01 which reads as laid cobbles), get_polyhaven_status (confirm bridge before any download), get_viewport_screenshot + get_object_info (verify front -Z silhouette + bounds/tri counts before export)

**Production steps:**
1. 0. Patch modelLoader.ts: add loadModel(path,opts) with {shadows=true, applyPhys=false}; when applyPhys traverse the clone and run mkPhys() on every material (GLTFLoader bypasses it); when shadows=false set cast/receiveShadow=false. Land + typecheck first.
2. 1. Confirm Polyhaven bridge (get_polyhaven_status); search_polyhaven_assets for Tuscan soil, rough block/field stone wall, gravel dirt-track; preview and pick CC0 only; download at 1k.
3. 2. In Blender, palette-clamp downloaded albedos (Hue +0.04, Sat x0.85, clamp luminance <=0.6); rename to loadPBRSet contract {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg under the 4 pbr folders.
4. 3. Script basamento hi-poly: L1 4m battered wall + geometry-nodes instance-on-grid of a chamfered 0.95x0.58x1.15m block with +/-3% scale and +/-1mm Y jitter; L2 2.5m dressed + Screw T-pilasters every 8m + one boolean blind-arch niche master arrayed x10; L3 tapered plinth. Author base at world y=6.5 (HILL_Y-1.5), origin (0,0,0), 1 Blender unit = 1 world unit; footprint aligned to the LIVE substructure bounds px0=-56, px1=52, pz0=-27, pz1=40 (verified line 2871) so N+E faces meet the building base with no floating gap.
5. 4. Retopo low-poly <=8k; smart_project island_margin 0.02 UV0-only; author procedural travertine (Voronoi scale 8 rand 0.7 + Noise) to atlas.
6. 5. Cycles GPU (HIP) bake AO(64 rays, cage 0.05)+Normal(GL)+Rough with the exact runtime sun/exposure; write travertine_wall_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_1k.jpg.
7. 6. Duplicate + Decimate 0.35 -> terrace_wall_lod1 (<=3k), strip pilasters/arches; reuse the same travertine_wall atlas.
8. 7. Script terrace_wall_seg.glb: a ~2m TILEABLE dry-stone unit (courses as beveled boxes, +/-3cm XY jitter, ~4mm mortar recess), <=600 tris, bake to field_stone atlas. NOTE the wall loop uses per-wall random wLen 8-28m (line 4281): a single InstancedMesh cannot express variable length without stretching texture, so place N ~2m segments end-to-end per wall (matrix loop), NOT one stretched instance.

### WS16 — PBR material library

*Master set: travertine, terracotta, plaster (fresh+worn), gold/gilt, weathered marble, patinated bronze, wood, iron — tileable + trim sheets honoring canon.ts.*

**Summary:** WS16 — Author 5 canon-precise procedural PBR material sets in Blender (Cycles node-bake, no generative tools), ship JPG-first to public/textures/pbr/{set}/, and wire them through a NEW async W3 block in ExteriorScene that REPLACES (not augments) the existing synchronous mobile loader call-sites, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior').
**Priority `P1` · ~6d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Author a hex-precise, canon-accurate master PBR material library for the Le Sette Sorelle exterior that raises perceived fidelity dramatically while never breaking the mobile/iOS 4-eager-set ceiling. The synthesis resolves the three competing briefs (photoreal-max / perf-first / hybrid) into ONE plan by adopting the HYBRID lens as the spine — audit-and-extend, not rip-and-replace — while borrowing photoreal's rigor on the four surfaces that actually move the needle and perf-first's hard slot-accounting as the binding constraint. The mobile/iOS envelope (60fps, maxEagerTextureSets=4, aoMap.channel=0, JPG-first) is the master constraint; quality is maximized strictly WITHIN it. Every set slots into the existing loadPBRSet() naming contract at /textures/pbr/{name}/{prefix}_{kind}_{res}.jpg with near-zero loader surface change, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior') and lazy-loaded inside the async GLB block so eager cap is never touched. The single most important correction across all three briefs: canon GOLD is #D4AF37 (verified canon.ts line 20) — the '#B8973A' in two briefs is WRONG and would misread the tympanum name-beat; gilt albedo is authored at exactly #D4AF37 (relLuminance 0.585, just under the 0.6 brightness-dogma ceiling), and lantern glow is added at RUNTIME via emissiveIntensity 1.5–3.0 in ExteriorScene, never baked into the diff.

**Design decisions:**
- SPINE = HYBRID (audit-and-extend). Verified on disk: travertine, terracotta_tiles, worn_plaster_wall, clay_plaster, sandstone, marble all already ship at 1k and are broadly canon-usable. Do NOT author 8 sets from scratch (photoreal brief's cost) nor overwrite production sets destructively. Author Blender bakes ONLY where the perceived-quality jump per byte is largest: (1) travertine_v2 upgrade for drum/balustrade close-ups, (2) gilt (NEW — no scanned equivalent exists), (3) marble_exterior (existing marble_01 is too clinical-white for exterior stone), (4) terracotta_coppo upgrade (bake inter-coppo groove into nor_gl). Everything else is calibrate-in-place or reuse.
- BINDING CONSTRAINT = perf-first's 4-eager-slot accounting (verified MOBILE_QUALITY.maxEagerTextureSets=4). Mobile GPU material budget collapses ALL surface identities to exactly 4 shared sets: Slot A stone = travertine_v2 (also serves marble_exterior + worn walls via material.color tint on same texture); Slot B terracotta = terracotta_coppo (dome panels + casa-torri slopes); Slot C plaster = clay_plaster (calibrated); Slot D metal = gilt (lantern+tympanum; iron reuses via metalness=1/color tint, zero extra texture). Desktop gets the full 8-identity split (marble_exterior, bronze_patina, iron_wrought as distinct sets) because maxEagerTextureSets=20 there.
- GOLD = #D4AF37 EXACTLY (canon.ts:20, verified). Reject the '#B8973A' value from the perf-first and routing-doctrine briefs — it is a stale placeholder. Bake gilt diff as flat albedo #D4AF37 at emissive 0.0; the lantern bloom glow is applied at runtime via material.emissive + emissiveIntensity 1.5–3.0 in ExteriorScene (bloom threshold 0.85 confirmed), so potato-tier (bloom off) has a correct un-blown fallback. Never bake emissive into the texture.
- JPG-FIRST, KTX2 fast-follow. Verified: ktx2-manifest.json does NOT exist yet, so the JPG pipeline is authoritative and shipping is safe. scripts/build-ktx2.mjs exists (toktx CLI prerequisite). Ship all sets as 1k JPG first (all tiers 404→1k fallback per loadJPGBase); add 2k desktop + 512 potato variants; regenerate manifest ONLY after all .ktx2 files are verified present (partial manifest = per-file 404 round-trips). No loader code change needed for KTX2 — pickKTX2Url/loadKTX2Base already wired.
- aoMap.channel=0 is a HARD constraint (assetLoader.ts:554, unconditional). Every Blender bake target must have exactly ONE UV map (UV0). Delete any auto-generated lightmap/second UV before baking AO, or mobile/potato AO silently shows solid white (SSAO is desktop-only, so baked AO is the ONLY occlusion carrier on phones). Verify aoMap.channel===0 in a Three.js dev-overlay material dump before promotion.
- REBAKE, don't OVERWRITE in place. Photoreal brief names travertine_v2 in a NEW folder (safe, non-destructive); perf-first brief overwrites the live travertine_*_1k.jpg (risky — breaks Roman-era interior reuse that shares loadTravertineTextures). Decision: author to NEW folders (travertine_v2/, marble_exterior/, gilt/, terracotta_coppo/) and add thin new loader wrappers; the exterior W3 block calls the new loaders, existing callers keep the old files untouched. Zero regression to non-exterior scenes.
- Color-management discipline for bake↔runtime parity. Runtime is NeutralToneMapping at EXPOSURE=1.15 (canon.ts:47) applied ONCE in postprocessing. Bake albedo-only (DIFFUSE with use_pass_direct=False, use_pass_indirect=False) at Blender exposure 0.0, View Transform=Standard/sRGB (never Filmic) when sampling hex. Eyedrop the exported JPG and confirm it matches the canon target within delta-E ≤5 BEFORE shipping; nudge ColorRamp endpoints if JPEG encoding drifts (e.g. travertine reads #ECE0CC instead of #E8DCC0 → lower endpoint ~0.02).
- Sun-match every bake. One DirectionalLight #FFB870 at [-20,18,-30] (GOLDEN, verified). Blender sun lamp: color (1.0,0.722,0.439) linearised, location (-20,18,-30), energy ~4.5. Any baked AO/curvature that implies a light direction must match or the GLB clashes with runtime shading.
- Atlas trim-sheets are DEFERRED, not day-one. The 4-slot collapse is achieved first by SHARING existing tileable sets across GLBs (one material slot per set via repeat-param reuse + material.color tint), which needs zero atlas work. Physical 2k atlas-packing (STONE/TERRACOTTA/METAL) is a later optimization only if draw-call profiling shows we exceed 80 opaque calls on mobile — and if done, use 0.002 UV margin inside quadrant boundaries to prevent bilinear bleed seams at the WP3 tympanum beat (d=118).
- Route by tool correctly: ALL 4 sets are scripted-bpy Cycles node-bake (Noise/Voronoi/ColorRamp) — NEVER Hyper3D/Rodin/Hunyuan3D (those produce non-tileable, non-hex-precise albedo) and NEVER Sketchfab (disabled + NC/ND license risk for a paid app). Polyhaven CC0 is used ONLY as an optional detail-scaffold for terracotta_coppo (verify CC0 via get_polyhaven_status before download; if CC-BY, author coppo groove procedurally instead).

### WS17 — Texture baking workflow

*High->low bake pipeline (normal/AO/curvature/roughness), trim-sheet atlas strategy, UV standards, resolution ladder.*

**Summary:** Blender-bake 7 hero exterior GLBs (dome, drum-windows, Corinthian capital, baluster, tazza fountain, coppo strip, gold lantern) sharing 3 trim-sheet PBR atlases (stone/terracotta/gold); all scripted-bpy geometry + Cycles selected-to-active bake; geometry-only DRACO GLBs referencing external 1k JPGs; W3-flag-gated seam that EXCLUDES superseded procedural sub-geometry from the W2 merge before swapping GLBs in, holding iOS 750k-tri / 80-call / 140MB ceilings with baked AO carrying all contact shadow on mobile/potato.
**Priority `P1` · ~9d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** A hi-poly → low-poly Cycles bake pipeline that converts scripted Blender villa geometry into exactly THREE shared trim-sheet PBR atlases (stone / terracotta / gold) that drop straight into the existing loadPBRSet() {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_{res}.jpg contract with ZERO changes to assetLoader.ts or modelLoader.ts. The lens is HYBRID: leave every working procedural system (terrain, grass/wheat shaders, cypresses, sky, fog, daylight, env maps) untouched, and Blender-bake only the five hero surfaces that dominate >70% of primary-view pixels at the three reduced-motion stills (WP1/WP3/WP5) — dome shell, drum thermal windows, Corinthian capitals, balustrades, tazza fountain. Baked AO is the single highest-ROI channel because SSAO is disabled on mobile/potato (the binding iOS tier): a well-baked AO map does contact-shadow work the mobile postprocessor cannot do at all, so bake quality buys more perceived fidelity per byte than polygon count. Author once, instance/merge in Three.js, gate everything behind a fresh flag3d('w3_exterior') (staging ON / prod OFF), ship 1k JPG first with the built-in 404→1k fallback carrying the interim, and keep the whole hero payload ≤3 MB on mobile and under the iOS 750k-tri / 80-call / 140MB ceilings. The synthesis rejects the 4-atlas photoreal plan (busts the mobile 4-set eager cap once existing terrain sets are counted), rejects AO-premultiplied-into-diff (double-darkening risk against the hardcoded aoMap.channel=0), and rejects GLB-embedded KTX2/WEBP for the first ship (embedded textures decode twice, inflate the wire, and modelLoader.ts never registers a KTX2Loader). Result: 3 atlases × 4 channels, 7 hero GLBs, ~3 GLB draw calls on mobile, one thin loader file, one W3-gated seam block.

**Design decisions:**
- ATLAS COUNT = 3, NOT 4. Adopt the perf-first/hybrid 3-atlas plan (stone / terracotta / gold) over the photoreal 4-atlas plan. Rationale: MOBILE_QUALITY.maxEagerTextureSets = 4 (verified mobilePerf.ts:171) and the exterior already eager-loads terrain PBR sets (grass/ground/crop/gravel all route through loadPBRSet today). A 4th new atlas would push net-new exterior GLB sets past the cap and force lazy loads that read as pop-in during the 18s dolly. 3 atlases = at most 3 net-new binds, leaving headroom. Merge 'plaster' surfaces into the stone atlas as a dedicated trim-sheet zone rather than a 4th set.
- KEEP DIFFUSE CLEAN — DO NOT pre-multiply AO into the albedo. Reject the photoreal brief's diff_final = albedo*(1-AO*0.45) move. The runtime already binds a separate aoMap on UV0 (aoMap.channel=0 hardcoded, assetLoader.ts:554) so pre-multiplied AO would double-darken crevices. Bake a pure AO-only pass to the _ao channel and a light-free albedo to the _diff channel. This also keeps _diff canon-luminance-clampable independently.
- SHIP EXTERNAL JPG TEXTURES, GLBs REFERENCE THEM — do NOT embed textures in the GLB. modelLoader.ts registers only a DRACOLoader (verified modelLoader.ts:5-9), never a KTX2Loader, so any GLB-embedded KTX2/basisu texture silently renders black; embedded WEBP decodes twice and inflates each GLB past the 500KB mobile ceiling. Export geometry-only DRACO GLBs (level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12, export_apply, export_yup) and apply the shared atlas PBR set at runtime via loadPBRSet after load. This is why 7 GLBs share only 3 texture binds.
- UV0 ONLY, EXACTLY ONE UV LAYER NAMED 'UVMap'. aoMap.channel=0 is hardcoded; a second UV channel for AO silently smears the bake onto UV0 detail coords on mobile. Enforce: delete any secondary UV set before export; assert Data Properties shows exactly one UV layer. smart_project(island_margin=0.02, angle_limit=66) at 2k bake resolution (gives ≥2px safe margin after downsample to 1k) then pack all meshes of a family into that family's single atlas UV space.
- NORMAL MAPS ARE OPENGL/TANGENT-SPACE, GREEN-UP, NO Y-FLIP. Blender's glTF export default (nor_gl suffix already in the loader contract) matches Three.js MeshStandardMaterial.normalMap. Bake with the Image Texture node set Non-Color, bake type Normal, space Tangent. Verify in viewport under the canon SW sun that ribs read convex; only flip green if inside-out. Never flip in a compositor/Photoshop step.
- BAKE-TIME SUN MATCHES THE RUNTIME SUN EXACTLY so baked directional cues don't clash with the DirectionalLight. From GOLDEN.sunPosition [-20,18,-30] (verified canon.ts:57): Blender sun lamp azimuth ≈ 213.7°, elevation ≈ 27.5°, color #FFB870 linear-decoded (1.0, 0.722, 0.439), strength ≈ 3.2–3.5. AO/normal are direction-agnostic, but any directional/curvature cue must use this lamp. Bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies EXPOSURE=1.15 once via the shared NeutralToneMapping EffectPass — never bake a per-asset exposure, never bake a full HDRI into diff or it double-lights against the procedural PMREM).
- ROUGHNESS IS BAKED-VARIED, NOT FLAT. Drive roughness from a Pointiness→ColorRamp graph: travertine edges wear smooth/specular (~0.30 at arrises), flat field ~0.55–0.82, crevices roughen with dirt (~0.88–0.92); coppo 0.65 base / 0.50 ridge / 0.80 crack; gold 0.12–0.15 body rising to ~0.35 at finial tip. Baked variation is nearly free perceived quality and reads even under flat mobile hemisphere ambient.
- CANON LUMINANCE CLAMP AT ALBEDO. Clamp every architecture _diff pixel to ≤0.6 relative luminance (BRIGHTNESS_RATIOS.plaque, canon.ts:82) via a Curves node so memories stay the brightest pixels. Albedo targets: stone field #E8DCC0 / trim #E3D6BC (TRAVERTINE_GROUT), plaster zone #F2E9DA (PLASTER) / use PLASTER_RAMP.base, terracotta #B0725A, gold #B8973A (dull antique gilt — NOT canon.ts GOLD=#D4AF37 which is the emissive/frame token; the gold GLB gets its glow at runtime via emissiveIntensity 1.5–3.0 to cross the 0.85 bloom threshold, not from albedo).
- GLBs REPLACE PROCEDURAL GEOMETRY, NEVER ADD TO IT. The exterior is already near the 150-call mobile ceiling. Each hero GLB must swap out the procedural mesh it supersedes (dome GLB replaces the lathe hemisphere; drum_windows GLB replaces the box-sticker windows; balusters replace the tapered-cylinder rows). Merge-per-material static masonry in Blender before export; instance repeats (baluster, capital, coppo) via InstancedMesh with per-instance rot/scale jitter for the 'grown-over-centuries' asymmetry. Target ≤3 GLB draw calls on mobile.
- RE-APPLY mkPhys() TO EVERY LOADED MATERIAL. GLTFLoader builds its own material and bypasses mkPhys (verified: modelLoader.ts loadModel never calls it; mkPhys(three,props) returns a fresh Standard material on mobile stripping clearcoat/sheen/transmission, mobilePerf.ts:339). Author STANDARD PBR only in Blender (no clearcoat/transmission nodes), and add an explicit post-load traverse in the W3 seam that rebuilds each mesh.material via mkPhys and re-attaches the atlas maps + envMapIntensity≈0.45 to match the W2 dome.
- RESOLUTION LADDER: ship 1k first, add 512, hold 2k as bake-master only. Both DESKTOP_QUALITY and MOBILE_QUALITY.textureRes='1k' (mobilePerf.ts:145,170); POTATO='512' (:191). So 1k covers desktop+mobile immediately; 512 is a fast-follow for potato (the 404→1k fallback in loadJPGBase, assetLoader.ts:448, makes shipping 1k-first safe). 2k bakes are never fetched today (no desktop 2k code path) — keep them on disk as the KTX2 master for the later npm run build:ktx2 pass. Gold atlas stays 512 at all tiers (tiny screen area).
- FLAG GATE flag3d('w3_exterior'), read once at mount; W3 = W2 && flag. No flag retirement until prod+iOS verified. Add a dev overlay asserting renderer.info.render.triangles/calls against the ceilings during the first 15s warmup (the adaptive governor demotes a tier for 7 days if >20% frames miss 25ms in warmup), and keep the two bust GLBs as the DRACO decoder canary.

- Async-after-geometry try/catch: loadModel(path) each of the 7 GLBs from public/models/exterior/; add clones to the pooled scene (no 2nd WebGL context).
- Traverse each clone; material = mkPhys(THREE, {map, normalMap, roughnessMap, aoMap, envMapIntensity:0.45}) with aoMap.channel=0; re-attach the shared atlas set from exteriorAtlasLoader.
- InstancedMesh for baluster/capital/coppo with per-instance jitter matrices (1 draw call each).

- Preload+await dome+drum+stone-atlas before dolly/WP1; keep fountain/coppo progressive.
- Dispose via clearModelCache() at unmount only; never dispose clones or cached atlas textures.
- Dev overlay tri/call assertion during 15s warmup; iOS WKWebView 60fps QA; staging verify via ?flag3d=w3_exterior; prod deploy with W3 OFF until iOS-verified.

- POTATO: 0 decorative GLBs (fountain/urn/coppo suppressed), dome-only at ~8-10k with NO shadow, NO env map, NO bloom (mobilePerf shadowsEnabled=false loadEnvHDRI=false bloom=false) — baked AO must carry 100% of the dome form or it flattens.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: medium
- iOS risk: medium
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Fix: FIX THE ATLAS-COUNT RATIONALE (it is based on a false premise, though the conclusion is fine). Verified: maxEagerTextureSets is NOT enforced anywhere in assetLoader.ts — grep for it returns zero matches; loadPBRSet fetches every set immediately, there is no eager/lazy/deferred code path. It is used ONLY as a mobile-proxy (ExteriorScene.tsx:89 `isMobileQ=Q.maxEagerTextureSets<=6`). So the plan's headline decision ('a 4th atlas tips into lazy loads that read as pop-in during the dolly') describes a mechanism that does not exist. Keep 3 atlases for GPU-memory/draw-bind hygiene, but rewrite the rationale to the true one: each new base set = 4 more JPG fetches on the TTI-critical path + more decoded VRAM, and the mobile exterior currently loads only ~4 unique base sets because it collapses grass/ground/crop/gravel/worn-plaster to shared plaster/stone on mobile (ExteriorScene.tsx:284-289 `isMobileQ?paintedPlasterTex`). This also fully ANSWERS openQuestion #2 (mobile eager-cap headroom): there is no cap to bust — but there IS a real fetch-count/VRAM cost, so the 3-atlas ceiling still stands.
- Fix: RESOLVE THE POOLED-RENDERER CONTRADICTION IN THE SEAM. The brief asserts loads must use the pooled renderer and 'NEVER open a 2nd WebGL context,' but modelLoader.ts (verified lines 1-45) uses a module-level GLTFLoader that takes NO renderer and does GPU upload lazily on first render into whatever context draws it — it does not touch rendererPool at all. That is actually FINE (GLTFLoader defers upload to the draw context, so no 2nd context is created), but the plan's seam instruction to 'loadModel() via the pooled renderer' is not literally implementable against the current loadModel signature. Required: either (a) keep loadModel as-is and just add the clone to the pooled scene (correct, zero risk), or (b) if GLB-embedded KTX2 is ever wanted, THAT path needs getPooledRenderer() + setKTX2Loader — but the plan already (correctly) defers embedded KTX2. Document that the mkPhys re-material traverse must run on the CLONE returned by loadModel, before adding to scene, and must NOT dispose the cached original.
- Fix: BUDGET-VS-QUALITY COLLISION ON THE DOME. The plan lists a ~180k-tri hi-poly ogival dome as the stone-atlas bake source AND an ~8k desktop / ~5k mobile LOD. Baking 180k selected-to-active onto a 5k cage at 2k with 32-64 AO samples on an integrated AMD Radeon 890M iGPU (verified: HIP GPU is the 890M, not a discrete card) is workable but SLOW (minutes per pass x4 channels x7 assets); more importantly a 5k-tri mobile dome carrying 8 proud ribs + concave webs purely in a normal map will show silhouette-faceting against the sky at WP1/WP3/WP5 where the dome is the primary silhouette. Required: raise the mobile dome floor to ~8-10k tris (still trivial vs the 750k iOS budget — tris are not the mobile killer, draw calls are) so the OUTLINE is geometric, and let the normal map only carry web concavity/rib micro-relief. Confirm potato: POTATO_QUALITY has shadowsEnabled=false AND loadEnvHDRI=false (verified mobilePerf.ts:189-190), so the dome must read with NO shadow and NO env reflection — bake AO must carry 100% of the form on potato.
- Fix: GLBs-REPLACE-PROCEDURAL IS THE HARDEST UNVERIFIED PART AND IS UNDER-SPECIFIED. The 4944-line ExteriorScene merges the palace into ~18 static draw calls via mergeGeometries; the procedural dome/drum-windows/balustrades are baked INTO those merged buffers, not separate removable meshes. 'Swap out the procedural mesh each GLB replaces' therefore requires either (a) excluding those pieces from the W2 merge when W3 is on (a real edit to the synchronous geometry pass, gated on flag3d('w3_exterior') read at mount — feasible since flags are read once at mount, verified flags3d.ts), or (b) leaving procedural geometry in place and hiding it (wastes the tris/calls the plan claims to save). Required: the W3 flag must be read BEFORE the merge pass and conditionally exclude the superseded sub-geometries, otherwise the GLBs are ADDITIVE and blow the mobile 150-call/tri ceiling the plan explicitly forbids. This is the single biggest implementation risk and must be a named sub-task, not folded into 'async after geometry.'
- Fix: GENERATIVE MASCARON IS BLOCKED — decouple it from the ship. Verified live: both Hyper3D/Rodin AND Hunyuan3D report 'integration is currently disabled' (owner must tick N-panel checkboxes + restart). So fountain_tazza.glb's mascaron cannot be image->3D generated right now. Required: ship fountain_tazza with a hand-scripted bpy mascaron (or omit the mascaron entirely for v1 — the tazza silhouette is the value at dolly distance) so the pipeline is not owner-blocked. Do NOT put a disabled generative tool on the critical path.
- Fix: ADD GOLD_BAKED TO canon.ts BEFORE ANY GOLD BAKE (openQuestion #1 is real). The plan bakes gold albedo #B8973A but canon GOLD=#D4AF37 is a different, brighter token. Author-error risk is high across agents. Required: add GOLD_BAKED='#B8973A' constant + a comment that #D4AF37 is emissive/frame-only, and that the gold GLB gets glow at runtime via emissiveIntensity 1.5-3.0 (must cross the 0.85 bloom threshold — but note bloom=false on mobile AND potato per mobilePerf.ts:161,186, so on mobile the gold lantern gets NO bloom and must read from albedo+normal alone; verify the antique-gilt reads acceptably without bloom on the binding iOS tier).
- Fix: TTI / DOLLY POP-IN GUARD. The 18s establishing dolly + reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 mean a GLB that finishes loading mid-dolly will visibly pop the dome/fountain in. loadModel is async and uncached-first-load can take >1s over mobile network for 7 GLBs + 3 atlases (~3MB). Required: (a) preload/await the hero dome + drum GLBs and their stone atlas BEFORE the dolly starts (or before the WP1 still composes on the reduced-motion path), keeping decorative GLBs (fountain/urn) as progressive; (b) verify the governor's 15s warmup window (verified mobilePerf.ts: GOV_SAMPLE_MS=15000, demotes a tier for 7 days if >20% frames miss 25ms in >=2 of ~4 windows) is not tripped by GLB decode+upload jank — DRACO decode + first-frame GPU upload of a 8k merged mesh can spike a frame; stagger uploads across frames or upload during the pre-dolly veil.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] REPLACE-NOT-ADD: with W3 ON, renderer.info.render.calls does NOT increase vs W2 by more than +3 (dome + <=2 decorative; capitals/balusters/coppo instanced to 1 call each; drum-windows merged to 1 or 0-if-decal). The procedural dome/drum/balustrade/lantern are provably absent from the merged buffers when their GLB loaded (no double geometry / z-fight at the dome).

- [ ] NO DOUBLE-DARKEN: crevices are not over-darkened — AO is a separate _ao channel on UV0 (aoMap.channel=0), NOT premultiplied into _diff; visual matches a reference with aoMapIntensity toggled.

### WS18 — Lighting: HDRI + baked AO/lightmaps

*Golden-hour HDRI selection, whether to bake AO/lightmaps into assets, how baked + realtime lighting coexist without double-shadowing.*

**Summary:** WS18 is a lighting-integration workstream (not modelling): a shippable-now 3-item slice (env-map SW sun-disc bug fix, desktop background-HDRI swap to CC0 belfast_sunset_puresky_1k, mkPhys aoMapIntensity default) plus a WS11-17-blocked bake slice (per-GLB embedded UV0 AO, desktop-only UV1 lightmap atlases, gold-lantern emissive), all additive and gated behind a NEW flag3d('w3_exterior').
**Priority `P1` · ~4d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.78**

**Vision.** WS18 is a lighting-INTEGRATION workstream, not a modelling one. The runtime already owns the lighting decision per tier (procedural PMREM authoritative on mobile/potato via buildExteriorEnvMap; real HDRI for IBL on desktop+mobile via loadEnvHDRI; background HDRI desktop-only via loadBackgroundHDRI). Grafting the strongest move from each brief, WS18 delivers exactly five additive, W3-gated things and changes NOTHING in the W1/W2 path: (1) swap the desktop BACKGROUND HDRI to Polyhaven CC0 belfast_sunset_puresky_1k (pure-sky, ~500KB vs the 6.5MB tuscan_landscape_2k, zero mobile cost), giving the 18s dolly a real Italian golden-hour horizon that matches the already-authored SW canvas-sky gradient; (2) FIX the procedural env-map sun disc, which today sits at (30,18,-15) — the NE quadrant, i.e. the WRONG side vs the canon SW sun [-20,18,-30] — so IBL specular on new metallic GLBs (gold lantern) lands on the correct face and the procedural-vs-real-HDRI tiers finally agree; (3) mandate a UV0-baked AO channel on EVERY W3 hero GLB, baked in Cycles under a sun lamp numerically identical to the canon DirectionalLight, so mobile/potato read sculptural WITHOUT SSAO; (4) bake ONE 2k Combined lightmap atlas per material family (stone / terracotta) into UV1 for a desktop-only quality push on the WP3 name-beat hero surfaces (dome, drum, stair, tympanum); (5) drive the gold lantern emissive across the 0.85 bloom threshold. The one-grade law (NeutralToneMapping, EXPOSURE=1.15 applied once in the shared EffectPass) is never touched; all Blender bakes are done at Raw/Standard view-transform, exposure 1.0. The result: shadows and sculptural relief read on every tier with ZERO code-path bifurcation, transparent procedural fallback if any GLB fails to load, and a sky that photographs like Villa Lante rather than a neutral studio ball.

**Design decisions:**
- AO vs LIGHTMAP split (resolved): bake AO-ONLY (view- and light-independent) into UV0 as the aoMap for EVERY tier — this is what carries mobile/potato where SSAO and the real HDRI are stripped. Bake a full Combined LIGHTMAP into UV1 ONLY as a desktop quality-push, paired with the real HDRI so colour-match is guaranteed. Never merge the two: baking direct light into the UV0 AO would double-shadow against the realtime DirectionalLight on mobile. This is the hybrid brief's cleanest idea and it dissolves the double-shadow risk structurally rather than by tuning intensities.
- HDRI swap scope (resolved): swap the BACKGROUND HDRI only (tuscan_landscape_2k -> belfast_sunset_puresky_1k), NOT the IBL slot. Rejected the photoreal brief's proposal to also repoint HDRI_EXTERIOR (courtyard_1k IBL) because courtyard_1k already reads as a warm sky for specular, the swap is desktop-background-only (loadBackgroundHDRI), and keeping the IBL slot stable avoids any mobile regression (mobile uses loadEnvHDRI=courtyard, never the background). Ship 1k for background (pure-sky has no ground detail to lose); do NOT ship a 2k — the pure-sky gradient survives blur at backgroundBlurriness 0.03.
- Double-shadow prevention (resolved, structural + belt-and-braces): UV0=AO-only means no baked direct shadow exists to double. Additionally cap aoMapIntensity=0.6 on desktop (SSAO carries high-freq cavity) / 0.8 on mobile (baked AO stands alone, compensating for absent SSAO); UV1 lightMapIntensity=0.5 desktop / 0 mobile (atlas texture not even loaded on mobile — saves the draw call). AO bake ColorRamp floored at 0.3 so flat lit faces never wash below 30%. SSAO stays desktop-only at its existing intensity — unchanged.
- mkPhys default (resolved): add aoMapIntensity default (0.6) inside mkPhys() so every GLTFLoader-imported material — which bypasses mkPhys — inherits a safe value once re-applied. Harmless: only affects materials that actually set an aoMap (procedural materials never do). This is the perf brief's one-liner and it prevents accidental triple-darkening app-wide.
- Env-map sun fix (resolved, and it is a real bug): the current sun disc at (30,18,-15) is NE, the OPPOSITE quadrant from canon SW [-20,18,-30]. Move it to a scaled canon vector (e.g. (-12,11,-18)) and shift the horizon warm-band peak to SW. Cache key auto-invalidates on parameter change. This is unconditional (helps every tier's IBL colour-cast consistency) but ship it INSIDE the W3 flag block first for staging verification, then promote.
- Emissive/bloom (resolved): gold lantern GLB material carries emissive #6B5A20 at strength ~2.0 (crosses the 0.85 luminanceThreshold in the HDR buffer). W3 post-load pass sets emissiveIntensity=2.0 on desktop, 0.0 on mobile (bloom disabled there — emissive would just blow out flat). Only the lantern + tympanum gilt may cross threshold; all non-emissive albedo stays <=0.6 relative luminance (plaster authored at roughness 0.75 so specular stays sub-bloom).
- Warmup-governor safety (resolved): the adaptive governor demotes for 7 days if >20% of frames miss 25ms in the first 15s. The background HDRI (desktop-only anyway) loads via the existing loadHDRIProgressive onFull path AFTER the synchronous geometry pass; guard it so PMREM generation of a 2k never runs during warmup — 1k pure-sky PMREM is ~8ms and safe, so shipping 1k (not 2k) also de-risks the governor.
- No new flag needed for the invisible corrections (env-map sun fix, mkPhys default) once verified — but ALL new asset loads (background HDRI swap, lightmap atlases, emissive override) live inside flag3d('w3_exterior'). W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'). Staging ON / prod OFF automatically. No flag retirement until 60fps verified inside iOS WKWebView with zero governor demotions in the first 15s.
- Bake colour-management law (resolved): all data bakes (AO/normal/rough) at Display=sRGB, View Transform=Raw; diffuse albedo bakes at Standard. NEVER Filmic/AgX — that would perceptually shift values vs Three.js NeutralToneMapping. Bake at exposure 1.0; the 1.15 grade is Three.js-only, applied once.

- Desktop (getQuality high): real belfast_sunset_puresky_1k background HDRI + courtyard_1k IBL + full decorative GLB set + UV1 lightmaps (lightMapIntensity 0.5) + baked UV0 AO (aoMapIntensity 0.6, SSAO carries high-freq cavity) + lantern emissiveIntensity 2.0 (bloom on).
- Mid-mobile (iOS WKWebView, binding target): procedural PMREM env (canvas sky) — NO background HDRI, NO IBL HDRI switch; baked UV0 AO stands alone (aoMapIntensity 0.8, no SSAO); lightmap atlas NOT loaded (lightMapIntensity 0, saves the draw call); emissiveIntensity 0 (bloom off); hero GLB mobile LOD <=60k tris merged-per-material / InstancedMesh.
- Potato: procedural env, NO shadows, NO env map; dome only at ultra-low LOD (<=10k); baked UV0 AO still reads (light-independent); 0 decorative GLBs; lightmap + emissive both off.

**Dependencies:** HARD BLOCKER: bake slice depends on WS11-17 hero GLBs (dome shell, drum ring, fountain tazza, Corinthian capital, baluster, casa-torri/gate block, monumental stair, tympanum) — public/models/exterior/ is EMPTY today (only bust_base.glb + bust_female.glb exist in public/models/). Do NOT schedule bakes until WS11-17 ship geometry with authored UVs., Shippable-now slice (env-map sun fix, background HDRI swap, mkPhys default) has ZERO upstream deps — can land immediately behind w3_exterior., Canon_Sun lamp spec is a TEAM-WIDE constraint every WS11-17 bake must reuse (world direction = normalise(Blender (-20,30,18)) == Three.js GOLDEN.sunPosition [-20,18,-30] after Y-up), so WS18 must publish it before WS11-17 bake., Fast-follow KTX2 (npm run build:ktx2) — NOTE: this script does NOT currently exist in package.json (verified). It must be authored (needs toktx) before the KTX2 fast-follow can run; JPG/WEBP ships first regardless., Confirm Cycles compute_device_type on the authoring machine (AMD 890M iGPU => HIP; if NVIDIA => CUDA/OPTIX) or bakes silently fall to CPU.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: low
- iOS risk: low
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: AO delivery mechanism is broken as specified (loadPBRSet cannot do AO-only)
- Blocker: WS18 bake sub-slice has an unmet hard dependency on WS11-17 hero GLBs that do not exist yet
- Blocker: Two of three named HDRI fallback IDs do not exist in Polyhaven
- Fix: Do NOT ship AO through loadPBRSet: it unconditionally loads all four maps (diff/nor_gl/rough/ao, assetLoader.ts lines 548-551), so an AO-only set 404s the other three and builds a broken PBRTextureSet. The plan's 'AO via loadPBRSet with zero loader changes' is FALSE. Fix: bake AO into each GLB's OWN embedded aoMap (set aoMap.channel=0 in the post-load pass) OR write a new standalone single-texture loader. Prefer embedded-in-GLB so AO travels with the DRACO mesh and needs no separate fetch.
- Fix: Replace the non-existent HDRI fallback IDs. belfast_sunset_puresky is CONFIRMED present, but both named fallbacks (venice_sunset_puresky, golden_bay_puresky) do NOT exist in the Polyhaven DB. Use real alternatives: farm_sunset, magalies_field_sunset, pizzo_pernice_puresky, or drackenstein_quarry_puresky. Re-verify sun azimuth ~213deg SW on whichever is chosen.
- Fix: Split WS18 into (a) a 3-item shippable-now slice and (b) a bake slice blocked on WS11-17. Shippable NOW with zero upstream deps: (1) env-map sun-disc fix in environmentMaps.ts line 167 (30,18,-15 is genuinely NE vs canon SW; real bug), (2) desktop background HDRI swap tuscan_landscape_2k->belfast_sunset_puresky_1k (saves 6MB, desktop-only so zero mobile cost), (3) mkPhys aoMapIntensity default. All AO/lightmap bakes are BLOCKED: they require dome/drum/stair/tympanum GLBs that do not exist yet (public/models/exterior/ contains only the two bust GLBs). Do not schedule the bakes until WS11-17 ship geometry.
- Fix: Re-apply mkPhys manually in the ExteriorScene post-load pass. GLTFLoader bypasses mkPhys, so imported materials keep MeshPhysicalMaterial on mobile (2-3x heavier shader). The plan states this but it must be enforced per-material, and the aoMapIntensity default added to mkPhys only helps materials that go THROUGH mkPhys re-application, not raw GLTF materials.
- Fix: Add the w3_exterior flag to flags3d.ts and gate W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'). It does not exist yet; the plan assumes it. Read once at mount, never per frame.
- Fix: Budget bake time in HOURS not minutes: Cycles runs on an AMD 890M integrated GPU (HIP, shares system RAM), not a discrete card. 2k Combined lightmaps at 256 samples across multiple hero meshes will be slow and may memory-thrash. Offline-only so not a ship blocker, but the 'GPU bake' assumption is weaker than stated.
- Fix: Verify actual exterior draw-call/tri headroom with the dev overlay BEFORE authoring GLBs. The brief claims exterior is 'already near' the 150-call mobile budget, so every W3 GLB must REPLACE procedural geometry (merged-per-material or InstancedMesh), never be additive. This constraint is asserted but not yet measured against renderer.info.render.calls in-repo.

No crevice drops below ~15% luminance; no flat lit face washes below wallMin 0.5 (screenshot-gate at WP3 d=118).

### WS19 — Post-processing for cinematic

*Bloom, tone-mapping, SSAO, subtle DOF/vignette tuned to sell the new assets during the dolly, mobile-safe fallbacks.*

**Summary:** W3 exterior fidelity: 5 fully-scriptable-BPY DRACO GLB hero assets (segmented ogival dome, arched drum thermal-bay tile, acanthus Corinthian capital, lathe baluster, gold tympanum+lantern) streamed through the proven modelLoader path behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), REPLACING procedural geometry to keep draw calls flat, plus a code-only cinematic post-grade; fountain/figural work demoted to a fast-follow gated on generative tools; draw-call instrumentation and one baked-AO probe asset land BEFORE authoring the kit.
**Priority `P1` · ~14d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Lift the exterior ~1000x by replacing the highest-ROI procedural approximations with a small set of Blender-authored, DRACO-compressed GLB hero assets (segmented ogival dome, arched thermal-bay drum tile, acanthus Corinthian capital, lathe baluster, carved fountain tazza) streamed through the already-proven modelLoader path, plus a code-only cinematic post-grade that makes those assets read at the three dolly beats that matter (WP1/WP3/WP5). Everything gates behind a fresh flag3d('w3_exterior') (W3 = W2 && flag). GLBs REPLACE procedural geometry (merged-per-material or instanced, never additive), carry baked AO on UV0 so mobile/potato get depth without SSAO, and match the single sun (#FFB870 @ [-20,18,-30]) and single NeutralToneMapping grade (exposure 1.15, bake at 1.0). The post-grade adds ZERO new passes on mobile/potato and no new draw calls anywhere — only tuned uniforms, one desktop-only DOF EffectPass, and a CSS grain overlay. Ship JPG/WEBP first, KTX2 as fast-follow. Author one mobile LOD ≤750k whole-scene; profile clean during the 15s governor warmup, not after settle.

**Design decisions:**
- FLAG: introduce flag3d('w3_exterior'); W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), read once at mount. Do NOT retire W1/W2 flags until W3 is prod+iOS verified. Rejected any hardcoded gating.
- POST-GRADE SYNTHESIS — take the PERF-FIRST brief as the spine (zero new mobile passes, cheap uniform tweaks, CSS grain), graft the HYBRID brief's desktop-only DOF-as-separate-EffectPass lifecycle (avoids polluting the shared preset / mobile path), and DROP the PHOTOREAL-MAX brief's heavier moves (samples=32, chromatic-aberration ShaderPass, real-HDRI IBL swap) as over-budget for the binding iOS target and risk of governor demotion during the exact warmup window the effect plays in.
- BLOOM: keep luminanceThreshold=0.85 (MUSEO VIVO dogma — memories/gold/tympanum are the only pixels above threshold). Raise exterior intensity 0.6→0.9 (desktop only; mobile bloom already false). Reject threshold changes (0.88 pollutes nothing but risks losing lantern flare) and reject radius=0.9 mipmap spread (halo risk on dome-vs-sky at WP1).
- CINEMATIC BLOOM RAMP: desktop-only, w3-gated Float32Array target-per-waypoint [0.5,0.8,1.1,0.9,0.7]; one uniform write per frame lerped with dt clamped to 100ms (kills resume-flash). Requires createPostProcessing to RETURN a handle — change signature to return {composer, bloomEffect} (bloomEffect null on mobile). This is the one required loader-file API change; all call sites read .composer.
- SSAO: keep desktop-only (q.ssao guard). Retune exterior to radius 0.05 (between the two brief proposals — reads capital acanthus grooves AND drum-window reveals), intensity 1.5→2.0, bias 0.02→0.015, worldDistanceThreshold 20→15, worldDistanceFalloff 5→3 (kills terrain 'soup' + dome-vs-sky halo at WP1). Keep samples=16 (proven budget; reject 32). SSAO is ADDITIVE on top of baked AO, not a replacement.
- DOF: desktop-only, onboarding-only, reduced-motion-OFF. Created as a SEPARATE EffectPass appended in the W3 block (NOT via shared preset — keeps dof:false in preset so mobile never builds it), inserted BEFORE the main SMAA EffectPass so bokeh edges anti-alias. Single subtle rack at the WP4 close-pass (t=12–15s): bokehScale capped at 2.0. dofPassRef disposed the instant onboardingMode→false (skip-tap leak guard). Reject the always-on multi-stop DOF from photoreal brief (fights wide-shot depth read + governor cost).
- VIGNETTE: raise exterior darkness 0.35→0.42, offset 0.25→0.30. This is the ONLY post change that touches mobile — it is a free full-screen quad (microseconds), keeps the eye centre-frame on the new architecture. Reject 0.45 (clips on high-brightness mobile).
- GRAIN: 64×64 base64 white-noise PNG as an absolute CSS overlay div (mix-blend-mode:overlay, ~4% opacity, pointer-events:none, z-index:1, sibling-after-canvas per the existing cream-veil pattern), NOT a GPU pass. 0 draw calls, all tiers. opacity→0 under prefers-reduced-motion. Reject the Blender-baked LUT + ShaderPass grain (needless GPU cost + iOS DPR artifact risk).
- TONE-MAP: no change — NeutralToneMapping, EXPOSURE=1.15, applied once in the ToneMappingEffect (renderer at NoToneMapping). Add a canon.ts comment documenting the bake-at-1.0 / lift-15% contract for GLB authors. Emissive gold authored at linear ~1.8 (Blender Emission Strength ~2.2 @ Filmic exposure 1.0) so it lands above 0.85 AFTER tone-map.
- GLB INTEGRATION: load ASYNC in the scene useEffect AFTER the synchronous procedural pass, in try/catch, fall back to procedural on reject. Use pooled renderer only (never a 2nd WebGL context). Re-apply mkPhys() to every loaded material (GLTFLoader bypasses it; strips clearcoat/sheen/transmission on mobile). Dispose via clearModelCache() at unmount only; never dispose clones. Instance repeats via InstancedMesh with per-instance rot/scale jitter ('grown-over-centuries'); mergeGeometries per-material on uniques. GLBs must REPLACE the procedural geometry they supersede so draw calls stay flat (mobile ceiling 150/frame, exterior already near it).
- BUDGET CEILINGS (binding = iOS/WKWebView): author ONE mobile LOD ≤750k whole-scene; ≤60k tris mobile decorative, ≤15 GLB draw calls mobile, max 2 decorative GLBs on mobile (hero fountain + 1 urn), ≤500KB/asset, ≤8MB GPU, DRACO mandatory. Desktop ≤150–200k GLB tris, full decorative set. Potato: 0 decorative GLBs, dome only at ultra-low LOD ≤10k, no shadows/env.
- EXPORT: DRACO level 6 (pos 14 / nrm 10 / uv 12), export_apply, export_yup, WEBP embedded → public/models/exterior/<name>.glb. Assert GLB header (magic 0x46546C67, v2, extensionsUsed ⊇ KHR_draco_mesh_compression). NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail). KTX2 is a fast-follow via npm run build:ktx2 + manifest feature-detect with per-file JPG fallback.
- BAKE CONTRACT: bake AO+NORMAL+ROUGHNESS+curvature on Cycles GPU, selected-to-active with cage. Baked AO uses a Blender sun matched to [-20,18,-30] (azimuth ~213°, elevation ~28°), max-distance ~0.8m, into UV0 ONLY (assetLoader hardcodes aoMap.channel=0). Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default). Save PBR as public/textures/pbr/<set>/<prefix>_<kind>_<res>.jpg; ship 1k first (404→1k fallback across tiers). Cap unique PBR material-sets at ≤4 (mobile eager cap) — share stone/terracotta/metal atlases aggressively.
- ASSET ROUTING: architectural/deterministic assets = SCRIPTED BPY (lathe/SCREW/array/curve-sweep) — dome, drum tile, capital, baluster, roof coppo, tympanum text (generators mangle text). Figural (fountain mascaron, statuary) = GENERATIVE image→3D (Hunyuan3D primary, Rodin alternate) — BUT both are currently DISABLED; owner must enable + confirm commercial license before any figural work, so the fountain ships v1 as scripted tazza with a placeholder mascaron and figural detail is a fast-follow. Polyhaven = CC0 textures/HDRI backbone only, never villa geometry. Sketchfab skipped (NC/ND license risk for a paid app).

**Assets:**
- **dome_shell.glb (segmented ogival terracotta dome — HIGHEST ROI, visible every waypoint)** — Scripted BPY: 8-panel lathe/screw ogival shell + proud modeled travertine ribs (curve profile swept along meridians) + coppo-terracotta webs (one tile → geo-node instance-on-points with rot/scale jitter → baked to one mesh). Merge to one mesh per material. Replaces the smooth procedural hemisphere. Baked AO on UV0. ~2 shared material-sets.

Placed via InstancedMesh ×12 around the drum with slight jitter. Replaces the flat box-sticker drum windows. · ~3–5k per master tile; ×12 instanced = 1 draw call. - **capital_corinthian.glb (acanthus Corinthian capital — most-read at 7.5s tympanum beat, d=118)** — Scripted BPY base + sculpt detail for acanthus/caulicoli/volutes; bake hi→low (smart_project island_margin 0.02, UV0 only).
