### WS20 — LOD strategy & poly/draw-call budgets

*Per-asset LOD tiers, impostors/billboards at distance, draw-call batching/instancing, the desktop/mobile/iOS budget split.*

**Summary:** W3 exterior GLB program: 7 scripted-BPY hero masonry assets authored in Blender as DRACO GLBs with embedded LODs, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior') and swapped in as REPLACEMENTS for procedural meshes, but only after a mandatory step-0 refactor makes hero procedural elements individually removable and a governor-audition-done handoff replaces the broken magic-timer deferral.
**Priority `P1` · ~14d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** One geometry set, three read-outs. Author every hero exterior element ONCE in Blender as a DRACO GLB carrying its own LOD meshes, then let device tier + the 18s dolly decide which mesh renders. The binding constraint is the iOS WKWebView "mobile" tier (750k tri / 80-call / ~140MB GPU ceiling, governor demotes presets not meshes) — desktop is just "mobile geometry + higher-res textures + more decorative instances on top." The governing law is the perf-first brief's: draw calls, not triangles, are the mobile killer, so every repeated element collapses to ONE InstancedMesh and every static unique is merged-per-material inside Blender before export. Every GLB REPLACES a procedural mesh (net draw-call delta ≤0 per tier) rather than adding to it. Quality gains are front-loaded at the three reduced-motion anchor stills — WP1 (d≈185, wide silhouette), WP3 (d≈118, the tympanum name-beat, single most-read frame), WP5 (d≈40–63, entrance close-up) — and anything invisible at those beats is deferred or stays procedural. Result target: a perceptible fidelity leap (segmented ogival ribbed dome, deep-reveal thermal-bay drum, real acanthus capitals, lathe balusters, carved fountain) holding 60fps inside WKWebView, gated behind flag3d('w3_exterior') so staging is ON and prod is OFF until iOS is verified.

**Design decisions:**
- TIER MODEL (hybrid, iOS-binding): Three tiers, ONE authored geometry family. Desktop ≤200k exterior-GLB tris / ≤30 GLB draw calls / 1k(-2k) textures / full decorative set. Mobile==iOS binding tier ≤60k GLB tris / +≤12 GLB draw calls net (hard ceiling 80 total, exterior is already ~65) / 1k textures / DRACO mandatory / ≤500KB per asset (dome GLB may reach ~800KB as the single 'hero' exception, still <1MB). Potato = 0 decorative GLBs, dome-only ultra-low LOD (≤1k tris, baked AO only, no normal, no env map); everything else falls back to the existing procedural meshes which already pass potato framerates.
- LOD DELIVERY (grafted, simplified): Embed LOD meshes as named collections inside ONE GLB per asset (lod0_/lod1_/lod2_ prefix), never multiple files. Reject a full THREE.LOD graph for most assets — use the hybrid brief's simpler rule: at import, read getGPUTier() ONCE, activate the matching LOD by visibility and geometry.dispose() the unused LODs to free VRAM. Reserve a real THREE.LOD object ONLY for the dome, the one asset whose silhouette must survive the full dolly range (d=185→40) — distances [0,125,999] so WP3 (d=118) ALWAYS gets LOD0 on desktop. Mask the single dome LOD seam (crossed ~t=10s at d=125) with the existing dolly motion blur; add a morph-target crossfade only if QA shows a visible pop.
- DRAW-CALL COLLAPSE (the #1 rule, from all three): (a) balustrade runs on the same material = ONE InstancedMesh (1 DC any count); (b) drum thermal-bay tiles merged in Blender OR one tile + runtime InstancedMesh 12x = 1 DC; (c) dome+drum+lantern export as ONE GLB, max 3 materials (travertine shell / terracotta bay surround / gold lantern) = 3 DC; (d) capitals = 1 InstancedMesh; (e) urns = 1 InstancedMesh; (f) fountain = 1 unique GLB, 1 material. Set frustumCulled=false on the wide baluster and drum InstancedMeshes so orbiting behind the corps never pops the whole batch at the tympanum angle. Assert renderer.info.render.calls in a dev overlay (behind flag3d('w3_perf_hud')); if mobile total >72, skip the lowest-priority GLB (drum tile) and keep its procedural fallback.
- GOVERNOR SAFETY (resolved conflict — this was the sharpest disagreement between briefs): The photoreal brief wanted GLBs to resolve DURING warmup so the governor auditions on final geometry; the perf/hybrid briefs wanted scene.add() DEFERRED past the 15s window so a shader-compile spike can't cause a spurious demotion. RESOLUTION: split the timeline. Start loadModel() network fetches + TextureLoader pre-warm at mount immediately (network/decode cost only, no GPU spike). Because every GLB REPLACES a procedural mesh (remove-proc + add-glb in the same frame), draw-call count stays flat and the swap is not additive — so on DESKTOP swap in-place as each resolves (fast, cached, spike is negligible relative to headroom). On MOBILE/iOS, batch all scene.add()+InstancedMesh construction into one rAF gated by a setTimeout(15500) sentinel (or governor-done check) so the audition runs on the stable procedural baseline; the procedural fallback is fully correct for those 15s. This gives desktop its early fidelity and gives iOS its demotion-proof warmup.
- INTEGRATION SEAM (concrete): In ExteriorScene.tsx, after the closing brace of the `if (W2) {…}` block and before the `// ── CINEMATIC DOLLY` comment, insert `const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior');` then an async block. loadModel() already exists (GLTFLoader+DRACOLoader, /draco/ decoder, caches master + returns clone). Wrap each load in try/catch → on reject leave the procedural mesh in place and log '[w3] GLB load failed, staying procedural'. CRITICAL ORDER: await loadModel(); THEN scene.remove(proceduralMesh); THEN scene.add(glbGroup) — never remove before resolve (avoids a visual hole on reject). clearModelCache() only at unmount, never dispose clones. Use the pooled renderer (rendererPool.ts) — never open a 2nd WebGL context (iOS jetsam kills it silently).
- mkPhys RE-APPLY (verified mandatory): Confirmed in modelLoader.ts — loadModel() only sets castShadow/receiveShadow and keeps GLTFLoader's own MeshStandardMaterial; mkPhys() is bypassed. Ship a helper glbApplyMkPhys(group) that traverses and replaces each child.material with mkPhys(THREE, { color, map, normalMap, roughnessMap, aoMap, metalness, roughness }) forwarding the existing map references explicitly (Object.assign stripping loses maps otherwise). Author STANDARD PBR only (BaseColor/Metallic/Roughness/Normal + baked AO on UV0) — clearcoat/sheen/transmission are stripped on mobile.
- INSTANCEDMESH SHADOWS (verified gap): modelLoader traverses THREE.Mesh only, so InstancedMesh never gets shadow flags. After building each InstancedMesh set .castShadow=true and .receiveShadow=true on the InstancedMesh object itself (mid-mobile runs shadowMapSize=1024, shadowsEnabled). Extract geometry from clone.children[0], build ONE InstancedMesh(geo, mat, N), setMatrixAt per instance with ±0.5° rot / small scale jitter for the 'grown-over-centuries' asymmetry — never clone-and-add N meshes.
- BAKE MATCH (non-negotiable so GLB doesn't clash): Blender sun lamp EXACTLY at position [-20,18,-30] (#FFB870, ~28° elev / ~213° az) matching the runtime DirectionalLight; bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 once — never per-asset). Bake AO to UV0 (aoMap.channel=0 hardcoded in assetLoader). Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default). Palette canon albedo, no deviation: PLASTER #F2E9DA, TRAVERTINE #E8DCC0/#E3D6BC, coppo-terracotta #B0725A, INK #403B36, GOLD #B8973A (lantern + tympanum ONLY), EMBER #B85C38 (interactive only). Non-photo assets ≤0.6 relative luminance (memories stay the brightest pixels). Emissive 1.5–3.0 only on lantern/gold to cross the 0.85 bloom threshold.
- TEXTURE ATLAS (share aggressively — mobile eager cap = 4 sets): ONE shared 'stone' atlas (1k, procedural voronoi+noise travertine/plaster baked, NOT a Polyhaven scan — no match exists) covers dome shell / drum surround / capitals / balusters / fountain pedestal. ONE 'terracotta' atlas (Polyhaven clay_roof_tiles_02 or ceramic_roof_01 CC0 base, colour-corrected to #B0725A) covers dome coppo cap / casa-torri roofs / urn body. Desktop adds 'gold' (procedural #B8973A, roughness 0.15–0.25, metalness 0.88 — lantern + tympanum) and 'carved_stone' (wetter travertine roughness 0.55 — fountain tazza + mascaron). Mobile loads only stone+terracotta (2 sets). Contract {prefix}_{diff|nor_gl|rough|ao}_{res}.jpg in /public/textures/pbr/{name}/; ship 1k JPG first (all tiers 404→1k fallback); KTX2 via `npm run build:ktx2` (toktx) as fast-follow with per-file JPG fallback and a single cache key so JPG+KTX2 never co-reside on GPU. NEVER ship raw PNG albedo (one 2k RGBA = 16MB).
- EXPORT CONTRACT: DRACO level 6, position 14 / normal 10 / uv 12 bits; export_apply=True (bake modifiers), export_yup=True; WEBP textures embedded for single-file delivery OR reference the shared atlas path. Assert GLB header magic 0x46546C67 v2 and extensionsUsed ⊇ KHR_draco_mesh_compression before committing. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail). UV channel 0 only via smart_project(island_margin=0.02). Destination public/models/exterior/. Pre-warm the DRACO worker: fire a dummy loadModel('/models/bust_base.glb') at scene mount (decoder already warm from busts) so the first exterior GLB doesn't pay ~300ms WASM cold-start on low-end iOS.
- AUTHORING ROUTE: All 7 hero masonry assets are SCRIPTED BPY (deterministic, re-runnable, reviewable) — SCREW/lathe for domes/balusters/capitals/urns, ARRAY+boolean+SOLIDIFY for drum tiles/arcades, extruded curve OUTLINE for tympanum lettering (NEVER generative text — generators mangle glyphs). GENERATIVE (Hunyuan3D single-image primary, Rodin alternate for hero center-frame) is reserved ONLY for organic figural elements: the fountain mascaron and any statuary/coats-of-arms — and both are DISABLED, requiring an explicit owner action (tick N-panel checkbox + restart + confirm commercial-license tier). If Hunyuan3D stays off, export the fountain LOD0 WITHOUT the mascaron via Blender collection visibility — it still ships as a clean tazza. Sketchfab SKIPPED (disabled + NC/ND license risk for a paid app). Polyhaven CC0 for TEXTURE + HDRI backbone ONLY, never villa geometry.
- VALIDATION GATES before flag retirement: (1) iOS WKWebView profiling renderer.info: triangles ≤750k, calls ≤80, GPU ≤140MB. (2) Governor non-demotion: 3 cold mobile loads with GLBs ON, zero demotion events in console. (3) Anchor stills correct at exactly WP1/WP3/WP5 — dome silhouette + rib articulation + capital acanthus must read against the sky, tympanum name legible at WP3. (4) Reduced-motion path composes the WP1/WP3/WP5 stills, so every hero asset must be correct at those three angles with NO animation dependency. (5) iOS seal intact — no App-Review-breaking regression, no new WebGL context, no main-thread block (GLTFLoader parse is off-thread). Then `npx vercel --prod`; retire flag only after prod+iOS verified.
- i18n + reduced-motion: any new UI strings (perf HUD labels excepted as dev-only) go through the flat-section t() lookup (dotted sub-keys stored FLAT). No asset animation may be the sole source of a hero read (reduced-motion stills must hold).

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: medium
- iOS risk: medium
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: GOVERNOR TIMING IS WRONG BY ~4s (the single most load-bearing error). The plan hardcodes setTimeout(15500) from mount as the mobile scene.add() deferral. Verified in mobilePerf.ts: the governor is armed on the FIRST getQuality() call (line 220 -> startGovernorOnce), and ExteriorScene calls getQuality() synchronously at effect line 88 (~mount). But the sample span is GOV_WARMUP_MS(2500) + GOV_SAMPLE_MS(15000) = ~17500ms, and warmup only STARTS being measured after the first rAF. So the governor is still auditioning until ~t=17.5s, not 15s. Deferring GLB scene.add to 15500ms injects a shader-compile + texture-upload spike DURING the last ~2s of the live audition -> can cause the exact spurious 7-day demotion the plan claims to prevent. This is a real, self-inflicted regression risk.
- Blocker: GLTFLoader main-thread cost is understated. Plan repeatedly claims 'GLTFLoader parse is off-thread / no main-thread block.' Verified: only DRACO geometry DECODE runs in the DRACOLoader worker pool. The glTF scene-graph build, material creation, and — critically — GPU texture upload of embedded WEBP/KTX2 all happen on the MAIN thread inside the resolve callback. Uploading two 1k atlases + several geometry buffers in one frame on an iPhone is a multi-frame hitch. On mobile this lands inside/adjacent to the governor window (see blocker 1). modelLoader.ts does no decoder preload and no worker-limit tuning.
- Blocker: 'GLBs REPLACE procedural geometry so net draw-call delta <=0' is ASSERTED but UNBUILDABLE as written. Verified ExteriorScene builds the corps via mergeGeometries into per-material merged meshes (line ~565) — the dome/drum/balusters/capitals are NOT separable scene objects you can scene.remove() individually; they are baked into shared merged BufferGeometry with terrain/walls/roofs. There is no handle to remove 'the procedural dome' without re-architecting the W2 merge to keep hero elements as separate removable meshes FIRST. Until that refactor lands, every GLB is ADDITIVE, blowing the +0 draw-call claim and the 80-call iOS ceiling.
- Blocker: toktx is NOT installed (verified: 'toktx NOT on PATH'). The KTX2 fast-follow (build:ktx2 -> scripts/build-ktx2.mjs exists) cannot run in this environment. Not a launch blocker since JPG/WEBP ships first, but the plan's mobile VRAM math (~86MB) partly relies on eventual KTX2 compression; raw 1k JPG atlases decode to ~4MB EACH uncompressed on GPU and the embedded-WEBP-in-GLB path still decodes to full RGBA in VRAM.
- Blocker: No KTX2Loader is currently wired into modelLoader.ts (verified: grep found no setKTX2Loader/KTX2Loader in modelLoader). The plan calls it 'one line' but it needs the renderer handle from rendererPool and a transcoder in /public — untested integration, and GLB-embedded KTX2 without a registered transcoder is a SILENT decode failure (same failure class the plan flags for meshopt).
- Fix: FIX THE GOVERNOR HANDOFF PROPERLY, do not use a magic number. Either: (a) export a governorAuditionDone() boolean/Promise from mobilePerf.ts and gate mobile scene.add() on it (clean, deterministic); OR (b) if keeping a timer, set the mobile deferral to >=18000ms (GOV_WARMUP_MS+GOV_SAMPLE_MS+margin) measured from the same getQuality() call, NOT 15500 from mount. Verify with the '3 cold mobile loads, zero demotion events' gate the plan already specifies.
- Fix: REFACTOR THE W2 MERGE BEFORE W3, or the replacement premise collapses. ### WS21 — GLB export + DRACO/meshopt integration

*Concrete export settings, decoder compatibility, disposal, and additive integration into ExteriorScene via modelLoader without breaking the procedural fallback.*

**Summary:** Stream 5 scripted-bpy DRACO GLB hero assets (dome, baluster, capital, drum-bay, fountain-body) into ExteriorScene behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), REPLACING (never layering) the highest-ROI procedural geometry, with a cache-safe clone-only material path, on-device draw-call measurement, and a dome_shell.glb end-to-end pipeline canary proven before scaling out.
**Priority `P1` · ~9d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Raise perceived exterior quality by streaming a small set of Blender-authored, DRACO-compressed hero GLBs into ExteriorScene.tsx behind a new flag3d('w3_exterior'), REPLACING (never layering on) the highest-ROI procedural geometry at the three reduced-motion stills (WP1/WP3/WP5) and along the 18s dolly. The pipeline reuses the production-proven DRACOLoader/GLTFLoader/modelLoader.ts stack verified in code (loadModel caches masters, returns clones, auto castShadow/receiveShadow) plus the mkPhys mobile-strip gate (verified: strips clearcoat/transmission/sheen and downgrades MeshPhysical→MeshStandard on mobile). W3 = W1 && W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), read once at mount (confirmed flag semantics: staging ON / prod OFF via PROD_HOSTS, sessionStorage-persisted, ?flag3d= override). Lens resolution: PHOTOREAL-MAX on desktop is free because mkPhys auto-strips physical props on mobile — so author clearcoat/transmission liberally; but the BINDING master is the PERF-FIRST iOS WKWebView budget, and the HYBRID rule governs scope: keep every strong procedural system (sky, terrain, grass/wheat/foliage shaders, procedural env PMREM, all merge-bucket masonry) and swap ONLY the five elements where a hero GLB yields the biggest quality jump per byte. Every GLB is draw-call-neutral (merged-per-material or InstancedMesh, with the matched procedural mesh removed synchronously on load) and has a null-safe procedural fallback on any 404/DRACO/timeout failure.

**Design decisions:**
- FLAG: add `const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior')` immediately after the verified `const W2=W1&&flag3d('w2_exterior')` at ExteriorScene.tsx line 98. Read once at mount (never per-frame). All GLB code lives strictly inside `if(W3){}`. No flag retirement until prod+iOS verified. (All three briefs agree; grafted verbatim.)
- INTEGRATION SEAM: one async IIFE after the synchronous W2 geometry pass, guarded by a `mountedRef` (set false in cleanup) to survive scene-unmount races (iOS jetsam guard from brief 2). Use `Promise.allSettled` (brief 1) NOT `Promise.all` (briefs 2/3) so one 404 never blocks the rest — this is the correct resolution: individual try/catch per asset, procedural stand-in stays until its GLB resolves. Add a 10s timeout: if unresolved, abort swap and stay on W2 (brief 2 governor-safety).
- GOVERNOR-SAFE DEFERRAL (resolve brief-1 vs brief-3 tension): the governor samples the first 15s of rAF deltas; a mid-warmup geometry upload can demote desktop→mobile. Defer applyW3Material()+scene.add() into requestIdleCallback (200ms timeout fallback) AND only kick the async IIFE after the rAF loop is stable, so uploads land between frames. Per-asset GPU upload kept ≤8MB.
- REPLACE-NOT-ADD (draw-call neutrality, all briefs): every GLB author must identify the procedural mesh(es) it supersedes and remove them. loadExteriorModel() takes an optional `fallbackMesh`/`fallbackMeshes[]` that is scene.remove()'d BEFORE scene.add(group). Track replaced meshes in a `w3ReplacedMeshes` array. Dev HUD call-counter enforces net-neutral or negative draw-call delta.
- LOADER UPGRADE (non-breaking): add `loadExteriorModel(path, {fallback, tier, pbrSet})` to modelLoader.ts wrapping the existing verified loadModel(). Add a runtime meshopt-canary: after gltf.scene, if child Mesh count === 0, reject with 'GLB loaded 0 meshes — likely meshopt/empty export' (brief 1). Keep loadModel()/clearModelCache() signatures untouched — bust_base.glb/bust_female.glb path is the warm DRACO decoder canary and must not change.
- applyW3Material() (mkPhys re-application, all briefs, mandatory): traverse group; for every Mesh call mkPhys(THREE,{...}) to route through the verified mobile-strip gate (GLTFLoader bypasses it, giving raw MeshStandard). Force `mat.aoMap.channel = 0` on every aoMap (GLTFLoader defaults channel 1; assetLoader hardcodes 0; procedural/exported game meshes have no UV2 → AO silently zero otherwise). Re-assign castShadow/receiveShadow. Apply scene env map. POTATO CONTRACT: on potato tier, replace every material with flat MeshBasicMaterial (albedo color only, no env, no shadows, no textures) before scene.add — OR simply skip the GLB (potato loads 0 decorative GLBs per budget). Chosen: potato loads ZERO decorative GLBs and only the ultra-low dome LOD via MeshBasic.
- TEXTURE STRATEGY (resolve brief-1 embed-WEBP vs brief-3 reuse-existing-sets): HYBRID — REUSE the two existing on-disk PBR sets (public/textures/pbr/travertine/ and public/textures/pbr/terracotta_tiles/, confirmed as the intended shared sets) applied post-load via mkPhys, AND export GLBs with `export_materials='NONE'` (brief 3) so NO textures are embedded. Rationale: bypasses the verified mobile eager-set cap (getQuality().maxEagerTextureSets = 4 on mobile / 2 potato) because these two sets are already counted in W2; embedding new WEBP would push to 6 sets and blow the cap. This is strictly better than brief-1's embed-everything. Gold lantern uses procedural mkPhys (#B8973A) — no texture file. Net new PBR texture files required: ZERO.
- LOD MECHANISM (resolve brief-1 dual-mesh-in-GLB vs runtime-swap): author TWO LODs per hero asset packed in one GLB as a THREE.LOD (distance thresholds tuned to the dolly: LOD0 near, LOD1 ≥80 units) for dome only; for instanced elements (baluster/capital/drum-bay) ship a single mid-poly mesh sized to the mobile budget and reduce INSTANCE COUNT per tier rather than swapping geometry (simpler, draw-call identical). Tier routing: potato=0 decorative GLBs (dome ultra-LOD MeshBasic only), mobile=dome+fountain (2 GLBs), desktop=all 5.
- DRACO EXPORT CONTRACT (binding, all briefs converge): export_format='GLB', export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=True, level=6, position_quant=14, normal_quant=10, texcoord_quant=12, color_quant=10, export_apply=True (bake modifiers), export_yup=True, export_texcoords=True, export_normals=True, export_materials='NONE'. NEVER meshopt/EXT_meshopt_compression (no MeshoptDecoder registered — confirmed modelLoader.ts only setDRACOLoader → silent empty scene).
- EXPORT-TIME ASSERTIONS (in the bpy script, before writing the file): read the .glb bytes, assert magic 0x46546C67 ('glTF') + version==2, assert 'KHR_draco_mesh_compression' IN extensionsUsed, assert 'EXT_meshopt_compression' NOT in extensionsUsed, assert exactly one UV layer named UVMap/UV0. Per-file ceiling ≤500KB compressed / ≤8MB GPU-resident.
- DISPOSAL CONTRACT: track all W3-loaded groups in a sceneRef array; on useEffect cleanup, iterate BEFORE the existing scene.traverse sweep and dispose each group's geometry + any standalone materials/textures created post-load, then scene.remove(). NEVER call clearModelCache() at scene unmount (cache must survive SPA navigation so the 2nd mount skips the fetch — matches verified PBR-cache contract); clearModelCache() is app-teardown only. Do not register GLB materials into allTexSets/disposePBRSet.
- VALIDATION GATE before prod-promote: dev-only HUD (W3 && NODE_ENV!=='production') showing renderer.info.render.triangles/calls + AO-channel diagnostic. Desktop: ≤200k exterior tris, ≤30 GLB calls, no governor demotion in 15s warmup. iOS WKWebView (BINDING): ≤750k total tris, ≤80 total calls, ≤4 GLB draw calls, ≤140MB tex, ~60fps ≥15s, reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 render correct, bust GLBs still load. Then `npx vercel --prod` + on-device iOS spot-check before any flag retirement.

**Feasibility:**
- Perf risk: medium
- iOS risk: medium
- Blender MCP can produce: yes
- Blocker: DISPOSAL CORRUPTION: loadModel() returns model.clone(); Three.js Mesh.clone() SHARES geometry+material by reference with the cached master. The plan's disposal contract ('dispose each W3 group's geometry + materials on cleanup') will dispose the cached master's buffers, so the NEXT scene mount clones disposed geometry -> GL errors / invisible dome / possible context loss. This is a hard bug, not a risk.
- Blocker: mkPhys MISUSE: mkPhys(THREE, props) CONSTRUCTS a new material from a props object; it cannot 're-wrap' an already-loaded GLTF MeshStandardMaterial. applyW3Material as written ('call mkPhys to route through the strip gate') is not implementable as stated and, because clones share material refs, naively assigning a new material mutates the cached master for every future clone.
- Blocker: iOS WKWebView LACKS requestIdleCallback: the plan's governor-safety deferral (defer GPU upload via rIC with 200ms fallback) collapses to setTimeout on the exact binding target (iOS). setTimeout does NOT guarantee uploads land between frames, so a mid-warmup DRACO-decode + GPU-upload spike can still trip the 15s adaptive governor (>20% missed frames in >=2 windows) and persist a desktop->mobile demotion for 7 days.
- Fix: FIX DISPOSAL: on scene unmount, only scene.remove() the W3 clones and null references. NEVER dispose a clone's geometry/material/textures (they belong to the cached master). Dispose ONLY standalone objects the runtime created post-load (e.g. the procedural water disc, any freshly-built InstancedMesh geometry). Rely on clearModelCache() at app teardown for the masters. Add a comment/guard so no downstream agent adds a traverse-and-dispose sweep over W3 groups.
- Fix: FIX MATERIAL PATH: in applyW3Material, for each Mesh read the loaded MeshStandardMaterial's props, build a fresh material via mkPhys(THREE, {...extracted, map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap from the reused travertine/terracotta sets}), force aoMap.channel=0, set envMap, re-set castShadow/receiveShadow, then assign to the CLONE only. Do this on the clone returned by loadModel, never on the cached master. (Consider adding a modelLoader helper that deep-clones materials for the exterior path so the cache stays pristine.)
- Fix: FIX GOVERNOR TIMING: do not rely on requestIdleCallback (absent on iOS). Either (a) gate the async IIFE + scene.add to fire only AFTER the 15s governor sample window closes, or (b) chunk uploads one-mesh-per-rAF using the existing scenePreloader setTimeout-fallback scheduler, and verify on-device that no window in the first 15s exceeds 20% frames >25ms. This is the single most important iOS-demotion guard.
- Fix: MEASURE DON'T ASSERT draw calls: before promote, wire the dev HUD to read renderer.info.render.calls/triangles on a real mid mobile device and confirm each GLB nets <=0 draw-call delta vs the procedural mesh it replaces (the 'W2 near ceiling' premise is currently unverified; 95 scene.add calls != render.calls after merges).
- Fix: PROVE THE BLENDER ROUND-TRIP on ONE canary (dome_shell.glb) end-to-end before committing to all 5: execute_blender_code author -> smart_project UV0 -> Cycles GPU bake NORMAL+AO+ROUGH selected-to-active with cage -> DRACO export (level6/pos14/nrm10/uv12, materials=NONE, yup) -> byte-assert magic+KHR_draco+no-meshopt+single-UV -> load in-app via loadModel. The bake step is the least-proven MCP operation; validate it produces a <500KB, correctly-UV'd, AO-on-UV0 GLB before scaling out.
- Fix: SCOPE THE '1000x' CLAIM: figural statuary / fountain mascaron require Hunyuan3D or Rodin, both currently DISABLED (owner must enable N-panel + restart + confirm commercial-license tier). Ship W3 on scripted-bpy assets only (dome, baluster, capital, drum-bay, fountain-body, lantern) with normal-baked placeholder relief; do not gate W3 on generative statuary and do not promise organic figures until the generative route is enabled and license-cleared.
- Fix: CONFIRM per-clone shadow flags: loadModel sets castShadow/receiveShadow on the master before clone, which clones inherit, but potato tier disables shadows (shadowMapSize 0) -- ensure applyW3Material respects getQuality().shadowsEnabled and that potato loads ZERO decorative GLBs (dome ultra-LOD only, MeshBasic, no env/shadow) as the plan states.

### WS22 — Progressive streaming & loading UX

*Load order, lazy/priority streaming, poster/placeholder, KTX2 texture streaming, avoiding TTI/first-paint regression.*

**Summary:** Author 5 hero masonry GLBs (dome, drum-bay, capital, baluster, fountain) via scripted BPY, DRACO+embedded-WEBP export to public/models/exterior/, streamed behind flag3d('w3_exterior') using the scene's OWN local renderer (not the pool); dome-only on mobile, procedural fallback everywhere; generative capital/mascaron deferred until owner enables Hunyuan/Rodin.
**Priority `P2` · ~9d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Graft the three briefs into one HYBRID-with-perf-discipline design. Keep every strong procedural system (terrain, grass/wheat shaders, instanced cypresses, sky, daylight, postprocessing) untouched — they are already performance-optimal. Replace ONLY the 5 highest-ROI hero masonry elements with Blender-authored DRACO GLBs, streamed in behind a fresh flag3d('w3_exterior') gate so W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), staging-ON / prod-OFF automatically.

The procedural geometry IS the placeholder and the permanent fallback: it renders synchronously in the first frame exactly as today (zero TTI regression), and a priority-ordered ASYNC waterfall hot-swaps each GLB the moment it decodes by setting the displaced procedural mesh's .visible=false (never disposed until unmount). A failed/missing fetch leaves the procedural fallback intact and throws nothing. On mobile the procedural pass is not a placeholder at all — it is the shipped render for everything except the hero dome; on potato NO GLB ever fetches.

The single hard resolution of the three briefs' central conflict — WHEN to stream vs. the adaptive governor's 15s sample window (mobilePerf.ts GOV_SAMPLE_MS=15000, GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500) — is: the hero DOME is the ONLY asset allowed to load during the governor window (it must be present before the dolly reaches WP2 ~4.5s), and its mobile LOD is kept small enough (<=90KB DRACO, decode+upload <300ms on A14) that it cannot spike a demotion; ALL decorative GLBs (drum window, capitals, balusters, fountain) are deferred to fire AFTER the governor closes (~t=15.2s), well clear of both the sample window and (on the moving-camera path) the WP3 tympanum name-beat, which the dome+procedural columns already serve. Reduced-motion re-ranks to WP1/WP3/WP5 stills but still loads the dome (a quality upgrade, not motion) and skips all decorative GLBs.

Everything is additive-only against a proven seam: loadModel() (GLTFLoader+DRACOLoader, decoder warm from bust GLBs) resolves a cached clone; the new streamer adds every GLB to one exteriorGLBRoot Group added to the scene before the waterfall, and clearModelCache() at unmount is retained. No second WebGL context is ever created (pooled renderer only); KTX2 is an explicit post-ship fast-follow (empty manifest ships safely).

**Design decisions:**
- FLAG: new gate flag3d('w3_exterior'); W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), read ONCE at mount (append after the existing synchronous W2 geometry pass in the single ExteriorScene.tsx useEffect). If !W3 the entire streamer is skipped and tree-shaken. No flag retirement until prod+iOS WKWebView QA signs off. Verified seam: W1=flag3d('w1_exterior') @L92, W2=W1&&flag3d('w2_exterior') @L98.
- STREAMER MODULE: new src/lib/3d/exteriorStreaming.ts exporting streamExteriorAssets(scene, quality, renderer, opts). It owns the priority waterfall, an AbortController cancelled on unmount, per-asset try/catch (silent procedural fallback on reject), and creates ONE exteriorGLBRoot THREE.Group added to scene before any load. ExteriorScene.tsx change = a single guarded call after the sync pass, scheduled via one requestAnimationFrame tick so the first procedural frame commits first (TTI identical to today).
- GOVERNOR RESOLUTION (the key tradeoff): split the waterfall into BAND-1 (dome only) fired at scene mount, and BAND-2 (all decorative GLBs) fired at t = max(GOV_SAMPLE_MS, 15200)ms AFTER the governor's sample window closes. Rationale — brief #2's 'stream after the governor' is safest for demotion, but brief #1/#3's 'dome before WP2' is required for the dolly. Resolve by exempting ONLY the dome (bounded to <=90KB mobile so its decode/upload cannot spike a 25ms miss) into the window, and quarantining every heavier asset outside it. This satisfies all three briefs' non-negotiables simultaneously.
- LOAD ORDER within BAND-1: dome only. Within BAND-2 (serial per-budget-unit, NOT Promise.all — a parallel fetch saturates mobile bandwidth): (1) drum_window_bay ×12 clone-placed, (2) capital_corinthian InstancedMesh, (3) baluster InstancedMesh, (4) fountain_tazza. Desktop loads all; mobile loads NONE of BAND-2 (dome-only tier per iOS binding budget); potato loads nothing at all. Each await loadModel() wrapped in try/catch; reject => procedural stays visible, catch is silent.
- HOT-SWAP PROTOCOL (no pop, no flicker): on resolve — (a) traverse group, replace each MeshStandardMaterial with mkPhys(THREE, extractProps(mat)) to strip clearcoat/sheen/transmission on mobile; (b) FORCE mat.aoMap.channel=0 on every aoMap-bearing material (GLTFLoader defaults to channel 1, assetLoader hardcodes 0 — this is the single most likely silent-wrong-AO bug); (c) re-assign shared PBR maps from the already-cached procedural atlas sets (map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap) so NO new texture upload occurs; (d) call renderer.initTexture() on GLB materials so textures are GPU-ready; (e) scene-add via exteriorGLBRoot; (f) ONLY THEN set the displaced procedural mesh.visible=false (never dispose during the render loop). Disposal happens exclusively in unmount cleanup.
- INSTANCING: author ONE master GLB per repeated element; place via InstancedMesh from the SAME W2 procedural position/rotation arrays (reuse existing placement data, do not bake transforms into the GLB). Add a thin helper placeInstanced(glb, matrices) in exteriorStreaming.ts that mergeGeometries per-material, builds ONE InstancedMesh, applies mkPhys once, sets frustumCulled=false, castShadow/receiveShadow. Draw-call rule: every GLB REPLACES (never ADDS) the procedural draw calls it displaces — dome=1 merged mesh, drum tile=12 clones matching the 12 procedural boxes (net 0), capitals/balusters = 1 InstancedMesh each.
- MATERIAL PALETTE for GLBs (author to these EXACT albedos to match the running scene, which overrides canon.ts for exterior masonry): stone/travertine set diff target #E8DCC0/#E3D6BC; terracotta coppo #B0725A matte; GOLD lantern/tympanum #B8973A (NOT canon #D4AF37 — ExteriorScene.tsx L354 already ships #B8973A for exterior gold); emissive 1.5–3.0 only on gold/lantern to cross the 0.85 bloom threshold. Share aggressively: <=3 unique PBR sets total (stone, terracotta, gold), <=2 on mobile (stone, terracotta). Non-photo assets stay <=0.6 rel-luminance (memories are the brightest pixels).
- BAKE/LIGHT MATCH: one Blender sun lamp matching DirectionalLight #FFB870 at [-20,18,-30] (azimuth ~213°, elevation ~28°) so baked AO/shadow agrees at the dome→drum join. Bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 once via postprocessing.ts). AO baked to UV0 ao channel; normals OpenGL convention (Blender default). Cycles GPU selected-to-active, cage 0.02, smart_project island_margin 0.02, UV0 ONLY.
- EXPORT CONTRACT: DRACO level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12, export_apply=True, export_yup=True, textures embedded as WEBP q85 (single-fetch, no separate texture request). NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent fail). Blender export script MUST bpy.ops.object.join() same-material objects before export AND assert GLB header (magic 0x46546C67, v2, extensionsUsed ⊇ KHR_draco_mesh_compression) before writing to public/models/exterior/. Files: {name}.glb (desktop) + {name}_lo.glb (mobile dome LOD).
- DRACO WARM-UP: dome BAND-1 decode must not stall on cold WASM workers. At mount (inside the W3 branch, before the sync pass) inject <link rel=preload as=fetch href=/draco/draco_decoder.wasm> into document.head, AND fire a throwaway loadModel('/models/bust_base.glb') (already cached/shipped) to spawn the decoder worker pool before the dome load. Zero GPU cost, avoids the 200–400ms first-decode stall inside the governor window.
- REDUCED-MOTION: prefersReducedMotion() (src/lib/3d/reducedMotion.ts, imported @ ExteriorScene L16) is the FIRST guard in the scheduler. On true: skip BAND-2 entirely, still load BAND-1 dome (quality not motion), and the stills compose at WP1/WP3/WP5 from the procedural pass + dome. No streaming churn.
- KTX2 = EXPLICIT POST-SHIP FAST-FOLLOW, NOT day-1. Ship GLB-embedded WEBP first. The assetLoader.ts KTX2 manifest plumbing (pickKTX2Url/loadKTX2Base, empty manifest => JPG authoritative) already ships safely. The desktop-only silent upgrade pass (getQuality().textureRes==='1k' && !isMobileGPU(), a LOCAL new GLTFLoader with loader.setKTX2Loader(initKTX2Loader(getPooledRenderer())), guarded by !isMobileGPU()) is a later PR after npm run build:ktx2 (needs toktx). Rejected brief #1's day-1 KTX2 layer as premature and iOS-risky.
- DRAW-CALL SELF-TRIM GUARD + DEV OVERLAY: in NODE_ENV==='development', 2s after the last GLB resolves, read renderer.info.render.triangles/calls on next rAF and log PASS/FAIL vs per-tier ceilings (desktop 200k tris / 30 GLB calls; mobile 60k / 15; potato 0). Additionally, after each band, if renderer.info.render.calls exceeds the ceiling, remove the last-added Group and console.warn (graceful self-trim). Fires on first visible rAF (never during governor window, never when tab hidden).
- GOVERNOR-DEMOTION RACE FIX: register window.addEventListener('mp:governor:demote', reapplyMkPhys) so if the governor demotes desktop→mobile mid-session, exteriorGLBRoot is re-traversed and mkPhys re-applied (governor only Object.assign's _quality, it does not re-process existing meshes). Fire the event from governorDemote() in mobilePerf.ts (one added dispatch line).
- UNMOUNT CLEANUP: retain existing clearModelCache(). Additionally in the cleanup closure: abort the streamer's AbortController, remove exteriorGLBRoot from scene, and traverse it disposing geometry+material for GLB-produced meshes only (procedural disposal stays in the existing W2 cleanup). NEVER dispose the pooled renderer (belongs to rendererPool.ts).

FIX: rely on the existing scene sweep for clone disposal; only add clearModelCache() (disposes the cached ORIGINALS, which are NOT under `scene`) and the AbortController.abort(). ### WS23 — Mobile GPU / iOS fallback

*Detect low-tier devices, serve reduced assets or the existing procedural exterior, guarantee no App-Review-breaking perf/memory regression.*

**Summary:** W3 exterior GLB fidelity layer: 6 scripted-BPY DRACO GLBs (dome, drum-window tile, Corinthian capital, baluster, urn, fountain) grafted onto the procedural W2 villa behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), REPLACE-not-ADD, 3-tier LOD (desktop full / mobile hero-set / potato dome-only), reconciled to canon.ts tokens and the real merged-rib draw-call baseline.
**Priority `P2` · ~9d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** Raise the perceived quality of the exterior ~1000x by grafting Blender-authored, DRACO-compressed GLB hero assets onto the existing 100% procedural W2 villa — WITHOUT ever regressing mobile/iOS. The governing law is REPLACE-NOT-ADD behind a new flag3d('w3_exterior') gate (W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), staging ON / prod OFF). Every GLB retires the procedural geometry it upgrades so draw-calls stay flat-or-lower than today's W2 baseline; on any load failure, timeout, or potato tier the procedural mesh stays and the scene is visually identical to W2. Three tiers: DESKTOP gets the full decorative set (dome + drum window tile + Corinthian capital + baluster + urn + fountain, ~150-200k tris, ≤30 GLB draw calls); MOBILE/iOS gets a ruthlessly curated hero set (segmented dome + fountain + front-facade balusters, ≤60k GLB tris, ≤4 new draw calls, all DRACO ≤2MB over-the-wire); POTATO gets the dome ONLY at ultra-low LOD (≤2k tris, baked-AO albedo, no normal, no shadow) — the single exception to potato=0-GLBs, because the dome silhouette carries every dolly waypoint and all three reduced-motion stills (WP1/WP3/WP5). The hero payoff frame is the 7.5s tympanum name-beat at WP3 (d=118): dome + drum windows must read razor-sharp there. The single most important resolved tradeoff: GLB decode/upload is deferred past the governor's 2.5s warmup window and swapped in atomically, so the adaptive governor (which demotes a whole tier for the session if >20% of first-15s frames miss 25ms) never false-fires during the 18s establishing cinematic. This is a RUNTIME-integration + Blender-authoring-DISCIPLINE workstream, not net-new geometry invention — the GLB path is already production-proven via the two bust GLBs through modelLoader.ts (GLTFLoader+DRACOLoader, /draco/ decoder warm).

**Design decisions:**
- FLAG GATE: add flag3d('w3_exterior') (no code change needed — flag3d() is open-ended; document it in flags3d.ts header). W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior'), read ONCE at ExteriorScene mount, never per-frame. Staging ON / prod OFF automatically via PROD_HOSTS. Do not retire the flag until iOS+prod QA passes.
- TIER SPLIT ONCE AT MOUNT: read getGPUTier() a single time inside the scene useEffect (it already collapses iOS/iPad/Capacitor to 'mobile'). Also read getQuality() for the DEMOTED tier — the governor persists demotions across sessions, so a device that was demoted yesterday must start at the lower tier. Use the effective (possibly-demoted) tier, not the native tier, to pick the asset set. Decision made exactly once; stored in a local const.
- REPLACE-NOT-ADD PROTOCOL (the core law): every procedural mesh a GLB upgrades gets a STABLE NAME assigned in the W2 geometry pass ('dome_shell', 'drum_ring', 'capital_group', 'baluster_row', 'fountain_base', plus the ~80 rib box meshes grouped under 'dome_ribs'). Swap sequence per asset: load GLB async → on resolve, add GLB group → in the SAME rAF, set procedural.visible=false (do NOT remove yet) → call applyW3Materials() → dispose the procedural geometry+material one frame later and drop the ref. On reject/timeout/potato-skip: procedural stays fully visible. Never spawn a GLB alongside its procedural twin or draw-calls double.
- GOVERNOR-SAFE DEFERRED SWAP: fire all GLB fetches immediately at mount (parallel, dome first for fetch priority), but do NOT insert any GLB into the scene until t≥2.6s (past GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500). The procedural dome/fountain cover the warmup visually. Insert atomically on the next rAF after 2.6s to avoid a pop. Assets that resolve after 2.6s insert immediately on resolution. This is the single most important perf decision — it prevents governor false-demotion during decode/upload.
- ASYNC + TIMEOUT + allSettled: wrap every load in Promise.race([loadModel(path), timeout(8000)]) and collect via Promise.allSettled so one 404/slow asset never blocks others. Scene renders W2 procedural instantly; GLBs hot-swap as they resolve. On mobile, DRACO decode is main-thread in WKWebView (no SharedArrayBuffer) — load dome first and await its decode before starting the fountain fetch (sequential on mobile only) to avoid two simultaneous WASM decompressions spiking the warmup.
- mkPhys() RE-APPLY IS MANDATORY: modelLoader.ts sets castShadow/receiveShadow but does NOT call mkPhys(). Add applyW3Materials(group, quality) in a new src/lib/3d/exteriorGLBLoader.ts that traverses every Mesh, rebuilds each material via mkPhys(THREE, {color,roughness,metalness,map,normalMap,roughnessMap,aoMap}) so MeshPhysicalMaterial downgrades to MeshStandardMaterial on mobile (2-3x cheaper fragment cost in WKWebView), sets aoMap.channel=0 on every aoMap (GLTFLoader defaults to channel 1 = uv2; assetLoader only fixes basic geometries), sets envMapIntensity to Q.loadEnvHDRI?1.0:0.0, and copies castShadow/receiveShadow from Q.shadowsEnabled.
- TEXTURE DEDUP — STRIP EMBEDDED, SHARE ATLAS: export GLBs with NO embedded textures (Blender export_image_format='NONE'); load the PBR atlases ONCE via the existing loadPBRSet contract and assign material.map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap from the pre-loaded shared THREE.Texture in the post-load traverse. Two GLBs sharing 'stone_travertine' then upload ONE copy to GPU, not two. Reuse existing sets where possible (loadTravertineTextures, loadTerracottaTileTextures, loadSandstoneTextures already registered). Hard cap: ≤3 unique W3 PBR atlases (stone_travertine / terracotta_coppo / gold_lantern) at 1k → ~15MB GPU max W3 overhead, inside the mobile ceiling. Never exceed the mobile eager cap of 4 material sets (3 W3 + plaster already loaded).
- MATERIAL SLOT CANON (no deviation): exactly 3 W3 slots. stone_travertine (albedo TRAVERTINE #E8DCC0/#E3D6BC, roughness 0.8, metalness 0, procedural voronoi-veined Blender bake) shared by dome+drum+capital+baluster+urn+fountain. terracotta_coppo (#B0725A mat, roughness 0.9, from Polyhaven ceramic_roof_01/clay_roof_tiles_02) for roof/dome ribs. gold_lantern (#B8973A, metalness 0.85, roughness 0.25, NO texture) for lantern + tympanum lettering ONLY. Keep all non-photo assets ≤0.6 relative luminance — memories stay the brightest pixels.
- DOME PRIORITY OVERRIDE — the one potato exception: the dome loads on ALL tiers (desktop hi ≤25k / mobile ≤8k / potato ≤2k). Potato loads dome_lo.glb ONLY (baked-AO albedo, no normal map, no shadow, single travertine material) and skips every other GLB. This is justified because the dome+lantern silhouette must hold from every waypoint and all three reduced-motion stills. All other assets are desktop+mobile only.
- INSTANCING FOR REPEATS: author ONE master GLB per repeated element (drum window tile, baluster, urn, capital); place via THREE.InstancedMesh with per-instance matrix + small scale/rot jitter for 'grown-over-centuries' asymmetry. Ring/run positions computed in Blender and exported as a JSON sidecar next to the GLB. NEVER export N copies. Desktop: full count. Mobile: cap to drum-tile ×12 (1 InstancedMesh draw call), baluster front-facade run only, ≤4 urns; capitals are desktop-only (mobilePriority -1).
- DISPOSAL SAFETY (real footgun): loadModel returns clone() and in three r155+ clone geometry SHARES the source buffers — NEVER call geometry.dispose() on a GLB clone (it disposes the shared cached source). clearModelCache() at unmount handles the masters. ONLY call geometry.dispose()+material.dispose() on the PROCEDURAL meshes that were explicitly replaced by a resolved GLB. Keep a ref array of removed procedural meshes so the cleanup function double-checks disposal.
- GOVERNOR HARD-EJECT SAFETY NET: keep replaced procedural meshes constructed-but-invisible (visible=false), never destroyed while W3 assets are live on mobile — no, correction: dispose is fine on mobile for VRAM, BUT retain a rebuild closure. Add a per-second governor listener in ExteriorScene: if _effectiveTier drops below the tier the GLBs were sized for (demotion detected), remove all decorative GLB groups, restore procedural visibility (rebuild if disposed), and set sessionStorage mp3d:w3_fallback=true so the next load skips GLB attempts for 24h. This guarantees Apple App Review can never observe a perf regression.
- DEV-ONLY DRAW-CALL BUDGET OVERLAY: single fixed-position DOM node created once, gated by flag3d('w3_debug') && NODE_ENV==='development' (auto-hidden in prod via same PROD_HOSTS guard). Update textContent once/sec in the rAF with renderer.info.render.triangles / .calls / effective tier / renderer.info.memory.textures. Assert: if mobile calls>80 || tris>60000 → console.error('[W3-budget] OVER CEILING'). This is the primary QA gate before npx vercel --prod.
- DRACO CANARY + PRELOAD: the two bust GLBs prove the decoder path, but they load in the INTERIOR, not exterior — on first exterior visit the DRACO WASM cold-starts ~200-400ms. Add <link rel='preload'> for /draco/draco_decoder.wasm + /draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js in the exterior page head, OR call the dome load first so its decode warms the decoder before the fountain. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent parse fail); enforce export_draco=True, export_meshopt=False in the Blender export script and assert extensionsUsed⊇KHR_draco_mesh_compression on every committed GLB.
- BLENDER LIGHTING MATCH (or the bake clashes): Blender sun lamp at position [-20,18,-30] (SW, ~28° elevation, azimuth ~213°) matching canon.ts DirectionalLight #FFB870. Bake AO+normal on Cycles GPU at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping exposure 1.15 ONCE — never bake in exposure). Normal maps OpenGL convention (Blender default). Merge sub-meshes per material (Object>Join) so each GLB = 1 draw call per material; assert group.children.length ≤3 on import or console.warn.
- REDUCED-MOTION: prefersReducedMotion() already exists; the dolly is skipped and camera holds at WP1/WP3/WP5 stills. GLB world positions match the procedural positions EXACTLY so no separate reduced-motion asset path is needed — but for reduced-motion, either await GLB loads before composing the still OR render the procedural still immediately and swap on resolve (acceptable — the user isn't watching an animation). i18n: the tympanum owner-name is text baked as extruded curve OUTLINE in Blender (never generative — generators mangle text); any UI strings around the debug overlay stay dev-only so no i18n keys needed for shipped surfaces.

**Integration:**

On MOBILE ONLY, await dome decode before starting fountain fetch (sequential) to avoid dual main-thread WASM decompression during warmup. Collect via Promise.allSettled so one 404/slow asset never blocks others.
- GOVERNOR-SAFE DEFERRED SWAP: do NOT insert any GLB into the scene until t>=2.6s (past GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500). Procedural dome/fountain cover warmup visually. Swap atomically on the next rAF after 2.6s. Assets resolving after 2.6s insert immediately on resolution. This prevents governor false-demotion during decode/upload.
- SWAP PROTOCOL per asset: on resolve -> add GLB group -> same rAF set procedural.visible=false (do NOT remove yet) -> applyW3Materials(group,quality,sharedTextures) -> ONE frame later dispose the procedural geometry+material and drop the ref. On reject/timeout/potato-skip: procedural stays fully visible (scene identical to W2).
- DISPOSAL SAFETY (three r155+): loadModel returns clone() whose geometry SHARES cached source buffers - NEVER call geometry.dispose() on a GLB clone. Dispose ONLY the named procedural meshes explicitly replaced; rely on clearModelCache() at unmount for the masters.

Guarantees Apple App Review never observes a perf regression.

Render procedural stills immediately and hot-swap on GLB resolve. GLB world positions match procedural positions EXACTLY so no separate reduced-motion asset path is needed.

- Fix: Never dispose a GLB clone's geometry (three r155+ clone shares source buffers); dispose ONLY the named procedural meshes explicitly replaced, and rely on clearModelCache() at unmount for masters - keep a ref array of replaced procedural meshes for the cleanup double-check.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Flag OFF (prod hostnames) => scene byte-identical to current W2: zero GLB fetches, zero new draw calls. Verified by network panel + dev overlay.
- [ ] Flag ON desktop => all 6 GLBs load and REPLACE their procedural twins (no doubled geometry); renderer.info.render.calls does not exceed W2 baseline + the measured per-asset delta; total W3 tris 150-200k.
- [ ] Flag ON mobile/iOS WKWebView => only dome + drum-tile + baluster + fountain load (capitals excluded); <=4-5 NEW draw calls; composite GLB tris <=60k; whole-scene <=750k tris / <=80 opaque calls / <=140MB tex; sustained ~60fps.
- [ ] Potato tier => dome_lo (<=2k, no normal, no shadow) ONLY; all other GLBs skipped; reads correctly with no env map / no shadows.
- [ ] Governor does NOT false-fire during the first 15s / 18s cinematic: <20% of first-15s frames miss 25ms (no session demotion) - GLB insertion deferred past t=2.6s confirmed via profiling.
- [ ] Governor hard-eject verified: forcing a mid-session demotion removes all decorative GLBs, restores procedural visibility, and sets mp3d:w3_fallback for 24h - no visible frozen/broken frame (Apple 2.1a protection).
- [ ] Every committed GLB header asserts magic 0x46546C67, version 2, extensionsUsed includes KHR_draco_mesh_compression, and group.children.length<=3 (merged per material).
- [ ] On any GLB 404/timeout/decode-fail the procedural mesh stays fully visible - scene never shows a hole; the two bust GLBs still load (decoder canary intact).
- [ ] Reduced-motion stills at WP1/WP3/WP5 compose immediately off procedural geometry and hot-swap on GLB resolve (no await regression at ExteriorScene.tsx:4558).
- [ ] No GLB clone geometry is ever disposed (grep the W3 cleanup for geometry.dispose on cloned groups = 0); only the named replaced procedural meshes are disposed; clearModelCache() runs at unmount.
- [ ] All albedo bakes match canon tokens (spot-check dome/baluster albedo == #E3D6BC/#F2E9DA family, gold == #D4AF37, coppo from Polyhaven) - no off-canon #B8973A/#E8DCC0/#B0725A anywhere.
- [ ] WP3 tympanum name-beat (d=118) reads razor-sharp: segmented dome + 12 arched drum-window tiles legible; owner sign-off on a WP3 screenshot before prod promotion.

- Do the procedural exterior meshes already have stable names, or must names be added in the W2 pass? The swap-by-name protocol depends on 'dome_shell','drum_ring','fountain_base' etc. existing — audit ExteriorScene.tsx W2 block.
- Should GLB loads gate on cinematic-advance-past-WP1 instead of a fixed 2.6s timer? A fixed timer is simpler but WP1 timing may differ from 2.6s; confirm the dolly schedule so the swap lands on a wide/low-detail frame (hides any pop).
- Owner decision: enable Hunyuan3D/Rodin for figural statuary/mascarons (currently disabled, need N-panel checkbox + restart + commercial-license confirmation)? This plan keeps ALL hero masonry scripted-BPY and does not depend on generative tools, but the fountain mascaron and any future statuary would benefit — deferrable to a later wave.
- KTX2 fast-follow: ship JPG/WEBP first (this plan), then npm run build:ktx2 (needs toktx) + wire loader.setKTX2Loader for GLB-embedded KTX2. Confirm toktx is installed in the build environment before scheduling the compression pass.
- Is prefersReducedMotion still-composition currently awaiting async work, or does it render immediately? Determines whether reduced-motion must await GLB loads or can swap-on-resolve for the WP1/WP3/WP5 stills.

### WS24 — Blender MCP tool routing per asset

*The decision matrix: scripted bpy vs Polyhaven vs Sketchfab vs Rodin vs Hunyuan for each asset class, with reproducible generation recipes.*

**Summary:** W3 exterior GLB kit: 5 scripted-bpy architectural assets (dome, drum-bay, Corinthian capital, baluster, fountain) plus one optional deferred Hunyuan herm, each DRACO-GLB streamed through the existing modelLoader seam behind flag3d('w3_exterior'), REPLACING (not adding) procedural draw calls, with cold-decoder pre-warm, governor-window-safe staged loading, canon GOLD #D4AF37, mandatory mkPhys rebind, and UV0 baked AO.
**Priority `P1` · ~18d · Feasible: yes · Confidence 0.72**

**Vision.** One authoritative Blender-authoring route per asset class, chosen by perceived-quality-return-per-byte under the iOS/WKWebView binding budget. The design is HYBRID-ADDITIVE-BY-REPLACEMENT: every strong procedural system (sky, terrain, grass/wheat shaders, daylight, postprocessing, env-map PMREM, audio) stays byte-identical; only six geometry clusters where a GLB yields a DISCONTINUOUS quality jump are swapped in, and each GLB REPLACES its procedural draw calls rather than stacking. All new code gates behind `const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior')` read once at mount (staging ON / prod OFF automatically, verified in flags3d.ts line 46). The existing loadModel()/DRACO seam in src/lib/3d/modelLoader.ts is the ONLY integration path — zero new loader infrastructure. Route matrix: (A) SCRIPTED BPY for the five deterministic architectural assets (dome, drum bay, capital, baluster, fountain) — deterministic, tiny, instanceable, exact Renaissance mitres, and text/lettering never trusted to generators; (B) HUNYUAN3D image→3D for the one organic asset class (statuary/herms) with a scripted-bpy silhouette fallback because Hunyuan3D is gated OFF in the N-panel; (C) POLYHAVEN CC0 for TEXTURE SOURCE + bake-reference HDRI ONLY, never villa geometry; SKETCHFAB and RODIN both SKIPPED (Sketchfab NC/ND license risk for a paid app; Rodin only as Hunyuan alternate). The desktop tier is authored at the fidelity ceiling; a single mobile LOD (≤750k scene / author each mobile hero LOD low) and a zero-GLB potato fallback are budget floors, not the design target. Priority order by ROI at the 18s dolly beats (WP1/WP3/WP5 also serve the reduced-motion stills): dome shell first (visible every waypoint), then drum bays + Corinthian capitals (the WP3 d=118 tympanum name-beat, the single most-read frame), then balusters, fountain, herms.

**Design decisions:**
- ROUTE MATRIX RESOLVED: scripted-bpy wins for all 5 architectural assets (dome/drum-bay/capital/baluster/fountain) because they are deterministic, sub-1k-tri, instanceable, and need exact Renaissance profiles; Hunyuan3D wins for statuary/herms (organic figural work bpy cannot author) but is DEFERRED/optional because it is disabled in the N-panel — herms do NOT block the other five. Polyhaven = CC0 texture source + bake HDRI only. Sketchfab SKIPPED (NC/ND license risk on a paid app). Rodin = Hunyuan alternate only.
- TRADEOFF — BALUSTERS: the photoreal brief wanted a pre-merged ~96k-tri balustrade GLB; the perf brief wanted InstancedMesh; the hybrid brief wanted desktop-only instancing. RESOLVED: author ONE baluster_master.glb (~360 tris, 8-sided lathe), desktop renders it as InstancedMesh (2-4 draw calls, one per rail run) with the SAME bx/bz coordinate logic that baluX/baluZ already computes; MOBILE and POTATO keep the existing merged CylinderGeometry procedural path untouched (a merged 8-sided cylinder reads fine at mobile tier and costs 0 new draw calls). No pre-merged mega-GLB — it blows the iOS GPU ceiling for marginal gain.
- TRADEOFF — DRAW CALLS vs GOVERNOR: draw calls (not tris) are the #1 mobile killer, and the adaptive governor demotes a tier for 7 days if >20% frames miss 25ms in the first 15s. RESOLVED with a two-part mitigation: (1) every GLB REPLACES procedural draw calls (dome GLB removes 1 sphere + ~80 rib boxes → 1-2 calls; capitals 8 boxes → 1 InstancedMesh; fountain 5 meshes → 1); (2) PRE-WARM to beat governor jank — start all fetch()es in parallel via Promise.allSettled immediately after the synchronous geometry pass, add resolved GLBs to the scene off-camera (x=9999) to force shader-compile + texture-upload during warmup, then move to final position and hide the procedural twin in one microtask batch. This front-loads decode/compile before the governor's sampling window closes.
- TRADEOFF — EMBEDDED vs SHARED ALBEDO: RESOLVED — GLBs embed ONLY the baked normal + AO (WEBP, 1k), and NEVER embed albedo/roughness. Albedo/roughness/AO-tint come from a shared PBR set already on disk or newly added under public/textures/pbr/{set}/, assigned in the loader wrapper. This keeps unique MeshStandardMaterial bindings ≤2-3 for ALL six assets combined (mobile eager cap = 4 sets) and maximizes THREE.Texture cache sharing. Reference the shared set's THREE.Texture, never clone it.
- MKPHYS RE-APPLICATION IS MANDATORY (verified: modelLoader.ts loadModel only sets castShadow/receiveShadow, lines 29-34 — it does NOT call mkPhys). Every loaded GLB must be traversed: for each child.isMesh, rebuild material via mkPhys(THREE, {color: canonHex, roughness, map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap from shared set}) and assign it, DISCARDING the GLTFLoader-embedded material. This is the single most important step — it strips MeshPhysicalMaterial (clearcoat/sheen/transmission) that would 2-3x the fragment-shader cost on iOS, and re-binds the canon palette so GLBs never clash with adjacent procedural geometry.
- UV0-ONLY BAKE (verified: assetLoader.ts line 554 hardcodes aoMap.channel = 0). Every GLB bakes AO into the SAME UV island as diffuse (UV0 / 'UVMap'), never a UV1 lightmap channel. Baked AO carries mobile+potato because SSAO is desktop-only. Colorspace discipline: albedo texture nodes = sRGB; normal/rough/ao nodes = Non-Color, or the on-screen gamma drifts from the procedural neighbors.
- BAKE-LIGHTING MATCH (from canon.ts): one Blender sun lamp matching Three.js DirectionalLight #FFB870 at [-20,18,-30] (SW, azimuth ~213°, elevation ~28°); Cycles GPU (HIP), selected-to-active with cage, ray distance ~0.15; bake at exposure 1.0 (runtime applies NeutralToneMapping @1.15 once — baking at 1.0 avoids double-grading). Normal maps OpenGL/Blender convention.
- EXPORT CONTRACT (all GLBs): DRACO level 6, pos 14, nrm 10, uv 12; export_apply=True, export_yup=True, export_image_format='WEBP'. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered — silent load failure). After every export, assert GLB header magic 0x46546C67, version 2, and extensionsUsed ⊇ KHR_draco_mesh_compression; confirm Blender's draco encoder (4.x = 1.5.x) matches the deployed /public/draco/ decoder that the two bust GLBs already exercise (the decoder canary). Files land in public/models/exterior/.
- POTATO = ZERO GLB, ZERO REGRESSION: on potato getQuality() tier, no GLB loads at all — all six assets fall back to the existing W2 procedural geometry with no shadows/env-map dependency. A per-tier helper src/lib/3d/exteriorGLBConfig.ts returns {path, instanceCount, materialSet} per asset from getQuality().textureRes + isMobileGPU(), so tier tuning has ONE change surface. Mobile loads only dome_lo + fountain_lo (+ capital LOD instanced) as the decorative budget; drum bays and balusters stay procedural on mobile.
- GRACEFUL DEGRADATION IS THE DEFAULT: each GLB load is wrapped in try/catch inside Promise.allSettled; on any rejection the W2 procedural twin stays visible (never hidden until its GLB resolves). Dispose only via clearModelCache() in the existing useEffect cleanup return — NEVER dispose clones, never open a 2nd WebGL context (use the pooled renderer; a 2nd context is silently jetsam-killed on iOS). Dev-only W3 overlay asserts renderer.info.render.triangles/calls vs ceilings and console.errors on overrun before staging deploy.

11. STEP 10: Author src/lib/3d/exteriorGLBConfig.ts exporting getExteriorGLBConfig(Q) returning per-asset {path, instanceCount, materialSet} from getQuality().textureRes + isMobileGPU(): potato empty, mobile dome_lo+fountain_lo+capital-LOD, desktop all. One tuning surface.

**Poly budget:** desktop ~104k new GLB tris atop ~80k existing procedural = ~184k total (within 150-200k self-imposed target, 3.0M hard ceiling). dome_hi ~6k; drum_bay ~640 x12 instanced ~7.7k; capital ~800 x9 instanced ~7.2k; baluster_master ~380 instanced ~76k across rails; fountain_hi ~4k; herm ~2.8k x2 optional. Net new GLB draw calls ~9, each REPLACES its procedural twin (net delta <=0 per swap). · mobile Mobile-LOD ceiling 750k tris (iOS binding). Actual W3 new ~7.2k: dome_lo ~2.4k + capital-LOD ~320 x6 ~2.0k + fountain_lo ~1.0k + optional herm-LOD ~1.2k. Drum bays and balusters STAY procedural on mobile (0 new GLB calls). Potato = ZERO GLB, full procedural fallback. Net new mobile GLB draw calls ~5, within 80-opaque-call budget.
**Texture maps:** diff (albedo, sRGB) — shared on-disk PBR set, NOT embedded, nor_gl (OpenGL normal, Non-Color) — baked, EMBEDDED in GLB as WEBP 1k, ao (Non-Color, UV0 / aoMap.channel=0) — baked selected-to-active, EMBEDDED WEBP 1k, rough (Non-Color) — shared on-disk PBR set, NOT embedded, curvature/pointiness (bake helper only, not shipped) @ Ship 1k JPG/WEBP first for all tiers (404->1k fallback). Desktop 2k fast-follow. GLBs EMBED only baked normal (nor_gl) + AO as WEBP 1k; albedo+roughness from shared on-disk PBR sets (never embedded) so unique material bindings stay <=3. KTX2 atlases fast-follow, gated on toktx install.
**Export:** glTF 2.0 GLB via bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf. DRACO: export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=True, level 6, position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12. export_apply=True, export_yup=True, export_image_format='WEBP'. NEVER meshopt (no MeshoptDecoder registered = silent load fail). Post-export assert: GLB magic 0x46546C67, version==2, extensionsUsed includes KHR_draco_mesh_compression. Round-trip ONE test GLB through loadModel() in the actual runtime to prove Blender 4.x draco encoder decodes against the shipped /public/draco/ 1.5.x decoder before authoring the rest.
**Target path:** `public/models/exterior/`

**Integration:**
- Gate: add const W3 = W2 && flag3d('w3_exterior') read ONCE at mount (~line 98). Staging ON / prod OFF automatically per flags3d.ts line 46 PROD_HOSTS check (verified).
- COLD-DECODER PRE-WARM (required fix, verified: ExteriorScene does NOT import modelLoader today; busts load elsewhere so the DRACO wasm is COLD at exterior mount): during the synchronous mount pass, before the 18s dolly begins, call dracoLoader.preload() (or loadModel on a tiny warm-up GLB) to fetch+instantiate draco_decoder.wasm/.js OUTSIDE the governor sampling window. Parallel Promise.allSettled does NOT hide first-decode wasm-init cost.
- GOVERNOR-SAFE STAGING (required fix, verified GOV_WARMUP_MS=2500, 15000ms sample, demote if >=2 of ~4 windows miss >25% frames >25ms): do NOT decode all GLBs inside the first 15s on mobile. Either start GLB loads AFTER the 15s sample completes (accept pop-in behind the still-visible procedural twin) OR load only dome_lo on mobile during warmup and defer fountain_lo/capital-LOD. Desktop may load in parallel post-decoder-warm.
- MANDATORY mkPhys REBIND (verified loadModel lines 29-34 set only shadows): traverse every loaded GLB; for each mesh rebuild material via mkPhys(THREE, {color: canonHex, roughness, map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap = sharedSet.*}) and assign, discarding the GLTFLoader material. This binds canon palette + shared textures and applies mobile Physical-stripping. NOTE: on desktop mkPhys returns a full MeshPhysicalMaterial (verified lines 343-345) so it is NOT a desktop shader saving — the rebind is for palette+texture binding + mobile stripping only. Pass all maps explicitly; mkPhys does not read the GLTF material.

- Cleanup: clearModelCache() in the existing useEffect return only; never dispose clones; never open a 2nd WebGL context (use the pooled renderer — a 2nd context is silently jetsam-killed on iOS).
- i18n + reduced-motion untouched: reduced-motion stills compose at WP1/WP3/WP5, so every hero asset must read correct at exactly those three angles (front -Z primary at 6-30deg elevation; dome+lantern must hold silhouette from all waypoints with lookAt y=21).

**LOD tiers:**

- iOS risk: medium
- Blender MCP can produce: yes

- Blocker: Hunyuan3D/Rodin disabled behind owner N-panel gate + commercial-license confirmation (herm route only)
- Fix: FIX THE COLD-DECODER TTI RISK (highest). Verified: ExteriorScene.tsx does NOT import modelLoader/loadModel today — W3 introduces the FIRST exterior GLB load. The busts are only loaded by bustBuilder.ts inside a palace room, so at exterior mount the DRACO decoder (draco_decoder.wasm 192KB + .js 512KB) is COLD, not 'warm from bust GLBs' as the plan claims. First GLB triggers a synchronous wasm fetch+instantiate DURING the 18s cinematic, exactly inside the governor's 2.5-15s sampling window. Required: (a) pre-fetch and instantiate the DRACO decoder BEFORE the dolly begins (call loadModel on a tiny warm-up GLB, or GLTFLoader.setDRACOLoader + dracoLoader.preload(), during the mount's synchronous pass); (b) do NOT rely on Promise.allSettled parallel fetch alone — parallelism does not hide first-decode wasm-init cost; (c) off-camera pre-warm (x=9999) forces shader-compile but a full render of the off-screen mesh is required to actually upload textures + compile — verify with renderer.compile() explicitly.
- Fix: SPLIT THE GOVERNOR RISK ACROSS THE WARMUP WINDOW. The adaptive governor (verified mobilePerf.ts lines 237-324) demotes a tier for 7 days if ≥25% of frames exceed 25ms across ≥2 of ~4 windows in the first 15s. GLB decode+compile+upload spikes land here. GOV_WARMUP_MS is only 2500ms — decode of 6 GLBs will not finish by then on a mobile GPU. Required: either (a) gate GLB loading to start AFTER the 15s governor sample completes (load them at t>15s, accept pop-in behind the still-running procedural twin), or (b) load only ONE GLB (dome_lo) on mobile during warmup and defer the rest. Do NOT load dome_lo + fountain_lo + capital-LOD simultaneously on mobile inside the window as the plan proposes.
- Fix: USE CANON GOLD #D4AF37, NOT #B8973A. Verified: canon.ts exports GOLD='#D4AF37' and every gold surface in the app (EntranceHall, Corridor, eraMaterials) uses #D4AF37. The brief/plan's repeated '#B8973A' for the tympanum/lantern originates from a stale docstring comment in mobilePerf.ts line 337 only. Shipping #B8973A would make the exterior gold visibly duller than the entrance-hall gold the user walks into 2 seconds later.
- Fix: MKPHYS DOES NOT STRIP CLEARCOAT ON DESKTOP — the plan's premise is half-wrong. Verified mobilePerf.ts lines 339-367: mkPhys returns a full MeshPhysicalMaterial on desktop (isMobileGPU()===false) and only strips clearcoat/sheen/transmission on mobile/potato. So 're-apply mkPhys to strip MeshPhysicalMaterial' is a no-op on desktop. The real requirement stands (GLTFLoader materials must be rebuilt via mkPhys to bind canon palette + shared textures + get mobile stripping), but the plan should not claim desktop fragment-shader savings from it. Also: mkPhys(THREE, props) constructs a NEW material from props — you must pass color/roughness/map/normalMap/roughnessMap/aoMap explicitly; it does not read the GLTF material.
- Fix: DECOUPLE KTX2-FOR-GLB FROM THE 'ONE LINE' CLAIM. Verified: toktx is NOT on the build machine PATH (blocks build:ktx2), and the existing KTX2Loader wiring in assetLoader.ts is for the JPG-PBR-set pipeline (manifest-gated, JPG-authoritative) — it is NOT wired into modelLoader.ts. GLB-embedded KTX2 requires loader.setKTX2Loader(initKTX2Loader(renderer)) added to modelLoader's GLTFLoader plus a renderer handle threaded in — new integration, not one line. Non-blocking (ship WEBP-embedded GLB first), but the plan must not schedule KTX2 as trivial and must confirm toktx install first.
- Fix: DRACO ENCODER/DECODER PARITY IS A REAL GATE, NOT ppaper. Verified: three@0.183.2 ships DRACOLoader expecting draco 1.5.x; bust_base.glb genuinely uses KHR_draco_mesh_compression (canary valid) but bust_female.glb does NOT — so only one existing file exercises the decode path. Before exporting any W3 GLB, confirm Blender 4.x glTF exporter's draco encoder version decodes against the shipped /public/draco/ decoder by round-tripping ONE test GLB through loadModel in the actual runtime. A silent decode fail = invisible asset with procedural fallback (no error surfaced to user), which is exactly the failure mode that hid in the bust pipeline.
- Fix: ENFORCE 'REPLACE NOT ADD' MECHANICALLY. The mobile draw-call budget (80 opaque calls) is the binding constraint and the plan's own accounting only works if each GLB removes its procedural twin's draw calls. But the exterior builds 164 mesh/scene.add sites with 12 existing InstancedMesh/merge sites — the procedural-twin-hiding must target the EXACT mk()/InstancedMesh handles. - Fix: BUILD THE DEV OVERLAY BEFORE AUTHORING ASSETS, and add a hard runtime assert. No renderer.info overlay exists in ExteriorScene today. Without it the per-device budget claims (≤60k mobile tris / ≤15 GLB draw calls / ≤140MB tex) are unverifiable and the governor demotion will be discovered only as a 7-day field regression on real iPhones. The plan correctly defers this, but must guarantee the five architectural GLBs have ZERO code/asset dependency on herm_figure.glb so the herm can ship never. Also: Hunyuan output needs heavy retopo/decimate to hit the ~2.8k desktop / ~1.2k mobile budget and its photoreal albedo MUST be discarded for canon marble — realistic effort per herm is high; the scripted-bpy silhouette fallback is the safer default for v1.
